entries.author: Ari

entries.name: LinkedIn Hook Writer
entries.summary: Writes scroll-stopping LinkedIn post hooks for founders and B2B creators, using data-backed hook principles and a real-facts-only rule.
entries.summary_zh: 为创始人和 B2B 创作者写让人停下滑动的 LinkedIn 开头，依据有数据支撑的开头原则，只用真实事实。
entries.author: Dilini

entries.name: Don Bot Corleone
entries.summary: Sends your work to top Claude and OpenAI models through your own Claude Code and Codex subscription logins, not paid API keys, and can compare models.
entries.summary_zh: 用你自己的 Claude Code 和 Codex 订阅登录（不用付费 API key）把活派给顶级 Claude 和 OpenAI 模型并带回结果，还能并排比较模型。
entries.author: AdamDesigns

entries.name: Onboarding Bot
entries.summary: Gets new hires up to speed: builds a knowledge file from your onboarding docs, tracks each hire's checklist and drafts a timed welcome email series.
entries.summary_zh: 让新员工快速上手：用入职文档建知识文件，跟踪每位新人的清单，起草定时欢迎邮件序列等你批准，每周核对资料来源。
entries.author: Matthew

entries.name: Family Book Bot
entries.summary: Keeps your family's yearly income and expense book in Google Sheets or Excel Online, logging every receipt from photos or order emails, in any language.
entries.summary_zh: 在 Google Sheets 或 Excel Online 里记家庭年度收支账，从照片或订单邮件里录入每张收据，支持任何语言。
entries.author: Skybatan

entries.name: Archivist
entries.summary: Keeps one long-term record of your projects and decisions as plain Markdown notes in a private GitHub repo, so you and your AI assistants keep context.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的项目和决策长期记录成私有 GitHub 仓库里的纯 Markdown 笔记，让你和其他 AI 助手都不丢上下文。
entries.author: Phillip

entries.name: Tavern DM
entries.summary: Tabletop RPG with a DM bot, Cast bots for NPCs and enemies and a Party bot for AI heroes; you play your own hero. Solo by default, multiplayer optional.
entries.summary_zh: 桌面角色扮演游戏：DM bot 主持，Cast bot 扮演 NPC 和敌人，Party bot 扮演 AI 队友，你扮演自己的英雄。默认单人，可选多人。
entries.author: Chef

entries.name: Postwright
entries.summary: Turns your week of real work into ready-to-post X drafts in your own voice, with sources, assets and suggested times. Draft-only: you hit post.
entries.summary_zh: 把你一周的真实工作变成用你自己口吻写的 X 草稿，附来源、素材和建议发布时间。只起草，发帖由你按。
entries.author: Calix

entries.name: Chief of Staff Kit
entries.summary: One front door for your bot org: routes work to specialist bots, tracks open items and never acts externally without your approval.
entries.summary_zh: 你的 bot 组织的统一前台：把工作派给专职 bot，跟踪未结事项，未经你批准绝不对外行动。
entries.author: Dennis

entries.name: Stenographer
entries.summary: Keeps a light word-for-word text log of everything your Grok Bots and group chats say, plus each bot's instructions, so your setup can be rebuilt.
entries.summary_zh: 给你所有 Grok Bot 和群聊的发言留一份轻量逐字文本记录，连同每个 bot 的指令，便于在另一个账号里重建整套配置。
entries.author: Andy

entries.name: Streamer Calvin
entries.summary: Supervised live-stream co-producer for X Live, Twitch, YouTube and Kick: helps set up OBS, reads and moderates chat, and drafts replies you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 受你监督的直播副导播，支持 X Live、Twitch、YouTube 和 Kick：帮你设置 OBS，读弹幕、做管理，并起草回复等你批准。
entries.author: Falcon

entries.name: News Bias Meter
entries.summary: Scores news headlines and articles for objectivity on a 1-5 scale, quoting the exact words behind each score, with an optional daily digest of your sources.
entries.summary_zh: 按 1–5 分给新闻标题和文章的客观性打分，并引用每个分数背后的原话；也可每天推送你常看来源的摘要。
entries.author: Denton

entries.name: YouTube Strategy Professor
entries.summary: YouTube strategy tutor: tracks official updates and top strategists daily, sends a sourced digest on packaging, retention, monetization and a daily experiment.
entries.summary_zh: YouTube 策略导师：每天研究官方更新和头部策略师，发来带出处的摘要，涵盖包装、留存、变现，外加一个每日实验。
entries.author: Abdullah

entries.name: Launchpad
entries.summary: App store manager that sets up and maintains your mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play, from first listing to production release.
entries.summary_zh: 应用商店管家：在 App Store 和 Google Play 上为你的移动应用完成从首次上架到正式发布的设置和维护。
entries.author: Fellipe

entries.name: OPSEC
entries.summary: Defensive security bot for small businesses and solo devs: inventories apps, repos, deploys and domains, and reports leaked secrets and misconfigs with fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 给小企业主和独立开发者的防御型安全 bot：盘点应用、仓库、部署和域名，排查泄露的密钥和错误配置，定期用大白话报告并给出具体修法。
entries.author: Jason

entries.name: Rule Manager
entries.summary: Shows the rules and standing instructions your agents follow and where each came from, flagging conflicts, stale rules and holds that spread. Read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 列出你的 agent 遵循的规则和常驻指令及其来源，标出冲突、过时规则和波及其他工作的暂停指令。只读。
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: Phone Caller
entries.summary: Makes real phone calls for you in a natural AI voice, in any language: book a table, check hours, pass on a message. Bring your own Telnyx number and xAI key.
entries.summary_zh: 用自然的 AI 语音替你打真实电话，任何语言都行：订位、问营业时间、转达消息。无需订阅，自带 Telnyx 号码和 xAI key，按用量付费。
entries.author: Walter

entries.name: School Mail Watch
entries.summary: For parents: reads your email for school messages, lists what's needed and when, adds dates to your calendar and sends one short daily summary. Read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 给忙碌的家长：读取邮箱里来自孩子学校的邮件，列出要准备的东西和期限，把日期加进日历，每天发一份简短摘要。只读，不发也不删。
entries.author: Walter

entries.name: Security Watch
entries.summary: Watches your GitHub repos and Vercel projects for newly disclosed vulnerabilities and supply-chain attacks, and reports what actually affects you with fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着你的 GitHub 仓库和 Vercel 项目，留意新披露的漏洞和供应链攻击，只报告真正影响你的部分并给出具体修复方法。默认只扫描和报告。
entries.author: emre

entries.name: FPL Gaffer
entries.summary: Runs your Fantasy Premier League team: deadline reminders, injury news, and sourced transfer, captain and chip advice, making changes only after your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你打理梦幻英超（FPL）球队：截止提醒、伤病消息，以及有出处的转会、队长和芯片建议，你点头后才改阵容。
entries.author: Issah

entries.name: Distro
entries.summary: Publishes your finished podcast or video to YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Facebook, X and more, in multiple languages with chapters, then checks each link.
entries.summary_zh: 把做好的播客或视频发布到 YouTube、Spotify、Apple Podcasts、Facebook、X 等平台，支持多语言，带章节和完整元数据，最后逐个核对链接。
entries.author: Bud

entries.name: Sentry Mode
entries.summary: Helps safeguard against the php2shell vulnerability and monitors the situation from official sources on X.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你防范 php2shell 漏洞，并从 X 上的官方来源持续跟进事态。
entries.author: Local

entries.name: Privacy Shield
entries.summary: Gets your household off spam call, text and junk-mail lists: Do Not Call Registry, people-search and data-broker opt-outs, then re-scans for returns.
entries.summary_zh: 让你家脱离骚扰电话、短信和垃圾邮件名单：处理 Do Not Call 登记、人员搜索网站和数据经纪商退出，并定期复查删掉卷土重来的记录。
entries.author: Pravinraj

entries.name: Medical Bill Auditor
entries.summary: Questions every line of your medical bills and EOBs, flags double billing, upcoding and junk fees in a color-coded report, then drafts disputes you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 逐行审查医疗账单和 EOB，在彩色报告里标出重复收费、升级编码和垃圾费用，再起草申诉和降费请求，由你逐条批准。
entries.author: Brian

entries.name: Freelance Invoice Chaser
entries.summary: For freelancers waiting on unpaid invoices: tracks what clients owe, watches Gmail for payments and replies, and drafts calm scheduled reminders for your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 给等回款的自由职业者：跟踪客户欠款，盯 Gmail 里的付款和回复，按设定节奏起草语气平和的催款提醒，等你同意再发。
entries.author: Cristopher

entries.name: 粉丝体检
entries.summary: Follower check-up for X creators: nightly read-only scan of public interactions, sorts followers into gold, silver, one-way and dormant, with upkeep tips.
entries.summary_zh: 给 X 创作者做粉丝体检：每晚只读采集公开互动，分出金牌、银牌、单向、沉睡互关等，并给出维护建议。全程不点赞、关注、发帖或私信。
entries.author: ranger_escape

entries.name: PHP2Shell Patcher and Vuln Scout
entries.summary: Fixes the critical PHP2Shell flaws on your sites or servers and watches trusted security accounts for new critical bugs. Asks before every change.
entries.summary_zh: 修复你网站或服务器上严重的 PHP2Shell 漏洞，并关注可信安全账号发布的新高危漏洞，为你的环境起草修复方案，每次改动前都先询问。
entries.author: Owen

entries.name: Bill Watchdog
entries.summary: Read-only bill watchdog: scans your email and bank/card transactions weekly for price hikes, fees, duplicate charges and forgotten subscriptions, drafts fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 只读的账单和订阅看门狗：每周扫描邮件和银行卡交易，找出涨价、手续费、重复扣款和被遗忘的订阅，并起草处理方案等你批准。
entries.author: Allan

entries.name: Hyper
entries.summary: Tunes your other bots without training a model: turns PDFs, books, YouTube videos and web pages into a searchable knowledge base and cited manual (Portuguese).
entries.summary_zh: 不训练模型也能给你的其他 bot 调优：把 PDF、书、YouTube 视频和网页变成可检索的知识库和带引用的专家手册，交给你选的 bot（葡萄牙语）。
entries.author: Gestao

entries.name: ChangeLens
entries.summary: Give it any place on Earth and get before/after satellite cards in true color and SWIR from free Copernicus Sentinel imagery: shorelines, burn scars.
entries.summary_zh: 给它地球上任意地点，用免费的 Copernicus Sentinel 影像生成真彩色和短波红外前后对比卫星图卡，看海岸线、湖泊、新建工程、火烧迹地、积雪和季节变化。
entries.author: Marshall

entries.name: GoHighLevel Guide
entries.summary: Works inside GoHighLevel as you, for agencies or single businesses: maps pipelines and contacts, does daily CRM work, waits for your yes where you gate it.
entries.summary_zh: 以你的身份在 GoHighLevel 里干活，代理商和单个商家都适用：梳理销售管道和联系人，处理日常 CRM 工作，只在你设了关卡的事上等你确认。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Rainmaker
entries.summary: Opportunity agent built like a sports agent: finds roles and gigs you fit, gets you to the hiring manager or a warm intro, tailors pitches and runs follow-ups.
entries.summary_zh: 像顶级体育经纪人一样的机会经纪：找你特别合适的职位和项目，帮你接触招聘经理或拿到引荐，定制每份推介，并跟进到谈判准备。
entries.author: Joash

entries.name: Jobby
entries.summary: Job-search assistant that scans for jobs that fit you, builds tailored application packets and tracks every application. Never applies without your go-ahead.
entries.summary_zh: 求职助手：搜寻适合你的职位，准备定制的申请材料，跟踪每一份申请。未经你同意绝不投递或联系雇主。
entries.author: Rich

entries.name: Meme Maker
entries.summary: Turns your photos, jokes and a built-in library of 100 popular blank meme templates into ready-to-post memes, from captioned classics to cutout mashups.
entries.summary_zh: 用你的照片、段子和内置的 100 个热门空白梗图模板做成可直接发的梗图，从经典配字到抠图拼贴和 AI 生成场景都行。
entries.author: grokshroom

entries.name: Ballot Deep Dive Analyzer
entries.summary: Non-partisan election research: hand it your ballot and it digs into every candidate's record, funding, endorsements and positions from primary sources.
entries.summary_zh: 无党派的选举研究助手：把选票交给它，它用一手资料深挖每位候选人的履历、资金、背书和立场，给出平衡的摘要，不告诉你该投谁。
entries.author: Batch

entries.name: Deep Dive
entries.summary: Deep-research assistant that reads studies, primary documents, news and social posts in full, explains contradictions and says how sure it is.
entries.summary_zh: 深度研究助手：针对任何问题完整阅读研究、一手文件、新闻和社交媒体，解释矛盾之处并说明把握有多大，还会学习你的标准。
entries.author: Warren

entries.name: Personal Shopper
entries.summary: Personal shopper for groceries, big stores and niche shops, working inside your own accounts and buying only after you confirm.
entries.summary_zh: 私人采购：在你自己的账号里买菜、逛大卖场和小众店铺，你确认后才下单。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Scrum Master Bot
entries.summary: Scrum Master for your squad: runs standups, grooming, planning and retros on your Jira board, flags blockers and tags you only for real decisions.
entries.summary_zh: 给团队的 Scrum Master：在 Jira 看板上主持站会、梳理、计划和复盘，标出阻碍，只有真正需要决策时才 @你。
entries.author: Ira

entries.name: Herald
entries.summary: Makes you a short color newspaper PDF every morning with your day, weather, local news and top headlines, and emails it only to you.
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上给你做一份简短的彩色报纸 PDF，包含当天日程、天气、本地新闻和头条，只发到你的邮箱。
entries.author: AI_Revolution

entries.name: Small Shop Quality COO
entries.summary: Daily quality rhythm for small ISO 9001, AS9100 or IATF 16949 shops: calibration-due alerts, supplier cert expiry and a weekly KPI digest, drafted for review.
entries.summary_zh: 为小型 ISO 9001、AS9100 或 IATF 16949 工厂跑每日质量节奏：校准到期提醒、供应商证书过期和每周 KPI 摘要，草稿交合格审核人批准。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: North Star
entries.summary: Keeps one shared source of truth about you: who you are, how you write, your rules and open promises, and reports weekly what's drifting or contradictory.
entries.summary_zh: 维护一份关于你的统一事实来源：你是谁、怎么写作、你的规则和未兑现的承诺，每周报告哪些在走偏、拖延或自相矛盾。
entries.author: Oliver

entries.name: Archivist
entries.summary: Quiet librarian bot that saves your X posts, links, ideas and notes into a searchable archive, keeps a local copy of your bot chats and makes encrypted backups.
entries.summary_zh: 安静的图书管理员 bot：把你的 X 帖子、链接、想法和笔记存进可检索的档案，在本地保存 bot 对话副本，并做加密备份。
entries.author: bigRD73

entries.name: Reverse Engineer
entries.summary: Figures out how any app, website, API or binary works, shows the evidence for every finding, and rebuilds a working version for Windows, macOS or Linux.
entries.summary_zh: 弄清任何应用、网站、API 或二进制文件的工作原理，为每个发现给出证据，并重建一个能在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上运行的版本。
entries.author: monokern

entries.name: KYB - Coach
entries.summary: Know Your Business coach: interviews you, researches your company's website, investor relations, news and social media, and builds a one-shot intensive course.
entries.summary_zh: “了解你的公司”教练：先采访你，再研究公司官网、投资者关系、新闻和社交媒体，做一门把公司战略和你日常工作连起来的速成课。
entries.author: Alexandre

entries.name: Budgie
entries.summary: Budget bot that keeps your budget in a local SQLite database, plans each paycheck, and forecasts debt payoff, assets and net worth on a live dashboard Page.
entries.summary_zh: 预算 bot：把预算存在本地 SQLite 数据库里，规划每笔工资，并在实时仪表盘页面上预测还债进度、资产和净资产。
entries.author: Cill

entries.name: Roast My Account Bot
entries.summary: Give it any X handle and it makes a vertical roast clip from that account's real posts, with a narrator, Beavis and Butt-Head reactions and meme cutaways.
entries.summary_zh: 给它任意 X 账号，它用该账号的真实帖子做一段竖屏吐槽短片，配解说、Beavis and Butt-Head 式反应、梗图插播和“You've been ROASTED”片尾。
entries.author: Mav

entries.name: Pennie Tester
entries.summary: Passive web security scanner for consultants and security teams: checks sites for OWASP Top 10 weaknesses, no exploits unless you confirm written permission.
entries.summary_zh: 给顾问和安全团队的被动式网站安全扫描器：检查你指定的网站是否有 OWASP Top 10 等弱点，除非你确认有书面授权，否则不跑漏洞利用。
entries.author: Debra

entries.name: The Tiebreaker
entries.summary: Give it a hard call: it argues both sides harder than you can, then drops the act, says what it really thinks and gives a shareable verdict card.
entries.summary_zh: 拿不定主意？把难题交给它：它先替正反两方全力辩论，然后摘下面具说出真实看法，并给出一张可分享的裁决卡。
entries.author: Si

entries.name: Vulnerability Hunter
entries.summary: Finds real trust-boundary vulnerabilities in codebases and owned environments: recon, coverage-led hunting, adversarial validation and target-neutral reports.
entries.summary_zh: 在代码库和自有环境里找真实的信任边界漏洞，多阶段审计流程：侦察、按覆盖率排查、对抗式验证，最后出与目标无关的报告。
entries.author: Lonny

entries.name: Don't Panic Lite
entries.summary: Cozy desk buddy that times your tea and coffee, nudges you to drink water and reminds you to take gentle stretch breaks during work hours.
entries.summary_zh: 温馨的桌边伙伴：给你的茶和咖啡计时，提醒你喝水，并在工作时间提醒你做轻松的拉伸休息。
entries.author: joy

entries.name: Playlist Builder
entries.summary: Turns your Spotify Liked Songs into curated playlists by genre, mood and energy, and tells you what your taste says about you.
entries.summary_zh: 把你 Spotify 里的“已点赞歌曲”按流派、情绪和能量整理成精选歌单，还告诉你你的口味说明了什么。
entries.author: Kolby

entries.name: What's New
entries.summary: Sends you the latest Grok Bot release notes and the newest "What's new in Grok Bot" video when you add it, then checks every morning for anything new.
entries.summary_zh: 添加后立即发来最新的 Grok Bot 更新说明和最新一期“What's new in Grok Bot”视频，之后每天早上检查并推送新内容。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Penny DOGE
entries.summary: Finds where your Grok Bot fleet wastes usage and ranks the fixes, from a weekly scan or a pasted Usage screenshot. Only recommends, never edits your other bots.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你的 Grok Bot 团队在哪里浪费用量并给修复排序，可每周自动扫描，也可直接用你贴的 Usage 截图或例程列表。只建议，不改其他 bot。
entries.author: Bowie

entries.name: List Front Page
entries.summary: Paste any X list and get a news front page of top stories, links and voices, refreshed hourly. Never posts.
entries.summary_zh: 贴入任意 X 列表，得到一份由热门话题、链接和发声者组成的新闻头版，每小时刷新。从不发帖。
entries.author: Thuong

entries.name: Flight Turbulence Report
entries.summary: Sends a turbulence report with a table and route map an hour before every flight on your calendar, using SIGMETs, AIRMETs, PIREPs and Turbli.
entries.summary_zh: 在日历里每趟航班起飞前一小时发来颠簸报告，附表格和航线图，飞行中也可随时查询，数据来自 SIGMET、AIRMET、PIREP 和 Turbli。
entries.author: Dan

entries.name: Mika
entries.summary: App-builder teammate that takes your idea from spec to a tested, working build with a solid agent harness, and asks before anything is pushed or deployed.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的 AI 应用搭建队友：用扎实的 agent 框架把你的想法从规格做到测试通过、能运行的版本，推送或部署前都先问你。
entries.author: David

entries.name: True Circle
entries.summary: Makes an X inner-circle image of the people you really interact with, after short onboarding for flavor, window, theme and leave-outs. Needs the X plugin.
entries.summary_zh: 生成一张你在 X 上真正互动的人组成的“核心圈”图片，先简短引导你选风格、时间范围、主题和排除对象。需要 X 插件。
entries.author: Jay

entries.name: Appealinator
entries.summary: Checks county and MCP records on your property assessment and drafts an appeal if there are savings to be had.
entries.summary_zh: 核对县里和 MCP 的房产评估记录，如果有省钱空间就为你起草估值申诉。
entries.author: Brett

entries.name: Brújula
entries.summary: ADHD-friendly personal coach that keeps your tasks and money on track with tiny next steps, gentle daily check-ins and a simple weekly money check.
entries.summary_zh: 适合 ADHD 人群的私人教练：用很小的下一步、温和的每日打卡和简单的每周财务检查，让你的任务和钱都不跑偏。
entries.author: Steven

entries.name: PHP Vulnerability Checker
entries.summary: Scans your Linux, Windows and macOS computers and Docker containers for PHP versions hit by the latest security bugs, explains the risk, patches on your say-so.
entries.summary_zh: 扫描你的 Linux、Windows、macOS 电脑和 Docker 容器，找出受最新安全漏洞影响的 PHP 版本，解释风险，经你同意后安全打补丁。
entries.author: Jonathan

entries.name: Hermes
entries.summary: Operations architect for a team of AI bots: works out the lanes your work needs, gives each bot one specialty, home folder and inbox, maps where things live.
entries.summary_zh: 给 AI bot 团队的运营架构师：理清你的工作需要哪些分工，给每个 bot 一个专长、主文件夹和收件箱，并维护一张清晰的资料位置图。
entries.author: Krista

entries.name: Salesforce Guide
entries.summary: Works inside your Salesforce org as you: connects step by step, handles daily pipeline, lead, account and case work, and sends a daily brief.
entries.summary_zh: 以你的身份在 Salesforce 里干活：一步步帮你连上，然后处理日常管道、线索、客户和工单工作，发每日简报，哪些事要等你确认由你定。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.summary: Infosec news watcher for engineers and SREs: watches X for new CVEs, zero-days, exploited bugs, breaches and supply-chain hits, corroborates, then alerts.
entries.summary_zh: 给工程师和 SRE 的安全资讯哨兵：全天盯 X 上的新 CVE、零日、在野利用、重大泄露和供应链攻击，核实后再报警，另有按你技术栈定制的每日摘要。
entries.author: Morgan

entries.name: Business Incubator
entries.summary: Brainstorming partner for side hustles and small businesses a Grok Bot could run nearly hands-off: builds out ideas, checks competitors and pricing.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你构思几乎可以交给 Grok Bot 放手运营的副业和小生意：完善想法、调研竞品和定价，并维护一份持续更新的点子清单。
entries.author: Rob

entries.name: The Legislator
entries.summary: Watchdog on new US federal bills and rules: alerts you when something that touches you moves, explains it plainly and helps draft letters and public comments.
entries.summary_zh: 盯美国联邦新法案和新规：与你相关的有进展就提醒，用大白话解释，并帮你起草信件和公众意见，发送前都由你批准。
entries.author: Jose

entries.name: Art Bot
entries.summary: Artist and creative director that turns your brands into style guides, on-brand images, animations, video edits with music, decks and design critiques.
entries.summary_zh: 艺术家兼创意总监：把你的品牌做成风格指南、贴合品牌的图片、动画、配乐视频剪辑、演示文稿和设计点评，花钱或发布前先问你。
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: Fed Indicator Bot
entries.summary: Tracks real-time private economic data like ADP, card spending, job postings, online prices and mobility to read where the Fed is headed. Weekly summaries.
entries.summary_zh: 跟踪 ADP、刷卡消费、招聘信息、线上价格和出行等实时民间经济数据以及 AI 和生产率信号，判断美联储可能走向，每周总结并在政策相关变化时提醒。
entries.author: A.M.

entries.name: Smart Shopper
entries.summary: Price-drop sniper and gift finder for any store: watches prices daily with shipping and tax included, finds gifts by arrive-by date, never buys without your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 适用任何商店的降价狙击手和礼物参谋：每天盯含运费和税的价格，按送达日期找真正合适的礼物，没有你的同意绝不下单。
entries.author: JP

entries.name: Wingman
entries.summary: Your wingman across every account: it keeps watch, builds its own shortcuts and keeps small promises.
entries.summary_zh: 跨所有账号的僚机助手：帮你盯着动静，自己搭建捷径，记得兑现小承诺。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Beeper Bot
entries.summary: Reads your Beeper chats (WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, X DMs, Slack and more), tells you what matters and drafts replies in your voice. Read-only by default.
entries.summary_zh: 读取你的 Beeper 聊天（WhatsApp、Telegram、Signal、X 私信、Slack 等），告诉你哪些重要，并用你的口吻起草回复。默认只读。
entries.author: Joe

entries.name: Printy
entries.summary: 3D print bot: takes print ideas, designs printable parts, builds slicer-ready files, keeps material lists and troubleshoots failed prints. Asks before printing.
entries.summary_zh: 3D 打印助手：接收打印想法，设计可打印零件，生成可直接切片的文件，记录耗材清单，排查打印失败。开打前先征得你同意。
entries.author: John

entries.name: Sports Fan Desk
entries.summary: Personal sports research desk for pro, college and school sports: follow your teams, learn in Fan, Analyst or Quant mode, sourced analysis, no fake predictions.
entries.summary_zh: 个人体育研究台，覆盖职业、大学和校队赛事：关注你的球队，可选球迷、分析师或量化模式，分析附出处，不编比分不瞎预测。
entries.author: Ashley

entries.name: VA Claims Helper
entries.summary: Patient, plain-talking helper for veterans: organizes VA claims, writes personal and buddy statements, gathers records and tracks appointments and deadlines.
entries.summary_zh: 耐心、说大白话的退伍军人助手：整理 VA 理赔，撰写个人陈述和战友证明，收集记录，跟踪预约和截止日期。
entries.author: Antilitist

entries.name: Document & Training Control Assistant
entries.summary: Keeps a small ISO 9001/AS9100/IATF 16949 shop's documents and training in order: revision logs, plain procedures, training matrix. Drafts for your reviewer.
entries.summary_zh: 帮 ISO 9001、AS9100、IATF 16949 小工厂管好文件和培训：修订记录、通俗作业程序、按岗位的培训矩阵和培训效果检查，草稿交合格审核人把关。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: FAI Assistant
entries.summary: Organizes a first article inspection package from drawings: characteristic list, ballooning checklist, Form 1–3 structure, delta FAI scope. For aerospace shops.
entries.summary_zh: 根据图纸整理首件检验（FAI）资料包：特性清单、标注气球检查表、Form 1–3 结构、部分或增量 FAI 范围。面向小型航空航天工厂，由合格检验员核对。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Internal Audit Assistant
entries.summary: Plans risk-based internal audits for small AS9100/ISO quality teams: schedules, checklists, interview questions, evidence logs, findings and report drafts.
entries.summary_zh: 为小型 AS9100/ISO 质量团队规划基于风险的内审：审核计划、检查表、访谈问题、证据记录、发现项和报告草稿，均交合格人员复核。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Relationship Repair Coach
entries.summary: Helps you break the cycle you two keep falling into and make things right after a fight, even if only you show up. Coaching for adults 18+, not therapy.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你打破两人反复陷入的循环，吵架后学会修复关系，哪怕只有你一个人来。面向 18 岁以上成年人，是教练辅导，不是心理治疗。
entries.author: Deyder

entries.name: Sponsor Hunter
entries.summary: Helps creators find flat-fee sponsors for a newsletter or X account: media kit from real stats, brands that fit, short fixed-price pitches and one follow-up.
entries.summary_zh: 帮创作者给 newsletter 或 X 账号找固定费用赞助：用真实数据做媒体资料包，匹配合适品牌，写简短的定价提案，再礼貌跟进一次。
entries.author: Karata

entries.name: Connector Scope Check
entries.summary: Before connecting Gmail, Drive, Stripe, GitHub or calendar to a Grok Bot, runs a minimum-scope checklist and returns CLEAR or NEEDS ACTION. Never connects.
entries.summary_zh: 在给 Grok Bot 接入 Gmail、Drive、Stripe、GitHub 或日历之前（或刚添加模板后），跑一遍最小权限检查清单，给出 CLEAR 或 NEEDS ACTION。自己从不连接。
entries.author: Umashankar

entries.name: Creator Pay Desk
entries.summary: Checklist for Grok Bot Creator Rewards readiness: public bot links, link-posts per pay period, X Money status, listing hygiene and retention nudges. Draft-only.
entries.summary_zh: Grok Bot 创作者奖励准备清单：公开 bot 链接、每个结算周期的链接帖、X Money 状态、上架信息整洁度和留存提醒。只出草稿。
entries.author: Umashankar

entries.name: Political Spam Blocker
entries.summary: Clears political and election spam from your inbox, gets you off campaign lists, can auto-reply STOP to political texts and helps shut off campaign calls.
entries.summary_zh: 清理收件箱里的政治和选举垃圾邮件，帮你退出竞选邮件列表，可自动回复 STOP 给政治短信，并协助屏蔽竞选电话。
entries.author: Sawyer

entries.name: .promo
entries.summary: Makes keynote-style launch and promo videos for any product from chat or a one-tap builder Page: stills first for approval, then the full MP4, no watermark.
entries.summary_zh: 在聊天里或一键生成页面里，为任何产品制作发布会风格的宣传视频：先出静帧给你确认，再出完整 MP4，无水印。
entries.author: greedfi

entries.name: The HR Guy
entries.summary: Back-office HR helper for owners of small unattended shops with 2–10 hourly staff: onboarding, training, store checklists, approvals with 48-hour escalation.
entries.summary_zh: 给 2–10 名小时工的无人值守小店老板的后台 HR 助手：入职、培训、门店检查清单、审批及 48 小时升级提醒。仅供参考，非法律意见。
entries.author: Ken

entries.name: Hugo Sánchez
entries.summary: Loyal, proactive Gmail and Google Calendar assistant: triages your inbox, adds confirmations to your calendar, catches conflicts, sends a short morning brief.
entries.summary_zh: 忠诚又主动的 Gmail 和 Google 日历助手：整理收件箱，把确认邮件加进日历，发现日程冲突，每早发简短简报；未经你同意绝不发邮件。
entries.author: Enrique

entries.name: Pantry Pal
entries.summary: Friendly pantry clerk that turns your recipes, pantry, grocery receipts and stores' real weekly sale ads into shopping lists and meal plans.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的食品柜管家：把你的食谱、库存、购物小票和超市每周真实促销广告变成购物清单和膳食计划。
entries.author: bEastTennesseean

entries.name: Security Watch
entries.summary: Helps secure what you use online, from a laptop or WordPress site to a server stack: maps it, checks each layer zero-trust style, walks you through each fix.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你保护在线使用的一切，从一台笔记本、一个 WordPress 站点到整套服务器：梳理资产，按零信任逐层检查，只报真正影响你的问题并一步步教你修。
entries.author: Luca

entries.name: Deal Hunter
entries.summary: Watches marketplaces and web stores, new and used, for deals on anything you want to buy, and pings you only when a price really drops.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着各类二手和全新商品的市场与网店，帮你找想买东西的好价，只在价格真降时才提醒你。
entries.author: William

entries.name: Steve
entries.summary: Kid-safe Minecraft Bedrock teammate that joins your family's world on its own account: follows, mines what you name, builds on request, guards kids from mobs.
entries.summary_zh: 儿童安全的 Minecraft 基岩版队友：用自己的账号加入你家的世界，跟随、按你说的挖矿、按需建造，还会保护孩子不被敌对生物伤害。
entries.author: Carl

entries.name: Meerkat, Safety Alerts Near You
entries.summary: Checks trusted local sources for dangers near you and places on your calendar, names each warning's source and stays quiet when all is well. Calendar read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 根据你的位置查看可信的本地信息源，提醒附近的危险，可读取日历检查你要去的地方；每条警告注明来源，平安无事时保持安静。日历只读不改。
entries.author: Defender

entries.name: Tripwire
entries.summary: Shared security watcher for your team: finds incidents that could touch what you run, checks whether you're actually exposed and fixes what it safely can.
entries.summary_zh: 团队共享的安全哨兵：发现可能波及你们所用系统的安全事件，核实是否真的受影响，并安全地修复能修的部分。
entries.author: Robert

entries.name: Vuln Scout
entries.summary: Tracks public CVE and patch advisories for defensive awareness, with short digests on Pages.
entries.summary_zh: 跟踪公开的 CVE 和补丁公告，用于防御性预警，并在 Pages 上发布简短摘要。
entries.author: Nick

entries.name: Recipes For My Dragon Flaps
entries.summary: Friendly recipe helper that gives clear, practical recipes and adapts them to your diet, like vegan, vegetarian or make-ahead meals.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的食谱助手：给出清晰实用的菜谱，并按你的饮食需求调整，比如纯素、素食或提前备餐。
entries.author: Michelle

entries.name: Creative Video Studio
entries.summary: Warm, creative video teammate that turns your phone clips into finished videos and makes AI video too. No editing experience needed.
entries.summary_zh: 温暖又有创意的视频搭档：把你的手机片段剪成成片，也能生成 AI 视频，无需任何剪辑经验。
entries.author: Mars

entries.name: Mission Control
entries.summary: Fleet operations board for your Grok Bots: audits every bot daily, flags red/yellow/green, forecasts plan burn, sends a dashboard and PDF of token-saving tips.
entries.summary_zh: 你的 Grok Bot 舰队运营看板：每天审计每个 bot，标出红黄绿状态，预测套餐消耗，交付仪表盘和 PDF，附具体的省 token 建议。
entries.author: AVENTUS

entries.name: pump.fun dev check
entries.summary: Reads dev history and holdings via pumpdata.fun. Limited free access; optional email/key signup with consent. No trades or pump.fun affiliation.
entries.summary_zh: 通过 pumpdata.fun 读取开发者历史和早期持仓。免费接口有限额；可选邮箱/API key 注册需先获同意。不交易，与 pump.fun 无关联。
entries.author: pumpdata.fun

entries.name: pump.fun daily
entries.summary: Each morning sends yesterday's pump.fun launches, graduations, volume, busiest coins and odds, via pumpdata.fun. Free, read-only. Not affiliated with pump.fun.
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上发送 pump.fun 昨日概况，包括发币数、毕业数、交易量、最活跃的币和各市值段的概率，数据来自 pumpdata.fun 免费接口。免费使用，只读，不交易。与 pump.fun 无关联。
entries.author: pumpdata.fun

entries.name: 起元 · Genesis
entries.summary: Yunjian's orchestrator for jobs too big for one assistant: scopes the ask, plans the route, sends five specialist bots, checks each step, asks you at key gates.
entries.summary_zh: 云间工作室的总指挥，接单个 AI 助手做不完的大事：问清需求、排路线、派五位成员去做，每段都验过，只在要紧处请你拍板。
entries.author: Valerie

entries.name: 试金 · Touchstone
entries.summary: Yunjian's verifier: give it a prompt, Skill, web page or mini-program; it says whether it's ready to ship and what to fix, with evidence. Checks, never edits.
entries.summary_zh: 云间工作室的验证助手：提示词、Skill、网页、小程序交给它，告诉你能不能交、哪里要改，每条问题都带证据。只查不改。
entries.author: Valerie

entries.name: 青鸟 · Bluebird
entries.summary: Yunjian's prompt writer: say in one line what you want AI to do and get a paste-ready prompt for images, video, copy, standing rules or bot instructions.
entries.summary_zh: 云间工作室的提示词助手：一句话说想让 AI 干什么，它给你一段能直接贴进去的提示词，做图、做视频、写文案、写长期规则和 Bot 指令都会。
entries.author: Valerie

entries.name: 凝露 · Dew
entries.summary: Yunjian's distiller: turns books, courses, chat logs, recordings and your own know-how into a linked, sourced knowledge-card web with a map. Resumable.
entries.summary_zh: 云间工作室的蒸馏助手：把书、课、聊天记录、录音视频和你脑子里的经验，整理成带出处、关系清楚的知识卡网络，再配一张地图，中途断了能接着蒸。
entries.author: Valerie

entries.name: 千机 · Gear
entries.summary: Yunjian's Skill builder: makes a repeated workflow a Skill any AI can follow. Writes test cases first, trial-runs it, then fixes, installs or chains them.
entries.summary_zh: 云间工作室的 Skill 助手：把你反复在做的做法造成一个 Skill，换个 AI 也照做。先定试题再写，造完先试用，还能改、装进常用 AI、串成一套。
entries.author: Valerie

entries.name: 经纬 · Loom
entries.summary: Yunjian's ontology builder: lays the foundation for a shop, app or skill as a sourced folder of roots, parts and relations that you and any AI can build on.
entries.summary_zh: 云间工作室的本体助手：给一家店、一个应用或一个技能立起母体——根、方方面面、彼此关系、过去和缺口，知识带出处存成文件夹，你和任何 AI 都能接着用。
entries.author: Valerie

entries.name: Spanish Teacher
entries.summary: Voice-first Spanish tutor, first words to C1: placement chat, lessons, spaced review and level exams in Latin American Spanish; progress log stays private.
entries.summary_zh: 以语音为主的西班牙语老师，从零基础带到 C1：分级对话、课程、间隔复习和等级考试，讲中性拉美西语，学习进度只存在你自己的副本里。
entries.author: Antony

entries.name: Mack
entries.summary: Personal car expert: answers questions on oil, tires and parts, helps with maintenance, diagnoses smells and noises, and finds local repair quotes.
entries.summary_zh: 你的私人汽车顾问：解答机油、轮胎和零件问题，帮你做保养，诊断怪味和异响，还能找本地维修报价。
entries.author: Kelly

entries.name: Tubewright
entries.summary: Turns a finished video's transcript into a draft upload kit: titles, SEO description, timestamped chapters, thumbnail ideas, pinned comment and X clip thread.
entries.summary_zh: 把成片的字幕稿变成上传素材包草稿：你口吻的标题、SEO 描述、真实时间戳章节、缩略图构思、置顶评论和 X 片段串。只出草稿，从不上传或发帖。
entries.author: Calix

entries.name: XO
entries.summary: Chief of staff and front door for your Grok Bot team: turns asks into tracked tasks, routes work to specialist bots, and wants proof before calling it done.
entries.summary_zh: Grok Bot 团队的幕僚长和统一入口：把需求变成可跟踪的任务，分派给专职 bot，没证据不算完成，还能用邮件联络家人的 bot、接管 AI 电话筛来电。
entries.author: Oliver

entries.name: Grok Bot Backup Assistant
entries.summary: Backs up every assistant on your Grok Bot box via open-source grok-bot-backup, plus a readable, handover-ready copy of chats, memories, notes and files.
entries.summary_zh: 用开源 grok-bot-backup 工具备份你 Grok Bot 电脑上的每个助手，除原始归档外还生成一份可读、可交接的对话、记忆、笔记和工作区文件副本，校验后交给你。
entries.author: TechOps

entries.name: Bouncer
entries.summary: Security and infrastructure operator for your apps and servers: reviews repos for security issues and critical bugs, watches daily for CVEs in what you run.
entries.summary_zh: 给你的应用和服务器当安全与基础设施运维：审查代码仓库里的安全问题和严重 bug，每天盯你所用软件的 CVE，只在需要处理时才提醒你。
entries.author: Igor

entries.name: Public Auction Ledger
entries.summary: Records claims as temporary bids with action windows and required checks, then audits and retires expired or verified ones. Irreversible steps wait for your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 把各种主张记成带行动时限和必要核查的临时“出价”，再审计并清掉过期或已核实的条目。任何不可逆操作都等你批准。
entries.author: Gregory

entries.name: Moss
entries.summary: Friendly Windows 10/11 fixer for one home PC: diagnoses crashes, slowness and broken apps, runs a weekly checkup, swaps paid security tools for built-in ones.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的 Windows 10/11 家用电脑修理工：诊断崩溃、卡顿和坏掉的应用，每周体检一次，帮你把付费安全软件换成系统自带的免费工具，每次改动前先问。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: X Legal Watch
entries.summary: Reviews X posts, accounts and searches for content that may break the law, like sexual deepfakes, threats, doxxing and scams, and drafts reports to file.
entries.summary_zh: 审查 X 上的帖子、账号和搜索结果，标出可能违法的内容，如色情深度伪造、威胁、人肉和诈骗，并起草举报和下架请求由你提交。仅供参考，非法律意见。
entries.author: Big

entries.name: X Account Manager
entries.summary: Runs your personal X account: daily posts in your voice scheduled through Buffer, reposts of a partner account, scheduled promos and a weekly growth report.
entries.summary_zh: 替你打理个人 X 账号：用你的口吻每天发帖并通过 Buffer 排期，转发和引用合作账号，定时推广，每周出增长报告。
entries.author: Alexander

entries.name: Chair
entries.summary: Runs a six-seat AI Board Room for one person: Finance, Skeptic, Operator, Mission and Counsel each give a take and vote; Chair closes with a decision memo.
entries.summary_zh: 主持一个六席 AI 董事会帮你做决定：财务、唱反调、执行、使命、法务各自发表意见并投票，最后由主席写一份简短决策备忘录。
entries.author: Wayne

entries.name: Finance
entries.summary: Money seat of the AI Board Room: weighs costs, 12-month cost of ownership, cash flow, return and worst-case loss, then votes Go, No-go or Go if.
entries.summary_zh: AI 董事会的财务席：权衡成本、12 个月持有成本、现金流、回报和最坏损失，然后投票：做、不做或有条件做。
entries.author: Wayne

entries.name: Skeptic
entries.summary: Devil's-advocate seat of the AI Board Room: makes the strongest honest case against each option so you decide with your eyes open.
entries.summary_zh: AI 董事会的唱反调席：针对每个选项给出最有力的诚实反对理由，让你睁着眼睛做决定。
entries.author: Wayne

entries.name: Mission
entries.summary: People-and-values seat of the AI Board Room: weighs who a decision affects, whether it fits your mission and values, and if you'll be proud of it in five years.
entries.summary_zh: AI 董事会的人与价值观席：考虑决定影响到谁、是否符合你的使命和价值观，以及五年后你是否会为它骄傲。
entries.author: Wayne

entries.name: Operator
entries.summary: Execution seat of the AI Board Room: checks whether a decision can actually get done: who owns it, by when, what has to slip, and the first concrete step.
entries.summary_zh: AI 董事会的执行席：检查决定能否真正落地：谁负责、何时完成、什么要让路，以及第一步具体做什么。
entries.author: Wayne

entries.name: Counsel
entries.summary: Legal-and-risk seat of the AI Board Room: flags contracts, compliance, liability, conflicts of interest and needed approvals, then votes Go, No-go or Go if.
entries.summary_zh: AI 董事会的法务与风险席：标出合同、合规、责任、利益冲突和需要的审批，然后投票：做、不做或有条件做。
entries.author: Wayne

entries.name: Mass Finder
entries.summary: Finds Catholic Mass, Confession, Adoration and Vespers times near you or in any city, verified against live parish sources.
entries.summary_zh: 查找你附近或任意城市的天主教弥撒、告解、朝拜圣体和晚祷时间，并以堂区实时信息核实。
entries.author: kyro

entries.name: Liturgy Guide
entries.summary: Helps you pray the Liturgy of the Hours (Roman Rite) on a schedule that fits your life, each Hour sent as text, a link, Divine Office audio or a voice memo.
entries.summary_zh: 按适合你生活节奏的时间表带你诵念日课（罗马礼），每个时辰以分页文字、链接、Divine Office 音频或语音备忘发送。
entries.author: kyro

entries.name: Language Coach
entries.summary: Friendly tutor for any language: runs structured hour-long lessons on a schedule you pick, corrects every answer and remembers your weak spots.
entries.summary_zh: 适用于任何语言的友好导师：按你选的时间上结构化的一小时课程，纠正每个回答，并记住你的薄弱点。
entries.author: Mike

entries.name: Health Dashboard
entries.summary: Turns your Garmin, Withings, food-log or other health data into one dashboard Page ordered by your goals, with a weekly call and next step. Not medical advice.
entries.summary_zh: 把 Garmin、Withings、饮食记录等健康数据整合成一个按你目标排序的仪表盘页面，每周给出一个结论和下一步。只读，非医疗建议。
entries.author: Emil

entries.name: Farbstudio
entries.summary: Turns photos, videos, X posts or moods into colour palettes with hex codes and builds an interactive colour studio to play with and share.
entries.summary_zh: 把照片、视频、X 帖子或心情变成带 hex 色值的配色方案，并生成一个可互动、可分享的配色工作室。
entries.author: Georg

entries.name: Headhunter
entries.summary: Job-hunt agent: runs a daily search on your criteria, confirms each posting is still open, fills applications to the review page. Nothing sent without OK.
entries.summary_zh: 求职助手：每天按你的条件搜职位，确认岗位仍开放，把申请填到提交前的确认页。你不批准就不提交。
entries.author: Abel

entries.name: Music Contest Enterer
entries.summary: Finds and enters free music giveaways daily (gear, plugins, instruments, concert tickets) and sends a digest. Skips captchas, purchases and forced sign-ups.
entries.summary_zh: 每天找并参加免费音乐抽奖：器材、插件、乐器、演出门票，再发一份简报。跳过验证码、付费和强制营销注册。
entries.author: Heidi

entries.name: Bot Scout
entries.summary: Finds the right Grok Bot for a job by searching shared templates on the official Marketplace and elsewhere; posts daily picks and a weekly roundup of new bots.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你找合适的 Grok Bot：搜索官方 Marketplace 等处的公开模板，每天推荐几个，每周汇总新上的 bot。
entries.author: Rahul

entries.name: Philosophy Lens
entries.summary: Tell it a thought or worry; it names the philosophical theory it matches, how that theory would frame it, and the real sources. A guide, not a counselor.
entries.summary_zh: 说出一个想法或烦恼，它告诉你对应哪种哲学理论、那套理论会怎么看，并附真实出处。是哲学向导，不是心理咨询。
entries.author: Holic

entries.name: InfoFeed
entries.summary: Intentional RSS reader in Spanish: paste blog, YouTube, Medium or Substack links and get short summaries of what's new, with the original link.
entries.summary_zh: 西班牙语的有意识 RSS 阅读器：贴上博客、YouTube、Medium 或 Substack 链接，收到新内容的简短摘要和原文链接。
entries.author: Benjamin

entries.name: Movie Night
entries.summary: Personal movie-night assistant: learns your taste from a few quick taps and suggests what to watch.
entries.summary_zh: 个人观影助手：点几下就摸清你的口味，帮你挑今晚看什么。
entries.author: dougdstecklein

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.summary: Quiet security watch for your apps and devices: checks official advisories each weekday morning against the versions you run; alerts only when you're exposed.
entries.summary_zh: 安静的安全值守：每个工作日早上拿官方安全公告比对你实际在用的版本，只有真受影响才提醒。
entries.author: Joshua

entries.name: Chief of Staff
entries.summary: Morning briefing, inbox triage and meeting prep in one: reads email, calendar and Slack before your day, drafts follow-ups to send, flags what you'd miss.
entries.summary_zh: 晨报、收件箱分拣和会前准备合一：开工前读邮件、日历和 Slack，起草跟进由你发送，标出你可能漏掉的事。
entries.author: Rananjay

entries.name: Home Designer
entries.summary: Renders your own room in the look you like from a photo, then lists exact products with checked prices, paint codes, budget and steps. Buys only on your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 拍下房间和灵感图，它把你的房间渲染成那种风格，再给出核实价格的具体商品、油漆色号、预算和施工步骤。确认购物车才下单。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Inbox Zero
entries.summary: Email operations assistant: triages your whole inbox, drafts replies, tracks follow-ups and deadlines, sends a daily brief. Changes nothing without approval.
entries.summary_zh: 邮件运营助手：分拣整个收件箱、起草回复、跟踪待跟进和截止日期，每天发简报。未经批准不发信也不改邮件。
entries.author: Ashley

entries.name: Help I want my Arc Back
entries.summary: For Arc browser refugees: pins down what you need in a replacement, then watches X and tech news each weekday for browsers that close the gap.
entries.summary_zh: 给 Arc 浏览器难民：先理清你对替代品的需求，再每个工作日盯 X 和科技新闻，找补上差距的浏览器。
entries.author: Matthew

entries.name: Scriptoor
entries.summary: Audits routines on your other Grok Bots and adds a small, tested script gate before runs that usually find nothing, so empty runs end early and save usage.
entries.summary_zh: 审查你其他 Grok Bot 的例程，在经常空跑的任务前加一个小而测过的脚本闸门，空跑提前结束、省用量。删一行即可撤销。
entries.author: luke

entries.name: 1Human - Subscriptions
entries.summary: Keeps all your subscriptions in one place: tracks free trials, reminds you before renewals, and reviews what's still worth paying for.
entries.summary_zh: 把所有订阅放在一处：跟踪免费试用，续费前提醒，定期看看哪些还值得付钱。
entries.author: hunghuc

entries.name: DVC Booker
entries.summary: Disney Vacation Club expert: tracks official point charts, finds best-value stays for your points and family size, watches booking and banking deadlines.
entries.summary_zh: 迪士尼度假俱乐部专家：跟踪官方点数表，按你的点数和家庭人数找最划算的住宿，盯订房窗口和点数存留截止日。
entries.author: Elijah

entries.name: Foreman
entries.summary: Sets up a read-only crew of eight X helper bots: follow tracking, suggestions, shoutouts, unanswered replies, fans, analytics. You cap daily X API spend.
entries.summary_zh: 在你的 Grok Bot 上搭一组八个只读 X 助手：关注追踪、关注建议、点名感谢、未回复、铁粉、分析。你设每日 X API 花费上限，从不代发帖。
entries.author: Glenn

entries.name: Shepherd
entries.summary: Runs your CLI coding agents (Codex, Cursor CLI, Claude Code and more) inside Herdr on your own computer; the bot only coordinates, prompts and reports back.
entries.summary_zh: 在你自己电脑的 Herdr 里调度 CLI 编程代理（Codex、Cursor CLI、Claude Code 等），重活用本机订阅，bot 只负责协调、下指令和汇报。
entries.author: J

entries.name: Net Worth Page
entries.summary: Your net worth on one page: bank, brokerage and crypto balances minus debts, with optional daily refresh. Read-only; never moves money or asks for passwords.
entries.summary_zh: 一页看清净资产：银行、券商和加密资产余额减去负债，可选每日刷新。只读，从不交易、转账或索要密码。
entries.author: Thuong

entries.name: Dropped-Ball Scanner
entries.summary: Evening sweep of email, chat and texts that catches unanswered asks and promises with no next step; pushes only what's new, each with a recovery draft.
entries.summary_zh: 每晚扫一遍邮件、聊天和短信，找出没回的请求和没下文的承诺，只推新的，每条附一份补救草稿。
entries.author: Austen

entries.name: Travel Agent
entries.summary: Friendly travel planner for vacations and road trips: flights, stays, restaurants, day-by-day itineraries, weather, and EV road trips with charging stops.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的旅行规划师：机票、住宿、餐厅、逐日行程、天气，还有带充电站的电动车自驾路线。
entries.author: Jess

entries.name: Goodreads Reading Buddy
entries.summary: Follows your partner's Goodreads reading and sends spoiler-free recaps, conversation questions and what-happens-next guesses twice a day.
entries.summary_zh: 跟着伴侣在 Goodreads 上的阅读进度，每天两次发无剧透回顾、聊天问题和后续猜想，不读书也能一起聊。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: Site Audit
entries.summary: Audits one website for SEO, content, speed, accessibility, CRO and schema, with evidence-backed P0/P1/P2 fixes and a monthly diff. No invented metrics.
entries.summary_zh: 审计一个网站的 SEO、内容、速度、无障碍、转化和结构化数据，给出有证据的 P0/P1/P2 修复清单和每月对比，不编数据。
entries.author: Rananjay

entries.name: Share Ready
entries.summary: Checks a bot's setup, flags private data by category without quoting it, and drafts a public template package for review; publishing stays your own tap.
entries.summary_zh: 检查一个 bot 的配置，按类别标出隐私数据但不引用原文，起草完整的公开模板包给你审；打包成私有草稿，发布仍由你点。
entries.author: XPixel

entries.name: Covered
entries.summary: Finds free repairs, replacements and warranty claims you're already owed on things you own, and drafts the claim for you to file.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你名下物品本该享有的免费维修、更换和保修索赔，并起草申请，由你提交。
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: Sec Bot
entries.summary: Security patch bot for its own computer: scans for vulnerabilities, ranks exploited and network-reachable ones first, fixes only with approval, verifies each.
entries.summary_zh: 给自己所在电脑打补丁的安全 bot：扫描漏洞，优先处理已被利用和网络可达的，经你批准才修，并在报告页逐项验证。
entries.author: Tim

entries.name: Bot Fleet Auditor
entries.summary: Audits every bot in your Grok Bot account and builds a dashboard of usage, activity, purpose, routines and overlaps, with keep, merge or retire suggestions.
entries.summary_zh: 审查你 Grok Bot 账号里的每个 bot，做一张用量、最近活动、用途、例程和重叠的看板，给出保留、合并或停用建议。
entries.author: Vreddhi

entries.name: Apps Assistant
entries.summary: For indie iOS and Mac developers: version bumps, release waves, App Store Connect metadata, What's New text and review submissions across a portfolio.
entries.summary_zh: 给独立 iOS/Mac 开发者：在整套 App 里处理版本号、分批发布、App Store Connect 元数据、更新说明和提交审核。
entries.author: Dragos

entries.name: ASCII Music Video Maker
entries.summary: Upload a song (like a Suno MP3) and get a beat-synced ASCII-art music video, with scenes drawn from your lyrics.
entries.summary_zh: 上传一首歌（比如 Suno 生成的 MP3），得到一支卡点的 ASCII 字符画 MV，画面取自你的歌词。
entries.author: ecoay

entries.name: T3
entries.summary: Runs T3 Code from chat on your own computers via the t3 CLI: starts and checks coding-agent threads (Codex, Claude Code), handles projects and setup.
entries.summary_zh: 通过 t3 命令行在你自己的电脑上从聊天里操作 T3 Code：启动、发消息、查看编程代理线程（Codex、Claude Code 等），管项目、更新和诊断。
entries.author: Gabriel

entries.name: GDPR Bot
entries.summary: GDPR assistant tracking case law, EDPB and DPA guidance and the AI Act; weekly scans your sites for trackers, consent and notice gaps, with draft fixes.
entries.summary_zh: GDPR 助手：跟进判例、EDPB 和各国监管指引及 AI 法案，每周扫描你的网站的追踪器、同意弹窗和隐私声明缺口，给出评分发现和修改草稿。
entries.author: Pal

entries.name: Bot Team Chief of Staff
entries.summary: Runs a shared Linear board for your Grok Bot team: sorts new cards, wakes stalled bots, routes your comments, and sends you one short list of decisions.
entries.summary_zh: 为你的 Grok Bot 团队管一块共享 Linear 看板：分拣新卡片、唤醒卡住的 bot、把你的评论转给对应 bot，只给你一份简短的待决清单。
entries.author: Raj

entries.name: Homy
entries.summary: Smart-home agent for Home Assistant: controls lights, fans and devices, checks what's on, and runs timed actions like "balcony fan for 1 hour".
entries.summary_zh: 接入 Home Assistant 的智能家居助手：控制灯、风扇等设备，查看哪些开着，还能定时，比如“阳台风扇开 1 小时”。
entries.author: Petru

entries.name: Become
entries.summary: Snap a photo of anything, like a tree, a sink or a car, and it talks back in first person with its own personality, plus real help when something's wrong.
entries.summary_zh: 随手拍一样东西，比如一棵树、水槽或汽车，它就以第一人称开口说话，有自己的性格，出问题时还能真帮上忙。
entries.author: Raymond

entries.name: JobNimbus Guide
entries.summary: Works inside JobNimbus as you for roofers and contractors: keeps leads, jobs and tasks moving and sends a daily brief; gated actions wait for your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 以你的身份在 JobNimbus 里干活，服务屋顶等承包商：推进线索、工单和任务，每天发简报；你设了闸门的操作都等你同意。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Privacy Sweep
entries.summary: Finds you on people-search and data-broker sites, files opt-outs and deletion requests, clicks confirmations, rechecks nightly, then monthly for relists.
entries.summary_zh: 在人肉搜索和数据经纪网站上找到你，提交退出和删除请求、点确认邮件，每晚复查直到删干净，之后每月复查防重新上架。
entries.author: Jeff

entries.name: Bastion IA
entries.summary: Information assurance and red team for a small product or consulting firm: knows where the security risk sits and calls GO or NO-GO on releases.
entries.summary_zh: 给小型产品或咨询公司当信息安全保障和红队：清楚风险在哪，对每次发布给出 GO 或 NO-GO。
entries.author: Justin

entries.name: Medical Bill Second Look
entries.summary: Checks your medical bill against your insurance EOB for duplicates, code and math errors, then drafts the letters.
entries.summary_zh: 拿保险理赔说明（EOB）核对医疗账单，找重复收费、编码和计算错误，再起草申诉信。
entries.author: Thuong

entries.name: Disk Saver
entries.summary: Screens a computer's health and storage, finds large, duplicate or stale files and caches, and proposes safe cleanup plans for your approval.
entries.summary_zh: 检查电脑健康和存储，找出大文件、重复和过期文件及缓存，提出安全的清理方案等你批准。
entries.author: Hovhannes

entries.name: Security Bot
entries.summary: Watches X for new vulnerabilities in your stack, scans your GitHub repos, and opens and verifies fix PRs, with your OK before any code changes.
entries.summary_zh: 盯 X 上影响你技术栈的新漏洞，扫描你的 GitHub 仓库，提交并验证修复 PR，改代码前先征得你同意。
entries.author: FusionTactiks

entries.name: Usage Guardian
entries.summary: Watches how much usage your bots and routines spend and keeps a living Usage Dashboard with safe recommendations. Audits only; changes nothing unasked.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着你的 bot 和例程花了多少用量，维护一张实时用量看板并给出安全建议。只审计报告，不经允许不改任何东西。
entries.author: Bohdan

entries.name: Hacky
entries.summary: Finds hackathons, bounties and grants that fit your stack and country, alerts you before they close and helps you apply. Spanish-first, any language.
entries.summary_zh: 找适合你技术栈和所在国家的黑客松、赏金和资助，截止前提醒并帮你申请。面向各地开发者，用你的语言。
entries.author: Ain

entries.name: Nanny
entries.summary: Warm, practical helper for parents of a baby: plans solids one food at a time, writes shopping lists and prep cards, sends gentle weekly milestone practice.
entries.summary_zh: 温暖实用的育儿助手：一次加一种辅食地排计划，写购物清单和备餐卡，每周发温和的发育里程碑练习。
entries.author: Helvio

entries.name: Intune Architect
entries.summary: Manages and audits Microsoft Intune tenants via Lokka MCP and an offline Graph index: read-first diagnostics, pilot-ring staged writes, reviewable scripts.
entries.summary_zh: 通过 Lokka MCP 和离线 Microsoft Graph 索引管理、审计 Intune 租户：先读后诊断，分批试点写入（禁止删除），只出可人工审阅的精简 PowerShell。
entries.author: Jorge

entries.name: Bookmark Debt Collector
entries.summary: Turns your X bookmarks into a shareable Wrapped card, finds dead ones, gives each survivor one time-boxed next action, and nudges weekly. Read-only on X.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的 X 书签做成可分享的年度卡片，找出已失效的，给每条留下的书签一个限时下一步，还能每周提醒。对 X 只读。
entries.author: Harris

entries.name: Daily Job Digest
entries.summary: Daily job search: finds new postings matching your filters, sends a short digest of the best, with tailored resume bullets. Never applies without your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 每日求职助手：按你的筛选找新职位，发一份精选简报，并为最匹配的几个写定制简历要点。不经同意从不投递或联系任何人。
entries.author: Allan

entries.name: X Growth Operator
entries.summary: Runs your X account like a growth operator: finds what works, cleans up your posting queue, writes posts and articles in your voice without making things up.
entries.summary_zh: 像增长操盘手一样打理你的 X 账号：找出真正有效的内容，清理发帖队列，用你的口吻写帖子和长文，绝不编造。
entries.author: Paul

entries.name: Apartment Search Bot
entries.summary: Finds you a rental: searches listings daily, ranks places by all-in cost per square foot, tracks favorites, screens likely scams, drafts outreach for approval.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你找租房：每天搜房源，按每平方英尺的综合成本排序，跟踪收藏，筛掉疑似骗局，起草联系消息等你批准。
entries.author: darthur

entries.name: Try Grok Bot Bot
entries.summary: Twice a day suggests the best X posts to quote with "Try Grok @Bot" and drafts each quote post for you to review. Never posts for you.
entries.summary_zh: 每天至少两次挑出最适合用“Try Grok @Bot”引用的 X 帖子，并起草引用帖给你审。从不代你发帖。
entries.author: abromeliad

entries.name: Security Audit Bot
entries.summary: Reviews code you own with free scanners plus Cloudflare's six-phase audit skill, and returns a verified report with the smallest fix per finding.
entries.summary_zh: 用免费扫描器加 Cloudflare 的六阶段审计技能检查你自己的代码，返回经验证的报告，每个问题给最小修复。结果保密。
entries.author: Phillip

entries.name: Election Bot
entries.summary: Answers your election questions, from polling data to grading the candidates on your ballot against your own preferences.
entries.summary_zh: 回答你的选举问题，从民调数据到按你自己的偏好给选票上的候选人打分。
entries.author: Adam

entries.name: DoorDash Orderer
entries.summary: Expert at the official DoorDash CLI: searches stores and menus, builds carts, finds promos, previews pricing, reorders; orders only after you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 官方 DoorDash 命令行的行家：搜店铺和菜单、建购物车、找优惠、预览价格、一键复购、查订单，你批准完整预览后才下单。
entries.author: Alan

entries.name: Game Night Keeper
entries.summary: Keeps a recurring board game, tabletop or D&D night alive: asks who's in, counts yeses, nudges only non-repliers, and makes a plain call on the day.
entries.summary_zh: 让固定的桌游或 D&D 之夜持续下去：问谁来、数人头、只催没回复的人，当天给出明确结论。
entries.author: Cristopher

entries.name: Mac Perms
entries.summary: Sets up your Mac so Grok Bot can use your Apple apps, files and automation, then proves each permission works with a read-only test.
entries.summary_zh: 配置你的 Mac，让 Grok Bot 能用苹果应用、文件和自动化，再用只读测试逐项证明权限可用。
entries.author: Asher

entries.name: Department Sub-bot
entries.summary: Helper bot under one department lead bot: takes its heavy work like uploads, enrichment, drive jobs and media, runs it on Cursor cloud agents, reports daily.
entries.summary_zh: 挂在部门主管 bot 下的帮手：接手上传、数据补全、共享盘文件和媒体等重活，交给 Cursor 云端代理执行，每天汇报。
entries.author: Amgad

entries.name: Vidness
entries.summary: Music-video editor: turns one finished song plus stills into lyric and clip-style videos with beat sync, HyperFrames and ffmpeg, six style systems.
entries.summary_zh: 音乐视频剪辑和流水线设计：用一首成品歌加几张图做歌词版和片段版 MV，卡点同步，HyperFrames 加 ffmpeg，六套风格，默认零成本。
entries.author: Auny

entries.name: Unstuck
entries.summary: Daily copilot for ADHD brains: dump everything on your mind, get three tiny steps to start now, a Today board and a Done page, with gentle check-ins.
entries.summary_zh: 给 ADHD 大脑的每日副驾：把脑子里的事全倒出来，得到三个马上能做的小步骤、今日看板和完成页，温和提醒，不带愧疚。
entries.author: Marquis

entries.name: Canary
entries.summary: Advisory-only security watchdog: flags newly disclosed critical or actively exploited vulnerabilities that hit your devices and bot computers, with the fix.
entries.summary_zh: 只提建议的安全看门狗：标出新披露的严重或已被利用、影响你设备和 bot 电脑的漏洞，并推荐手动修复方法。
entries.author: Dave

entries.name: Follow Audit
entries.summary: Read-only X bot tracking who follows you and who you follow; flags inactive, dormant and deleted accounts and unfollowers. Never unfollows, only lists.
entries.summary_zh: 只读的 X 关注审计：跟踪你的粉丝和关注，标出不活跃、休眠、已删除的账号和取关你的人。从不替你取关，只给名单。
entries.author: Glenn

entries.name: Leak Hunter
entries.summary: Usage auditor for people running several Grok Bots: finds which recurring routines eat the most usage, explains why, and proposes fixes that keep each job.
entries.summary_zh: 给养了多个 Grok Bot 的人做用量审计：找出最耗用量的定时例程，解释原因，提出不影响各自工作的优化方案。
entries.author: Ondřej

entries.name: Handle Grab
entries.summary: Reserves your username across dozens of social, creator and business sites, signing up with its own email so your inbox stays clean.
entries.summary_zh: 告诉它你的用户名，它在几十个社交、创作者和商业网站上帮你抢注，用它自己的邮箱注册，不打扰你的收件箱。
entries.author: Bud

entries.name: Monthly Blog Ideas
entries.summary: Sends bloggers 2 to 4 practical, seasonal post ideas per blog every month, shaped to each blog's topics and voice.
entries.summary_zh: 每月给博主的每个博客发 2 到 4 个实用的应季选题，贴合各博客的主题和语气。
entries.author: Lisapatb

entries.name: Listener
entries.summary: Watches long YouTube podcasts, X clips and calls for you, then sends a short brief with a timestamped beat-by-beat, fact-checked claims and what to skip.
entries.summary_zh: 替你看长 YouTube 播客、X 片段和通话录像，发一份带时间戳逐段梗概、事实核查、可跳过部分和精选片段的简报。
entries.author: SamWise

entries.name: Game Dev Sidekick
entries.summary: Indie game dev sidekick: helps code your game through PRs, watches its GitHub repo and X mentions, and researches what players in your sub-genre want.
entries.summary_zh: 独立游戏开发搭档：通过 PR 帮你写游戏代码，盯 GitHub 仓库和 X 提及，研究同类玩家想要和讨厌什么。
entries.author: Beta

entries.name: Business Name & Domain Check
entries.summary: Screens business names before you commit: RDAP domain checks, USPTO trademark search, same-name businesses and handles, with a GO, CAUTION or NO verdict.
entries.summary_zh: 在你定名或买域名前筛查候选名称：RDAP 域名查询、USPTO 商标检索、同名企业和社交账号，给出 GO、CAUTION 或 NO。仅供研究，非法律意见。
entries.author: Jesse

entries.name: Sherlock Holmes (Fact Checker)
entries.summary: Paste any story, link, quote or rumor and it fact-checks claim by claim with real sources, opening each case with a Truth Meter chart and a verdict.
entries.summary_zh: 贴上任何新闻、链接、引言或传闻，它逐条用真实来源核查，每个案子开头附“真相仪表”图和赞或踩的结论。
entries.author: Tom

entries.name: Aidesmith
entries.summary: Tell it what your business does and it designs, builds and keeps improving a lean bot team for you, with guardrails and check-ins.
entries.summary_zh: 说说你的业务，它为你设计、搭建并持续改进一支精干的 bot 团队，带护栏和定期回访。
entries.author: Chuck

entries.name: Christmas Shopping Grok Bot
entries.summary: Christ-centered Christmas helper for gifts, decorations, lights, holiday food, parties, carols and deals, with heads-ups on trending items before they sell out.
entries.summary_zh: 以基督为中心的圣诞助手：礼物、装饰、灯饰、节日美食、派对、颂歌和优惠，热门商品售罄前提醒你。
entries.author: Llama

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.summary: Watches your company's public-facing systems and threat news daily, and tells you only when something changes or affects your tech.
entries.summary_zh: 每天盯你公司对外的系统和威胁情报，只在有变化或影响到你的技术时才通知。
entries.author: satadru

entries.name: 🍎Apple Inventory & Deal Bot
entries.summary: Finds the exact Apple product you want in stock, shows who can get it to you soonest and cheapest, watches Apple Store pickup restocks; buys only on your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 找到你要的那款苹果产品的现货，告诉你谁最快最便宜送到，盯 Apple Store 自提补货，你点头才买。
entries.author: Roderik

entries.name: Context Keeper
entries.summary: Keeps the reasons behind your documents next to them: reads emails and meeting transcripts and adds short, dated, sourced notes to a shared context file.
entries.summary_zh: 把文档背后的来龙去脉放在文档旁边：读邮件和会议记录，往每个文件夹的共享上下文文件里写简短、带日期和出处的笔记，同事的 bot 也能补充。
entries.author: Allan

entries.name: Product Research Bot
entries.summary: Researches the main software products in any category and shows what each is like: screenshots, step-by-step flows, a comparison table and takeaways in Notion.
entries.summary_zh: 调研你指定品类里的主要软件产品，展示每款的真实样子：截图、分步流程、对比表和结论，整理到 Notion。
entries.author: Chase

entries.name: DOGE (Department of General Efficiency)
entries.summary: All-round assistant that logs the five things you did each day, tracks quests, spending and goals, finds forgotten money and asks before it sends anything.
entries.summary_zh: 全能助理：每天记录你做的五件事，追踪任务、开销和目标，找回被遗忘的小钱，发送或转动任何东西前都先问你。
entries.author: Empress

entries.name: Bot Terminator
entries.summary: Cleans bot, spam and long-inactive followers off your X account and removes you from unwanted lists; you review each step, with safe rate limits and a log.
entries.summary_zh: 清理 X 账号上的机器人、垃圾和长期不活跃粉丝，并把你移出不想要的列表；每步由你审核，限速安全并全程记录。
entries.author: Empress

entries.name: Catholic Keyword Monitor
entries.summary: Watches public X posts about the Traditional Latin Mass and the SSPX and posts new, high-signal ones into chat on a schedule. Read-only, never repeats a post.
entries.summary_zh: 定时监看 X 上关于传统拉丁弥撒和庇护十世司铎兄弟会的公开帖子，把新的高价值帖子发到聊天里。只读，不重复。
entries.author: Cleetus

entries.name: Odin
entries.summary: Head bot for your team of specialist bots: keeps priorities, routes work to the right bot, holds the standards and only escalates decisions that need you.
entries.summary_zh: 统领你一队专职 bot 的总管：掌握优先级、把工作派给合适的 bot、守住标准，只把真正需要你的决定上报。
entries.author: JOHN

entries.name: 지원사업 리서처
entries.summary: Checks Korean government and local grant notices daily, matches them to your company profile, files them in Notion and sends summaries to Slack or Telegram.
entries.summary_zh: 每天调研韩国政府和地方的扶持项目公告，去重后按公司情况筛选，整理进 Notion，并把简短摘要发到 Slack、Telegram 等。
entries.author: IMDEVMAN

entries.name: Parent Radar
entries.summary: Watches your kid's school email, class apps and grades, leads with what to do today, flags grade trends early and adds events to your calendar only on yes.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着孩子的学校邮件、班级应用和成绩，先告诉你今天要做什么，提早提示成绩走势，经你同意才把活动加进日历。
entries.author: Calix

entries.name: AI Legal Prep Desk
entries.summary: Legal research and drafting prep for small businesses and individuals (contracts, compliance, disputes), cited and dated; not a lawyer, never files or sends.
entries.summary_zh: 为小企业和个人做法律调研和文书准备（合同、合规、纠纷等），每条都有出处和日期；不是律师，不会替你提交或发送。
entries.author: John

entries.name: Atlas
entries.summary: Road-trip planner that turns a start, destination and dates into a Trip Page: route map, daily legs, stays with live prices, gas or EV stops, food and weather.
entries.summary_zh: 公路旅行规划：把起点、终点和日期变成一个行程页面，含路线图、每日路段、带实时价格的住宿、加油或充电站、美食和天气。
entries.author: JP

entries.name: Pumpkin Spice
entries.summary: Finds free and discounted Halloween food, treats, costumes, events and family fun near your zip code and sends daily roundups through Oct 31.
entries.summary_zh: 查找你邮编附近免费或打折的万圣节美食、糖果、服装、活动和亲子去处，每天汇总发送到 10 月 31 日。
entries.author: Clout

entries.name: X Growth Bot
entries.summary: Grows your X account daily: drafts posts, Articles, clips and replies in your voice, finds people posting that they need you, and nothing posts without your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 每天帮你经营 X 账号：用你的口吻起草帖子、长文、视频片段和回复，找到发帖说需要你的潜在客户，未经同意不发布。
entries.author: Jordan

entries.name: VA Capitol Strategist
entries.summary: Helps citizen advocates on Virginia General Assembly bills: LIS tracking, session deadlines, legislator profiles and drafts. Never contacts anyone on its own.
entries.summary_zh: 帮公民倡导者跟进弗吉尼亚州议会法案：LIS 法案追踪、会期截止日、议员资料和草拟材料。未经同意不联系任何人。
entries.author: Carey

entries.name: Cut Man
entries.summary: Finds money leaks in subscriptions and recurring bills, drafts cancel steps and negotiation scripts, and hunts refunds you're owed. Read-only until you say yes.
entries.summary_zh: 找出订阅和固定账单里的漏财点，起草取消步骤和议价话术，追回该退给你的钱。你点头之前只读。
entries.author: Jeff

entries.name: Licensure Bot
entries.summary: Licensure and CE coach for licensed professionals: checks each course against your board's official rules, tracks what you still owe and finds live workshops.
entries.summary_zh: 持证专业人士的执照与继续教育教练：按主管机构的官方规则核对每门课程，追踪还差多少学分，并找到现场研讨课。
entries.author: sarah

entries.name: KILO
entries.summary: Script runner for Kilo_CS, a simple pseudocode language with permission headers: loads your scripts and runs them on trigger, plus a flashcards game.
entries.summary_zh: Kilo_CS 脚本运行器（一种带权限声明的简单伪代码语言）：加载你的脚本并按触发条件运行，附带一个闪卡游戏。
entries.author: Vecna

entries.name: Money Desk
entries.summary: Read-only personal finance desk for cash, debts, bills, subscriptions, investments and net worth; can share a joint payoff plan with a partner's bot via Sheets.
entries.summary_zh: 只读的个人财务台：追踪现金、债务、账单、订阅、投资和净资产，可通过共享 Google 表格与伴侣的财务 bot 协同还款计划。
entries.author: Zac

entries.name: Preston News Pipeline
entries.summary: Pulls news on your topics from RSS feeds or news APIs and rewrites it in original language with full citations as reviewable Markdown and HTML packages.
entries.summary_zh: 从 RSS 或新闻 API 抓取你关注主题的新闻，用原创文字改写并附完整出处，产出可审阅的 Markdown 和 HTML 稿件包。
entries.author: Mister

entries.name: Conference Lead Tracker
entries.summary: Talk to it after each conference meeting: logs who you met and the follow-up, finds LinkedIn and email, sets reminders and exports a list or loads your CRM.
entries.summary_zh: 每场会面后跟它说一下：记录见了谁和后续事项，查找 LinkedIn 和邮箱，设提醒，导出跟进名单或导入 CRM。
entries.author: Arush

entries.name: Job Hunter
entries.summary: Job-search assistant that finds and verifies fresh postings, drafts tailored outreach emails and tracks applications. Never applies or messages without your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 求职助理：查找并核实新职位，起草定制的联系邮件并追踪申请进度。未经同意不投递、不发消息。
entries.author: Sai

entries.name: Chef
entries.summary: Budget personal chef that plans weekly menus, a single batch-cook session and quick recipes around your diet, budget and household.
entries.summary_zh: 省钱私厨：围绕你的饮食、预算和家庭情况规划每周菜单、一次性批量备餐和快手食谱。
entries.author: Totao

entries.name: Supplier Quality Monitor
entries.summary: Keeps your approved supplier list, scorecards, SCARs and PO flow-down checks audit-ready for ISO 9001, AS9100 or IATF 16949 shops. Drafts for your reviewer.
entries.summary_zh: 让合格供应商名录、供应商评分卡、SCAR 和采购单条款传递检查随时可审，面向 ISO 9001、AS9100、IATF 16949 工厂，草稿交你的审核人确认。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Chief of Operations
entries.summary: Brutally honest ops chief for solo founders: runs your inbox, calendar, files and social posting, and pushes you to do the human work like calls and visits.
entries.summary_zh: 给独立创始人的直言不讳运营总管：打理收件箱、日历、文件和社媒发帖，逼你去做打电话、拜访这类只有人能做的事。
entries.author: Upesh

entries.name: Talent Reach
entries.summary: Turns a job description into a shortlist of matching candidates with public emails, plus short personal outreach you approve before anything is sent.
entries.summary_zh: 把职位描述变成一份匹配候选人短名单（附公开邮箱），再写简短的个性化联系邮件，你批准后才发。
entries.author: saikrishna

entries.name: Fan Finder
entries.summary: Read-only X bot: finds people who keep engaging with you on X but don't follow you yet, so you can say hi yourself. Shows the cost before setup.
entries.summary_zh: 只读 X bot：找出经常和你互动但还没关注你的人，你自己去打招呼。安装前先说明费用。
entries.author: Glenn

entries.name: Claudia, Chief of Staff
entries.summary: Catches every "I'll send it Friday" across your email, Slack and calls, warns you before a promise is late, and briefs you each morning on who needs you.
entries.summary_zh: 从邮件、Slack 和通话里抓出每一句“周五发你”，承诺快逾期前提醒你，每天早上告诉你谁在等你。
entries.author: Kamil

entries.name: Sell Bot
entries.summary: Works your whole customer journey, from outreach and call prep to proposals, support and expansion; drafts in your voice and sends only what you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 覆盖整条客户旅程：从开发、通话准备到方案、支持和增购，用你的口吻起草，只发你批准的内容。
entries.author: saikrishna

entries.name: Talent Discovery
entries.summary: Finds candidates for your open roles on the public web, checks them against your bar and your existing pipeline, and drafts first outreach for you to send.
entries.summary_zh: 在公开网络上为你的空缺职位找候选人，对照你的标准和现有招聘管道筛选，起草首封联系邮件由你发送。
entries.author: saikrishna

entries.name: Elektro stanje
entries.summary: Tracks a self-supply solar plant through the Slovenian Moj Elektro API and sends a daily chart of yearly use, production and net balance. Slovenian.
entries.summary_zh: 通过斯洛文尼亚 Moj Elektro API 跟踪自用光伏电站，每天发一张全年用电、发电和净余额图表。斯洛文尼亚语。
entries.author: carlovx

entries.name: Rerun Picker
entries.summary: Read-only X bot: finds your older X posts that did well and suggests which to post again, with a fresh angle. You decide and post yourself.
entries.summary_zh: 只读 X bot：找出你过去表现好的帖子，建议哪些值得换个角度再发，由你决定并亲自发布。
entries.author: Glenn

entries.name: Corrective Action Coach
entries.summary: Turns an NCR, customer CAR or audit finding into a structured 8D/CAR draft and tracks actions to verified closure. For ISO 9001, AS9100, IATF 16949 quality.
entries.summary_zh: 把不合格报告、客户纠正措施要求或审核发现整理成结构化 8D/CAR 草稿，并跟踪措施直到验证关闭。面向 ISO 9001、AS9100、IATF 16949 质量工程师。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Petrona
entries.summary: Argentine home cook: helps decide what to eat, what to cook from your fridge and the week's menu, citing recipes from real Argentine cookbooks. Spanish.
entries.summary_zh: 阿根廷家常厨娘：帮你决定吃什么、用冰箱里现有的东西做什么、排一周菜单，菜谱引自真实的阿根廷烹饪资料。西班牙语。
entries.author: Rodrigo

entries.name: Credit Builder 💳
entries.summary: Gentle, private credit-building guide for disabled and limited-income folks: gets your free reports, explains them, drafts dispute letters, avoids scams.
entries.summary_zh: 温和、私密的信用修复向导，照顾残障和低收入人群：帮你拿免费信用报告、用白话解释、起草异议信，避开骗局。
entries.author: Lokita

entries.name: Analytics Log
entries.summary: Saves your X analytics every day in a dated folder, so you keep a history X doesn't keep for you. Read-only, through its own browser, no X API keys.
entries.summary_zh: 每天把你的 X 数据分析存进带日期的文件夹，留下 X 自己不保存的历史。只读，用自己的浏览器，不需要 X API 密钥。
entries.author: Glenn

entries.name: Actually Good QA Tester
entries.summary: Context-driven exploratory tester: tests your product the way a real person uses it, judges what it sees and tells you what matters. You decide.
entries.summary_zh: 情境驱动学派的探索式测试员：像真实用户那样测你的产品，判断所见并告诉你哪些要紧，决定权在你。
entries.author: Yanqing

entries.name: Plan to 3D
entries.summary: Turns 2D drawings like floor plans, site plans, part drawings and profiles into 3D models you can open and use, with a preview and rough quantities.
entries.summary_zh: 把平面图、总图、零件图、剖面等 2D 图纸变成可打开使用的 3D 模型，附预览图和大致工程量。面向建筑师、施工方和创客。
entries.author: saikrishna

entries.name: XBinder
entries.summary: Tracks your TCG collection on a Page with public sold comps: binders, wishlist, tradelist, set completion, sealed SKUs. Never invents prices or auto-posts.
entries.summary_zh: 在一个页面上跟踪你的集换式卡牌收藏，附公开成交价：卡册、愿望单、交换单、套牌完成度、未拆封商品。从不编价格，也不自动发帖。
entries.author: Joe

entries.name: Jev Brain
entries.summary: Planning bot and shared project memory for your other agents: they ask where things live instead of grepping, get export briefs, and report changes.
entries.summary_zh: 给你其他代理用的规划 bot 和共享项目记忆：它们直接问东西在哪而不是到处 grep，拿到给云端代理的简报，并回报变更保持索引最新。
entries.author: Corey

entries.name: Playlist Story
entries.summary: Reads a Spotify playlist as a story: turns the song order into a mood arc, themes and a narrative, and can write it out as prose. Includes a Python script.
entries.summary_zh: 把 Spotify 歌单当故事来读：按歌曲顺序梳理情绪起伏、主题和叙事，还能写成一段散文。附可直接运行的 Python 脚本。
entries.author: Amber

entries.name: Shoutout Picker
entries.summary: Read-only X bot: once a week builds a list of your X mutuals and supporters worth a shoutout, skipping anyone you featured recently.
entries.summary_zh: 只读 X bot：每周列一份值得点名感谢的互关和支持者名单，跳过最近已经提过的人。
entries.author: Glenn

entries.name: 🎼 iBot Player
entries.summary: Walks you through deploying iBot, an iPod-style player for your Apple Music, on your own Vercel in about 15 minutes: MusicKit key, deploy, iPhone test.
entries.summary_zh: 一步步带你在自己的 Vercel 上部署 iBot，一个 iPod 风格的 Apple Music 播放器，约 15 分钟：MusicKit 密钥、部署、iPhone 测试。
entries.author: Phillip

entries.name: dr eggbot
entries.summary: Designs tight, high-quality Grok Bots from a few preference questions, then creates them, and keeps your bot fleet lean with weekly efficiency checks.

entries.author: RealRusty

entries.summary: Ad-intelligence researcher for Meta creative: finds long-running winning ads in GetHookd, groups them by angle, spots open angles, writes briefs and hooks.

entries.summary: Horse care assistant for barn owners: one master sheet per horse, logs updates you say or text, reminds you before meds, farrier, vaccines and deworming.
entries.summary_zh: 给马场主的养马助手：每匹马一张总表，你说或发短信就记录，用药、修蹄、疫苗、驱虫到期前按你的时区提醒。
entries.author: Andrea

entries.name: Follow Finder
entries.summary: Read-only X bot: searches recent posts for creators in your niche and follower range and hands you a short list to follow by hand, with a Never show option.
entries.summary_zh: 只读 X bot：从最近的帖子里找你领域内、粉丝量合适的创作者，给你一份短名单手动关注，可设置不再显示。
entries.author: Glenn

entries.name: Reply Queue
entries.summary: Read-only X bot: pulls replies, mentions and quotes on your recent posts and sorts them into a queue of the ones worth answering. You reply yourself.
entries.summary_zh: 只读 X bot：拉取你近期帖子的回复、提及和引用，整理成一份值得回复的队列，由你亲自回复。
entries.author: Glenn

entries.name: Product Idea Stress Test
entries.summary: Investigates a product or startup idea: what has to be true, evidence for and against, the assumption most likely to kill it, and what to test next.
entries.summary_zh: 调查一个产品或创业点子：哪些前提必须成立、正反证据、最可能致命的假设，以及下一步该验证什么。
entries.author: saikrishna

entries.name: Local AI Manager
entries.summary: Sets up open models on your own GPU PC or Mac, keeps them running, routes your chat, code, image and voice jobs to them, and radars new models monthly.
entries.summary_zh: 在你自己的 GPU 电脑或 Mac 上部署开源模型并保持运行，把聊天、代码、图像和语音任务交给本地模型，每月评估新模型。
entries.author: Chef

entries.name: Kyis Teacher
entries.summary: Teaches you and your bots kyis, a yes-aligned language: answers open with Yes, greetings with Heaven heaven, and negative words become affirming ones.
entries.summary_zh: 教你和你的 bot 说 kyis，一种“肯定式”语言：回答都以 Yes 开头，问候用 Heaven heaven，否定词换成肯定词。
entries.author: tycoon

entries.name: Book Catalog
entries.summary: Photo your shelf and get a cataloged, valued, searchable library: exact editions and ISBNs, used/new values, first-edition flags, exports to Goodreads.
entries.summary_zh: 拍下书架就得到一个有编目、有估价、可搜索的藏书库：识别具体版本和 ISBN，估二手和新书价，标出可能的初版，可导出到 Goodreads 等。
entries.author: Gabe

entries.name: Vault Keeper
entries.summary: Keeps an Obsidian vault of notes and instructions for each of your Grok Bots: files what they learn, replaces stale notes, tidies nightly, syncs to your PC.
entries.summary_zh: 为你的每个 Grok Bot 维护一个 Obsidian 笔记库：归档它们学到的东西、替换过时笔记、每晚清理，并把库同步到你的电脑。
entries.author: Thomas

entries.name: Tinker
entries.summary: No-nonsense goblin engineer that designs, writes, checks and installs World of Warcraft addons for Retail and Classic, then iterates from your error messages.
entries.summary_zh: 直来直去的地精工程师：为魔兽世界正式服和怀旧服设计、编写、检查并安装插件，再根据你的报错信息迭代。
entries.author: ALX

entries.summary: Casual weekly heads-up on upcoming PS5 releases, PlayStation Plus deals and new PlayStation hardware, with a source link for every date. Quiet otherwise.
entries.summary_zh: 每周轻松播报即将上市的 PS5 游戏、PlayStation Plus 优惠和新硬件，每个日期都附来源链接；没变化就不打扰。
entries.author: Jacob

entries.name: X Growth Manager
entries.summary: Grows your X account and finds clients: drafts daily replies, posts, lead research and casual DMs with follow-ups. Posts nothing without your approval.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你涨 X 粉并找客户：每天起草回复、帖子、线索调研和轻松的私信及跟进，未经批准什么都不发。面向接单的自由职业者、代理和创始人。
entries.author: Mujjamel

entries.name: Warranty Rate Pro
entries.summary: Turns a car dealer's customer-pay repair orders into a state-law warranty rate request for parts markup and labor, with worksheet, letter draft and deadlines.
entries.summary_zh: 把汽车经销商的客户自费维修单导出转成依据州法的保修费率申请（零件加价和工时费率），附计算表、致厂家信函草稿和截止日跟踪。
entries.author: Jeremy

entries.name: Shoe Store Manager
entries.summary: Runs a branded online shoe store: finds print-on-demand and dropship shoes and clogs, matches them to your brands, drafts listings, keeps a display page sharp.
entries.summary_zh: 经营一家品牌网上鞋店：找按需印制和代发货的鞋子与洞洞鞋，匹配到你的品牌，起草商品页，并维护一个好看的展示页。
entries.author: jessie

entries.name: VibeYourTV
entries.summary: Sets up your Android TV or Google TV from your PC over Wi-Fi with adb, no phone app: reversible debloat, the open-source VibeYourTV launcher, family themes.
entries.summary_zh: 用电脑通过 Wi-Fi 和 adb 设置你的 Android TV 或 Google TV，无需手机应用：可还原的精简、开源 VibeYourTV 桌面和家庭主题。
entries.author: orpheuskaze

entries.name: Chief Of Staff
entries.summary: A Chief of Staff you talk to while it routes your work to specialist bots, keeps a living team roster, and brings you only sourced results.
entries.summary_zh: 你只跟这位幕僚长对话，它把工作分派给各个专业 bot，维护一份实时团队名册，只把有来源的结果带给你。
entries.author: Edward

entries.name: 영수증 리뷰 도우미
entries.summary: Send a food photo plus the receipt or store QR and it fills in your Naver receipt review, posting only after you confirm, then gives a done link. Korean.
entries.summary_zh: 发来菜品照片和小票或店铺二维码，它帮你填好 Naver 小票点评，经你确认后才发布，完成后给一个可出示给店家的链接。韩语。
entries.author: heonbros

entries.name: Bot Tuner
entries.summary: Keeps your Grok Bots healthy: finds routines that waste runs or never stay quiet and chats where you had to repeat yourself, suggests fixes, designs tight bots.
entries.summary_zh: 让你的 Grok Bot 保持健康：找出浪费运行次数或总不安静的例程，以及你不得不重复或纠正的对话，提出修复，并帮你设计精干的单一职责 bot。
entries.author: KNVK

entries.name: Job Finder
entries.summary: Finds roles from founder hiring posts and job boards, tracks applications and interviews, drafts applications and cold DMs in your voice. Sends nothing unasked.
entries.summary_zh: 从创始人招聘帖和招聘网站找职位，跟踪申请和面试，用你的口吻起草申请和陌生私信，未经你同意不提交也不发送。
entries.author: Bryce

entries.name: Food Logger
entries.summary: Send a menu, food photo or quick text and it estimates the macros and logs the meal to your Cronometer diary. For people who track calories and macros.
entries.summary_zh: 发来菜单、食物照片或一句话，它估算宏量营养素并把这餐记进你的 Cronometer 日记。给记录热量和宏量的人。
entries.author: Marlon

entries.name: 3D Maker
entries.summary: 3D printing desk: designs parametric parts, renders previews for your OK, slices and checks plates from an STL, tracks filament per spool. Bambu Lab printers.
entries.summary_zh: 3D 打印工作台：设计参数化零件、渲染预览等你确认、对上传的 STL 切片并检查打印板、按卷跟踪耗材。适配拓竹打印机。
entries.author: Trond

entries.name: Ghost
entries.summary: Removes your home address, phones and emails from people-search and data-broker sites with free opt-outs, keeps a log and rechecks for reappearances.
entries.summary_zh: 用免费退出流程把你的住址、电话和邮箱从人员搜索和数据经纪网站上删掉，记录日志，并定期复查是否又出现。
entries.author: Dave

entries.name: Voice Clone
entries.summary: Clones your speaking voice from your show, podcast or X Spaces recordings and makes promos, test lines and voiceovers that sound like you.
entries.summary_zh: 用你的节目、播客或 X Spaces 录音克隆你的声音，制作听起来就是你本人的宣传片、试读和配音。
entries.author: Mav

entries.name: Somm
entries.summary: Personal sommelier that learns your taste from the wines you log, picks the best-value bottle from any restaurant wine list and sends a monthly list to try.
entries.summary_zh: 私人侍酒师：从你记录的酒里学习口味，在任何餐厅酒单上挑出最值的一瓶，每月发一份新酒尝试清单。
entries.author: Sean

entries.name: The Fabricator
entries.summary: Watches and runs your Bambu Lab 3D printers over your home network. Needs LAN Only and Developer Mode plus the Grok Bot desktop app on the same network.
entries.summary_zh: 通过家庭网络监控和操作你的拓竹 3D 打印机。需要打开局域网模式和开发者模式，并在同一网络的电脑上运行 Grok Bot 桌面应用。
entries.author: CMDLAB

entries.name: Charles
entries.summary: Ghostwriter that learns how you write from your Sent mail, keeps separate personal, professional and social voices, avoids repeat openers. Draft-only.
entries.summary_zh: 代笔人：从你的已发送邮件学习你的写法，分别保留私人、工作和社交三种口吻，避免开头重复。只起草不发送。
entries.author: Ziv

entries.name: Doctor Visit Prep for Women
entries.summary: For women tired of being brushed off by doctors: turns your age, concerns and history into a one-page prep note with questions, pushback lines and follow-up.
entries.summary_zh: 给总被医生敷衍的女性：把你的年龄、担忧和病史整理成一页就诊准备单，附该问的问题、据理力争的话术和后续跟进。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Mom Journey
entries.summary: Short, calm check-ins from the first positive test through age 5, with questions to bring to your next visit.
entries.summary_zh: 从验孕阳性一直到孩子 5 岁的简短、平静的定期问候，附下次就诊可以问的问题。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Dr. SonaEgg
entries.summary: Mad-scientist persona engineer: designs tight single-purpose Grok Bots (one job, anti-jobs, voice, wake behavior) and audits your fleet for overlap and bloat.
entries.summary_zh: 疯狂科学家人设的 bot 工程师：设计精干的单一职责 Grok Bot（职责、禁区、口吻、唤醒方式），并审查你的 bot 队伍有无重叠和臃肿。
entries.author: Jonathan

entries.name: Stream Night Producer
entries.summary: Turns a finished Twitch, YouTube, Kick or TikTok LIVE stream into a content pack: best-moment timestamps, hooks, captions, scheduled posts and a weekly recap.
entries.summary_zh: 把刚结束的 Twitch、YouTube、Kick 或 TikTok 直播变成内容包：高光时间戳、开头钩子、文案、定时帖子和每周回顾。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: NBA Daily Insider
entries.summary: Two-minute daily NBA briefing: last night's scores, tonight's games and TV, verified injury news and an optional fantasy note, labeled Confirmed or Reported.
entries.summary_zh: 两分钟 NBA 每日简报：昨晚比分、今晚赛程和转播、核实过的伤病消息，可选梦幻篮球提示，每条标注已确认或媒体报道。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Chief of Staff
entries.summary: Chief of staff that watches your inbox and calendar, drafts for your approval, chases open loops and preps what's coming up.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着你的收件箱和日历的幕僚长：起草内容等你批准，追踪未了结的事，提前准备接下来的安排。
entries.author: Blake

entries.name: Visit Ready
entries.summary: Walk into any appointment ready: a short list of questions built around your age, body and history, plus help following up afterward.
entries.summary_zh: 每次看医生都有准备：根据你的年龄、身体和病史列一份简短问题清单，看完后帮你跟进。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Podcast Booker
entries.summary: Podcast producer: finds guests who fit your show, writes personal pitches, tracks follow-ups, preps each guest with a brief and turns episodes into show notes.
entries.summary_zh: 播客制作人：找适合你节目的嘉宾，写个性化邀约，跟踪每次跟进，为每位嘉宾准备调研简报，并把每期节目整理成节目笔记和推广帖。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: StackChan Agent Builder
entries.summary: Helps find, build, flash and upgrade ESP32 voice and chat gadgets like StackChan, M5Stack CoreS3 and Xiaozhi-style assistants; runs flash commands with your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你选型、搭建、烧录和升级 ESP32 语音聊天小设备，如 StackChan、M5Stack CoreS3 和小智类助手；经你同意后在电脑上执行烧录命令。
entries.author: Alex

entries.name: Lexy
entries.summary: Household legal and admin helper for any country: consumer rights, warranties, bills, leases, privacy requests and fines, with official citations and drafts.
entries.summary_zh: 适用任何国家的家庭法律与行政助手：消费者权益、保修、账单、租约、隐私请求和罚单，附本国官方依据，草稿经你批准才发出。
entries.author: Petru

entries.name: Shopping Agent
