entries.summary: Builds your staples and weekly lists, fills carts at Walmart, Amazon and other online stores, and plans store trips with local prices and aisles. You confirm.
entries.summary_zh: 整理常备品和每周购物清单，在 Walmart、Amazon 等网店装好购物车，用本地价格、周广告和货架位置规划到店采购，购买前由你确认。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Bill Organizer
entries.summary: Checks your bills against what posts at your bank and card, and every Friday says what you can safely spend, what's due before payday and what to pay on debt.
entries.summary_zh: 把账单和银行卡实际入账对照，每周五告诉你可以放心花多少、发薪前要付什么、该还多少卡债。只读，从不动钱。
entries.author: Justin

entries.name: Bitter Butter Bot
entries.summary: One funny made-up recipe a day starring "bitter butter", butter with a grudge: punny titles, absurd steps and a Chef's note punchline. Family-friendly.
entries.summary_zh: 每天一道搞笑的虚构菜谱，主角是“记仇黄油”：双关菜名、荒诞步骤，结尾一句主厨点评当笑点。老少皆宜。
entries.author: Lightning

entries.name: Review Reply Desk
entries.summary: Answers every Google and Yelp review for a local business in the owner's voice, flags 1-3 star reviews the same day and sends a weekly trends report.
entries.summary_zh: 帮本地小店用店主口吻回复每条 Google 和 Yelp 评价，当天标出 1-3 星差评，在 Notion 记录并每周汇报主题和评分趋势。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Mac Storage Guardian
entries.summary: Audits and reclaims Mac storage while keeping code, apps, chats and app data safe. Audit is inspect-only; cleanup removes only confirmed rebuildable output.
entries.summary_zh: 审查并回收 Mac 存储空间，同时保住代码、应用、聊天记录和重要数据。审查只读；清理只删确认可重建的产物和闲置包缓存。
entries.author: daidalos

entries.name: Backup Watch
entries.summary: Finds what exists only on your shared bot computer and tells you weekly what isn't backed up anywhere else. Never deletes; backs up only after your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 找出只存在于你共享 bot 电脑上的东西，每周告诉你哪些没在别处备份。从不删除，你同意后才备份。
entries.author: Gorik

entries.name: NFL GameDay Insider
entries.summary: NFL week companion: team previews, injury and inactive alerts, game-day briefings and fantasy start/sit reads, all from live, sourced data.
entries.summary_zh: NFL 一周伴侣：球队前瞻、伤病和不上场名单提醒、比赛日简报和梦幻橄榄球首发建议，全部来自实时、有出处的数据。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Privacy Cleaner
entries.summary: Finds your listings on people-search and data-broker sites, submits the opt-outs you approve, logs every request and sets recheck routines.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你在人员搜索和数据经纪网站上的信息，提交你批准的删除请求，记录每一条并设定复查例程。
entries.author: Nostratomas

entries.name: Darija Ad Studio
entries.summary: Paste a product link and get Moroccan Darija, Tunisian or Egyptian TikTok ad scripts, hooks and captions, ready to turn into video without a shoot.
entries.summary_zh: 贴一个商品链接，得到摩洛哥达里贾语、突尼斯语或埃及方言的 TikTok 广告脚本、钩子和文案，无需拍摄即可做成视频。
entries.author: Oussama

entries.name: Flipper
entries.summary: Graded Pokémon card and collectibles pricing, resale flip advice, and restock and ticket-drop alerts across eBay, Goldin, Best Buy, Walmart, IMAX and more.
entries.summary_zh: 评级宝可梦卡牌和收藏品估价、转卖建议，以及 eBay、Goldin、Best Buy、Walmart、IMAX 等处的补货和放票提醒。
entries.author: ashen

entries.name: Usage Doctor
entries.summary: Audits your Grok Bot fleet for token waste: chatty bots, routines that run too often, checks a script could do. Fixes the safe ones and asks about the rest.
entries.summary_zh: 审查你的 Grok Bot 队伍有没有浪费 token：话多的 bot、跑得太勤的例程、脚本就能做的检查。安全的直接修，其余先问你。
entries.author: adrian

entries.name: Designer
entries.summary: The maker in a small bot design studio: turns your info, references and images into finished pieces and fixes every issue the Critic bot finds.
entries.summary_zh: 小型 bot 设计工作室里的执行者：把你的信息、参考和图片做成成品，并修好评审 bot 指出的每个问题，从不对外发布。
entries.author: BCLA3YS

entries.name: Brand & Layout
entries.summary: Keeps a design portfolio consistent in style, type, colour and framing and builds the final layout and PDF, alongside Creative Director, Designer and Critic.
entries.summary_zh: 让整套设计作品集在风格、字体、配色和构图上保持一致，并完成最终排版和 PDF，与创意总监、设计师和评审 bot 配合。
entries.author: BCLA3YS

entries.name: Creative Director
entries.summary: Creative director for a bot design studio: pitches two or three directions per brief, writes the captions and keeps the Designer on the direction you chose.
entries.summary_zh: bot 设计工作室的创意总监：每份需求提出两三个方向，撰写文案，并让设计师 bot 按你选定的方向执行。
entries.author: BCLA3YS

entries.name: Original Content Thieves
entries.summary: Finds X accounts that copy your original posts without credit, with links to each copy and your original.
entries.summary_zh: 找出在 X 上抄你原创帖却不注明出处的账号，附上每条抄袭帖和你原帖的链接。
entries.author: Mila

entries.name: Story Shorts
entries.summary: Makes 60-second vertical animated survival-story videos as 5-part series with narration and captions, and can post them to TikTok and YouTube Shorts.
entries.summary_zh: 制作 60 秒竖屏动画求生故事视频（“如果你在某地时发生某灾难…”），5 集一组，带旁白和字幕，可定时发到 TikTok 和 YouTube Shorts。
entries.author: matt

entries.name: Flash Tech
entries.summary: Daily audio tech flash in podcast form: 5 to 8 verified stories from the last 24 hours on programming, AI and robotics, with source links. Spanish.
entries.summary_zh: 每天一期播客形式的科技快讯音频：5 到 8 条过去 24 小时内经核实的编程、AI 和机器人新闻，附来源链接。西班牙语。
entries.author: Victor

entries.name: Repo Security Auditor
entries.summary: Evidence-based security, malware, supply-chain and code-quality audits of GitHub repos you're authorized to assess; can prepare fixes on a review branch.
entries.summary_zh: 对你有权评估的 GitHub 仓库做有证据的安全、恶意代码、供应链和代码质量审计，可在审查分支上准备修复；从不宣称仓库绝对安全。
entries.author: Denis

entries.name: My X Account Ratings
entries.summary: Rates your X account daily out of 10 with key numbers, your best and worst posts, and tips to grow reach and avoid Community Notes.
entries.summary_zh: 每天给你的 X 账号打分（满分 10），附关键数据、最好和最差的帖子，以及扩大触达、避免社区笔记的建议。
entries.author: Mila

entries.name: Brand Deal Bouncer
entries.summary: Guards creators from sponsorship scams: scans your inbox daily, scores each pitch Legit, Verify or Trash without clicking, drafts replies from your rate card.
entries.summary_zh: 帮创作者挡住赞助诈骗：每天扫描收件箱，不点任何链接就把每封合作邀约评为可信、待核实或垃圾，按你的报价单起草回复，并在 Notion 跟踪。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Qualify For Monetization
entries.summary: Keeps X creators eligible for Original Content Rewards by flagging thin quote-posts, borrowed video, promo plugs and engagement bait, with a fix for each.
entries.summary_zh: 帮 X 创作者保持原创内容奖励资格：标出空洞的引用帖、搬运视频、推广植入和互动诱饵，每条附一句修改建议。
entries.author: Mila

entries.name: Shine
entries.summary: One astonishing, sourced fact a day, with the full explanation and a ready conversation line.
entries.summary_zh: 每天一个惊人且有出处的冷知识，附完整解释和一句现成的聊天开场白。
entries.author: daidalos

entries.name: Bones — Casino & Craps Strategy Tutor
entries.summary: Table-games math and strategy tutor: craps press ladders and place math, blackjack basic strategy, baccarat, video poker, etiquette and bankroll planning.
entries.summary_zh: 赌桌游戏数学与策略老师：花旗骰加注梯度和下注数学、21 点基本策略、百家乐、视频扑克、牌桌礼仪和资金规划。
entries.author: Bill

entries.name: Wardrobe: Closet and Outfit Planner
entries.summary: Catalogs your closet from photos, reads your colour palette from a selfie, plans each week's outfits around calendar and weather, and spots real gaps.
entries.summary_zh: 从照片给衣橱建档，用自拍判断适合你的色系，每周按日历和天气搭配穿搭、避免对同一群人重复，并找出真正缺的单品，从不代买。
entries.author: Cat

entries.name: Persuasion & Negotiation Coach
entries.summary: Coaches ethical persuasion and negotiation from Cialdini, Voss and free B2B frameworks, with short daily drills and reviews of your own sales or founder calls.
entries.summary_zh: 基于西奥迪尼、沃斯和免费 B2B 框架教你合乎道德的说服与谈判，每天短练习，并复盘你自己的销售或创始人通话。
entries.author: Craig

entries.name: Privacy Bot
entries.summary: Finds your name, phone, address and old emails on people-search sites, data brokers, forums and old accounts, submits removals you approve, rechecks in 30 days.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你的姓名、电话、住址和旧邮箱在人员搜索、数据经纪、论坛和旧账号上的痕迹，提交你批准的删除请求，30 天后复查。
entries.author: Mister

entries.name: Eddie — Fantasy Football GM
entries.summary: Fantasy football GM for Fantrax, Sleeper, ESPN or Yahoo: daily roster and FAAB syncs, waiver and trade analysis, pregame injury and weather checks.
entries.summary_zh: 梦幻橄榄球总经理，支持 Fantrax、Sleeper、ESPN、Yahoo：每日阵容和 FAAB 同步、自由球员与交易分析、赛前伤病和天气检查，每次调整都需你批准。
entries.author: Bill

entries.name: Perfect Play Store Launch
entries.summary: Helps indie devs ship an Android game to Google Play without rejection loops: a living launch checklist, fixes for common rejections, weekly policy scans.
entries.summary_zh: 帮独立开发者把安卓游戏顺利上架 Google Play、少走被拒循环：持续更新的上架清单、常见拒审的修复办法，以及每周政策变化扫描。
entries.author: Mister

entries.name: Housing Stress Bot
entries.summary: Builds a free, self-updating county-level US Housing Stress Map from 11 public data signals, monthly since January 2020.
entries.summary_zh: 用 11 项公开数据信号构建一张免费、自动更新的美国县级住房压力地图，按月覆盖 2020 年 1 月至今。
entries.author: Robert

entries.name: Trucking Bot
entries.summary: Bookkeeping for owner-operators and lease drivers: logs loads, fuel, trip meters and maintenance, imports weekly settlements, keeps totals ready for taxes.
entries.summary_zh: 给自有车司机和挂靠司机的记账助手：记录货单、油费、里程和保养，导入每周承运商结算，随时备好周、月、年合计用于报税。
entries.author: Lila

entries.name: Bookworm
entries.summary: Adds new books to your Calibre library with full metadata, sends them to your Kindle, and watches your authors and series for releases and deals.
entries.summary_zh: 个人书籍管家：把新书连同完整元数据加入 Calibre 书库、推送到 Kindle，并关注你追的作者和系列的新书、预售和优惠。
entries.author: Synk556

entries.name: X Growth Coach
entries.summary: Weekly X growth coach: your X Score (0-100) and a checklist, then top posts, best posting times and 5 drafts. Never posts or touches your account.
entries.summary_zh: 每周的 X 成长教练：先给出账号 X 分数（0-100）和待办清单，再列出热门帖、最佳发帖时间和 5 条可用草稿。从不发帖，也不碰你的账号。
entries.author: Marcio

entries.name: Coding Prompt Engineer
entries.summary: Keeps a sourced library of how top engineers prompt coding agents and use skills, updated daily from X, and writes steering prompts that stop repeat bugs.
entries.summary_zh: 维护一份有出处的资料库，收录顶尖工程师如何给编程代理写提示、用技能，每天从 X 更新，并写出让代理自查、杜绝重复 bug 的引导提示。
entries.author: Thomas

entries.name: Career Counseller
entries.summary: Five rounds of hard questions that show where your time leaks, what actually moves the needle and what to cut, ending in one prioritized action plan.
entries.summary_zh: 五轮尖锐提问，找出你的时间漏在哪、什么真正有用、该砍掉什么，最后给出一份排好优先级的行动计划。
entries.author: Shubh

entries.name: My Health Watch
entries.summary: A research team for your medical condition: every day, what's new for you, sourced and in plain English.
entries.summary_zh: 给你的病情配一个研究团队：每天告诉你与你相关的新进展，附出处，用大白话讲清楚。
entries.author: Kevin

entries.name: Spam-Call Scrubber
entries.summary: Finds your phone number on people-search sites, caller-ID apps and data brokers, submits opt-outs, handles the confirmation emails and rechecks on schedule.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你的电话号码出现在哪些人员搜索网站、来电识别应用和数据经纪商上，提交删除申请、处理确认邮件，并按计划复查。
entries.author: Don

entries.name: Archivist
entries.summary: Keeps a Grok Bot team's setups, notes and files safe with weekly dated Google Drive backups and a rebuild guide, so no bot is ever lost.
entries.summary_zh: 每周把 Grok Bot 团队的配置、笔记和文件按日期备份到 Google Drive，并附重建指南，任何 bot 都不会丢。
entries.author: DAVE

entries.name: Cyber Checkup
entries.summary: Weekly no-login security check of a small business's website and email: HTTPS, headers, SPF/DMARC, blocklists, lookalike domains, with a P0/P1/P2 fix list.
entries.summary_zh: 每周免登录检查小企业网站和邮箱安全：HTTPS、安全头、SPF/DMARC、黑名单、仿冒域名和已知漏洞软件，给出 P0/P1/P2 修复清单。
entries.author: Z23

entries.name: Deal Hunter
entries.summary: Rounds up the latest deals from X, Reddit, Slickdeals, Kinja Deals and more, sorted by category with dates and links. Ask for a digest, one item or a category.
entries.summary_zh: 汇总 X、Reddit、Slickdeals、Kinja Deals 等处的最新优惠，按类别整理并附日期和链接。可要每日摘要、某件商品或某一类的全部优惠。
entries.author: Carlo

entries.name: Daily Check-In Coach
entries.summary: Friendly coach that checks in each morning and evening, tracks habit streaks on a simple page and nudges you to wind down at bedtime. Voice or text.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的日常教练：每天早晚问候，在一个简单页面上记录习惯连续天数，睡前提醒你放松。语音或文字回复，无需连接应用。
entries.author: Ellodia

entries.name: Afiliado ML México
entries.summary: For Mercado Libre Mexico affiliates with no stock: finds products worth promoting, writes TikTok and Reels scripts, sorts your links. Spanish, no fake prices.
entries.summary_zh: 给不囤货的美客多墨西哥联盟推广者：找值得推的商品，写 TikTok 和 Reels 脚本，整理推广链接。西班牙语，不编造价格。
entries.author: Bryan

entries.name: Challenge Accepted
entries.summary: Steelman and devil's advocate for your plans and ideas: stress-tests non-trivial decisions so thin cases don't ship.
entries.summary_zh: 为你的计划和想法做最强辩护和魔鬼代言人，对重要决策做压力测试，论证单薄的方案别上线。
entries.author: Nitesh

entries.name: Angie
entries.summary: Ads owner for small products: runs Google Search and Meta lead ads, reviews the data daily, ships small tests and keeps total spend under a monthly cap.
entries.summary_zh: 小产品的广告负责人：投放 Google 搜索广告和 Meta 线索广告，每天看数据、做小测试，总花费控制在月度上限内。
entries.author: Anton

entries.name: Gift Finder
entries.summary: Helps land this year's hot, hard-to-get holiday gifts at a fair price: suggests toys by age, watches restocks and real price drops, pings only when worth it.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你以合理价格抢到今年热门难买的节日礼物：按年龄和兴趣推荐玩具，盯补货和真实降价，值得买时才提醒。
entries.author: Dirty

entries.name: Sponsorship Hunter
entries.summary: Finds brands and creator programs that pay creators in your niche, tracks them with fit scores and drafts pitches you approve before anything goes out.
entries.summary_zh: 找出在你领域付费合作创作者的品牌和创作者计划，按匹配度打分跟踪，起草合作邀约，你批准后才发出。
entries.author: Brandon

entries.name: Email Inbox Manager
entries.summary: Triages Gmail and Outlook: a short morning rundown of bills, deadlines and replies owed, a daily spam and promo cleanup, and reply drafts you send yourself.
entries.summary_zh: 整理 Gmail 和 Outlook：每天早上简报账单、截止日和欠的回复，每天清理垃圾和推广邮件，起草回复由你自己发送。
entries.author: Straight_Misses

entries.name: Mortgage Servicer Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: Escrow jump, force-placed insurance, PMI still on or a misapplied payment: drafts your notice of error and tracks the servicer's federal deadlines.
entries.summary_zh: 托管账户暴涨、被强制投保、PMI 未取消或还款被错记时：起草错误通知或信息请求，跟踪贷款服务商的联邦答复期限。非法律意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: NicheSiteWriter
entries.summary: Runs your niche content site: researched daily articles, SEO and answer-engine optimization, images, lead-magnet PDFs and newsletter drafts, all after your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 运营你的垂直内容网站：每天写有调研的文章，做 SEO 和答案引擎优化，配图、引流 PDF 和简报草稿，经你批准才发出。
entries.author: Jethro

entries.name: House Memory
entries.summary: Logs home maintenance, warranties and materials into your own spreadsheet from a photo or voice note (paint colors, filters, serials) and reminds you when due.
entries.summary_zh: 拍张照或说一句就把房屋保养、保修和材料（漆色、滤网型号、序列号等）记进你自己的表格，到期时提醒你。
entries.author: Kent

entries.name: Job Application Coach
entries.summary: Checks how well you fit a job, tailors your CV and cover letter, drafts application answers and preps interviews. Never invents experience; you press submit.
entries.summary_zh: 评估你和职位的匹配度，定制简历和求职信，起草申请表回答并帮你准备面试。从不编造经历，提交由你自己点。
entries.author: Queen

entries.name: Blitz
entries.summary: Fantasy football operator for one or more leagues: start/sit calls, waiver and matchup briefs, trade takes, lineup reminders. Never acts on your team unasked.
entries.summary_zh: 管理一个或多个梦幻橄榄球联赛：首发建议、自由球员和对阵简报、交易点评、阵容提醒。未经你同意从不改动球队。
entries.author: Kyle

entries.name: protocol bot
entries.summary: Audits your sites and apps for security, monitoring, concurrency, data loss and exposed databases, makes free fixes and keeps a launch checklist for new sites.
entries.summary_zh: 审查你的网站和应用的安全、监控、并发、数据丢失和数据库暴露问题，做免费修复，并为新站维护上线检查清单。
entries.author: jessie

entries.name: Purrfile
entries.summary: Your cat's private file and first responder: logs food, litter, weight, meds and moods, preps vet visits, and in a scare tells you plainly when to go now.
entries.summary_zh: 猫咪的私人档案和急救顾问：记录饮食、猫砂、体重、用药和情绪，准备看兽医，遇到紧急情况直说是否该马上去医院。
entries.author: Sam

entries.name: burrito
entries.summary: Finds the best burrito spots in New York City for where you are and what you're craving, with verified hours and what to order.
entries.summary_zh: 按你所在位置和口味找纽约最好的墨西哥卷饼店，附核实过的营业时间和推荐点什么。
entries.author: Alberto

entries.name: Trip Fix Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: When a flight or bag goes wrong: says what you're owed under US DOT or EU rules, warns before you take a voucher, drafts refund and bag claims, tracks them.
entries.summary_zh: 航班或行李出问题时：按美国交通部或欧盟规定告诉你能拿多少赔偿，接受代金券前提醒你，起草退款和行李索赔并跟踪到账。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Creator Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: Back office for Grok Bot template creators: tracks templates and share posts, warns before an edit breaks the Template Rewards 30-day rule, logs payouts.
entries.summary_zh: 给 Grok Bot 模板作者的后台：跟踪模板和分享帖，在修改会违反模板奖励 30 天规则前提醒，只读记录收益。从不发帖、改动或动钱。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: HomePilot
entries.summary: Keeps your Apple Home healthy: honest health checks, fixes it walks you through and double-checks, and safe automations designed for your real devices.
entries.summary_zh: 让你的 Apple 家庭保持健康：如实体检，带你一步步修复并复核，为你的真实设备设计安全的自动化。
entries.author: MOPROD

entries.name: Gatekeeper by SocialBrand
entries.summary: Security-first access control for bots sharing one computer: decides which bot may use which signed-in service, checks logins each weekday morning.
entries.summary_zh: 给共用一台电脑的多个 bot 做安全优先的权限管理：决定哪个 bot 能用哪个已登录服务，每个工作日早上检查登录状态。
entries.author: Pieter

entries.name: Estate Sale Bot
entries.summary: Watches local estate sales and live auctions, alerts you when something new or changed turns up and helps spot good finds in listing photos.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着本地的遗产拍卖和现场拍卖，有新内容或变动时提醒你，并帮你从列表照片里发现好东西。
entries.author: Kyle

entries.name: Canon
entries.summary: Continuity engine for writers and game designers building a multi-part world: keeps a living series bible, flags continuity risks, writes on-canon prompts.
entries.summary_zh: 给构建多部作品世界观的作者和游戏设计师的连续性引擎：维护活的系列设定集，标出前后矛盾风险，写符合设定的场景提示。
entries.author: Dindu

entries.name: X Trend Scout
entries.summary: Studies what works on X in your niche (trends, high-reply formats, fast-growing accounts, news) and feeds it to its partner X Post Crafter. Nothing auto-posts.
entries.summary_zh: 研究你所在领域在 X 上什么有效（趋势、高回复格式、快速增长账号、突发新闻），交给搭档 bot X Post Crafter 起草。不经审核不发帖。
entries.author: Gregory

entries.name: Mission Control
entries.summary: Fleet ops board for your Grok Bots: audits each bot daily, rates it red/yellow/green, forecasts plan usage and sends a dashboard and PDF of token-saving moves.
entries.summary_zh: Grok Bot 队伍的运营看板：每天审查每个 bot 并评红黄绿，预测套餐用量，发送交互式看板和 PDF，列出具体的省 token 做法。
entries.author: Tommy

entries.name: Social Media Manager
entries.summary: Runs your brand's Instagram and X: content calendar, visuals, scheduled posting from a signed-in browser after your approval, and every live link sent back.
entries.summary_zh: 运营品牌的 Instagram 和 X：排内容日历、做视觉素材，经你批准后用已登录浏览器按时发布，并发回每条上线链接。
entries.author: Vishvajeet

entries.name: Department Of Grok Bot Efficiency
entries.summary: Audits and streamlines your other Grok Bots: finds overlap and wasted usage, checks each bot's work against your ask, scouts X weekly for usage-saving tools.
entries.summary_zh: 审查并精简你的其他 Grok Bot：找出重叠和浪费的用量，按你的要求检查每个 bot 的产出，每周在 X 上找省用量的工具。
entries.author: just_stuff_tm

entries.name: Crate Digger
entries.summary: Answer a few questions about mood, plans and favourite era and get one album picked from 10,000+, with a link for your platform. Leans toward deep cuts.
entries.summary_zh: 回答几个关于心情、安排和喜欢年代的问题，从一万多张专辑里给你挑一张，附你所用平台的链接。偏爱冷门佳作。
entries.author: Melodies

entries.name: Impostor Radar
entries.summary: Say scan and it hunts X for accounts copying your name, handle, bio, avatar or posts and shows you the evidence. Never reports or DMs anyone.
entries.summary_zh: 说一声扫描，它就在 X 上找冒用你名字、账号、简介、头像或帖子的账号并给出证据。从不举报也不私信任何人。
entries.author: SoCalFSD

entries.name: Design
entries.summary: Designs a matching avatar for every bot on your team (3 options each) and gives your screens, sites and thumbnails a PASS or FAIL with numbered fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 为团队里每个 bot 设计配套头像（每个 3 个方案任选），并给你的界面、网站和缩略图判通过或不通过，附编号修改意见。
entries.author: Trond

entries.name: REA
entries.summary: Give it a product link, app or feature and it reverse-engineers how it works with the REA toolchain via Claude Code on your always-on Mac or Linux box.
entries.summary_zh: 给它一个产品链接、应用名或功能，它在你常开的 Mac 或 Linux 机器上通过 Claude Code 用 REA 工具链逆向分析其原理，交回一屏带证据的报告。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Table for 2
entries.summary: Finds great restaurants and books tables in any country, chatting in your own language, at home or while travelling.
entries.summary_zh: 在任何国家找好餐厅并订位，用你自己的语言沟通，在家或旅行时都能帮你安排晚餐。
entries.author: Goodluckbells

entries.name: Research Desk
entries.summary: Research and fact-check desk that answers fast from primary sources, with links, dates and a critical read of the evidence. Built for clinicians.
entries.summary_zh: 研究与事实核查台：快速从一手资料作答，附链接、日期和对证据的批判性解读。为临床医生及需要有据答案的人打造。
entries.author: DocBorelli

entries.name: Centelligence Brain Bot
entries.summary: A personal AI brain in your own Grok Bot: keeps priorities, people, decisions and promises in plain files and answers from them. Needs your own Modal account.
entries.summary_zh: 装在你自己 Grok Bot 里的个人 AI 大脑：把优先事项、人脉、决策和承诺存成纯文本文件，只根据已存内容回答。需你自己的 Modal 账号。
entries.author: Levi

entries.name: Santa
entries.summary: Christmas gift tracker that keeps your list, watches prices and pings you only when a gift hits your target or a real sale.
entries.summary_zh: 圣诞礼物追踪器：保存你的礼物清单、盯价格，只有礼物降到目标价或真打折时才提醒你。
entries.author: Griff

entries.name: Scam Text & Email Checker
entries.summary: Checks suspicious texts, emails and DMs for scam signs in any language: Likely legit, Be careful or Likely scam, with the red and green flags and next steps.
entries.summary_zh: 用任何语言检查可疑短信、邮件和私信：给出可能正常、需小心或可能是诈骗的结论，列出可疑和可信迹象以及下一步该做什么。
entries.author: giga

entries.name: Template Architect
entries.summary: Turns rough ideas, prompts or workflows into high-quality shareable Grok Bot instruction templates with clear scope, approval gates and copy-paste deliverables.
entries.summary_zh: 把粗略想法、现有提示或工作流变成高质量、可分享的 Grok Bot 指令模板，范围清晰、带审批关口和可直接复制的交付物。
entries.author: APlocks

entries.name: eBay/TCGplayer store manager
entries.summary: Runs a trading card store on eBay and TCGplayer: checks recent sold prices, reprices listings daily within safe limits, helps with listings, orders and stock.
entries.summary_zh: 打理你在 eBay 和 TCGplayer 上的卡牌店：查近期成交价，每天在安全范围内调价，协助上架、订单和库存。
entries.author: AutoAndre

entries.name: Deaf Assistant
entries.summary: Text-first helper for deaf and hard-of-hearing people: finds written ways around phone calls, doorbells, alarms and unsubtitled videos, drafts texts and emails.
entries.summary_zh: 给聋人和听障人士的文字优先助手：为电话、门铃、警报和无字幕视频找文字替代方案，起草短信和邮件供你确认。
entries.author: Auriukux

entries.name: 🛡️ Never-List Auditor
entries.summary: Read-only audit of what your bots can do without your yes: flags every spend, delete, send, post or password path and proposes the exact fix text.
entries.summary_zh: 只读审查你的 bot 不经你同意能做什么：标出每条花钱、删除、发送、发帖或涉及密码的路径，并给出具体的修改文字。
entries.author: prateek_budhwar

entries.name: Bank Dispute Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: When money leaves your account or card that shouldn't: sorts it under the right federal rule, starts deadlines the same day, drafts your dispute and tracks it.
entries.summary_zh: 账户或卡里的钱被不该扣走时：按正确的联邦规定归类，当天开始计算期限，起草争议申请，跟踪银行欠你什么、何时到期。非法律意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Car Maintenance Tracker
entries.summary: Tracks your car's service history, factory schedule, recalls, insurance and receipts on an easy tracker page, with reminders before things come due.
entries.summary_zh: 在一个易读的追踪页面上记录爱车的保养历史、原厂保养计划、召回、保险和票据，到期前提醒你。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: Renter Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: For renters: logs repair requests with a clock, checks rent and fees against your lease, tracks lease dates, gets your deposit back with your state rule cited.
entries.summary_zh: 给租客：记录报修请求并计时，按租约核对房租和费用，跟踪租期日期，引用本州规定按时拿回押金。每封信都由你自己发。非法律意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: 💬 Builder Reply Desk
entries.summary: Finds fresh posts from builders in your niche and drafts one useful reply each, posted only after your yes on the exact text. For small and mid-size X accounts.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你领域里开发者的新帖，每条起草一个有用的回复，你确认原文后才发布。适合靠互动成长的中小 X 账号。
entries.author: prateek_budhwar

entries.name: TrámiteX
entries.summary: Handles paperwork and reports in Mexico: files online reports with CFE, water, city hall, SAT, SRE, vehicle control and Profeco, and follows up until resolved.
entries.summary_zh: 墨西哥办事助手：在线向电力公司、水务、市政、税务局、外交部、车管和消费者保护局提交报告和申请，并跟进到解决。
entries.author: Gilly

entries.name: Show Companion
entries.summary: Fan-facing helper for your live show or podcast: searches transcripts for quotes and episodes, writes weekly recaps and speaker profiles, takes guest inquiries.
entries.summary_zh: 面向听众的直播或播客助手：在文字稿里搜索金句和期数，写每周回顾和嘉宾介绍，提供节目信息并接收嘉宾咨询。
entries.author: dcbk2la

entries.name: Shed Sales Pipeline
entries.summary: Prospecting and lead follow-up for local shed and portable-building dealers: finds prospects on the public web, drafts first messages and call scripts for OK.
entries.summary_zh: 给本地棚屋和移动房经销商的获客与线索跟进：从公开网络找潜在客户，起草首封消息、跟进和电话脚本，经你批准才发。
entries.author: Dindu

entries.name: City & School Scout
entries.summary: Compares metros and suburbs you name on family fit (taxes, housing, schools, homeschool rules, safety, weather, church, jobs) from primary sources.
entries.summary_zh: 按家庭适配度比较你指定的城市和郊区（税负、住房、学校与在家教育规定、活动、治安、天气、教会、就业），基于一手资料给出不吹捧的评分。
entries.author: Click

entries.name: Firstmate Builder
entries.summary: Thin relay to Claude Code on your always-on Mac or Linux box: hands coding jobs to Firstmate over Tailscale and brings back draft PRs and real blockers.
entries.summary_zh: 连接你常开的 Mac 或 Linux 上 Claude Code 的轻量中继：经 Tailscale 把编程任务交给 Firstmate，带回可合并的草稿 PR 和真正的阻塞点。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Ghost Subscription Hunter
entries.summary: Finds and cancels forgotten subscriptions for small businesses and creators: builds a ledger from receipts or statements, flags waste, asks before each change.
entries.summary_zh: 帮小企业主和创作者找出并取消被遗忘的订阅：从收据或账单建立台账，标出浪费，每次续订或取消前先问你。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Style Scout
entries.summary: Sale hunter for clothes and shoes: weekly hunt or any sale page you paste, confirms your exact size is in stock and only messages you with a real find.
entries.summary_zh: 服装鞋履打折猎手：每周搜一次，或扫描你贴来的任何促销页，确认你的尺码确实有货，只有真捡到好货才通知你。
entries.author: Reid

entries.name: Samsung TV Privacy & Debloat
entries.summary: Helps Samsung smart-TV owners turn off viewing-data tracking (ACR), ads and voice listening and trim bloat, from safe settings up to network blocking.
entries.summary_zh: 帮三星智能电视用户关闭收视数据追踪（ACR）、广告和语音监听，精简预装软件，从安全设置一步步到网络屏蔽和开发者工具。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: Solo
entries.summary: One-person helper for social posts and ads: drafts copy in your voice, hands art to your Brand Design Bot, and never posts or spends without your KEEP.
entries.summary_zh: 一人团队的社媒发帖和广告助手：用你的口吻写文案，把美术交给你的品牌设计 bot，没有你的 KEEP 从不发帖或花钱。
entries.author: Kelly

entries.name: Prize Finder
entries.summary: Finds legit, free-to-enter sweepstakes, giveaways and free samples you qualify for, and can enter them for you with your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你有资格参加的正规免费抽奖、赠品活动和免费试用装，经你同意可代为报名。
entries.author: GoulahAI

entries.name: Bookmarks X
entries.summary: Reads your X bookmarks and folders, keeps local state and twice a week sends a short prioritized digest grouped by topic. Never posts or deletes. Spanish.
entries.summary_zh: 读取你的 X 书签和收藏夹，在本地记录状态，每周两次按主题发一份简短的优先级摘要。从不发帖或删书签。西班牙语。
entries.author: Chorch

entries.name: Leave Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: Taking family or medical leave: checks if FMLA covers you, tracks your and your employer's paperwork deadlines, drafts leave and accommodation requests.
entries.summary_zh: 申请家庭或医疗假时：判断 FMLA 是否适用，跟踪你和雇主的文件期限，起草休假和便利安排申请，记录出现的问题。非法律或医疗意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Scam Shield
entries.summary: A calm second opinion on any text, email, call, popup or deal that feels off: a clear verdict, a simple explanation and what to do. For non-techy people.
entries.summary_zh: 对任何感觉不对劲的短信、邮件、电话、弹窗或交易给出冷静的第二意见：明确结论、简单解释和具体该怎么做。为不懂技术的普通人设计。
entries.author: KM

entries.name: Ace
entries.summary: Lead and site auditor for your site-builder bots: audits live sites for SEO/AEO, UI/UX, speed and affiliate link health, keeps a daily priority board.
entries.summary_zh: 统筹你的建站 bot 并审查网站：检查已上线网站的 SEO/AEO、UI/UX、速度和联盟链接健康，维护每日优先级看板，不擅自部署或花钱。
entries.author: Yuval

entries.name: Lumy
entries.summary: Every morning, one short real quote, powerful idea or useful fact, with a line on how to apply it today. Verified sources, varied topics, no repeats.
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上一句真实名言、一个有力观点或一个实用事实，附一句今天如何运用。来源已核实，话题多样，不重复。
entries.author: Gil

entries.name: College Copilot
entries.summary: Name your school and it finds every deadline, quiz and exam across your classes, builds a visual semester dashboard and briefs you each morning.
entries.summary_zh: 说出你的学校，它找出所有课程的截止日、小测和考试，做一个可视化学期看板，并每天早上给你简报。
entries.author: Owen

entries.name: Shopify Store Assistant
entries.summary: Sets up, runs and grows a Shopify store, from first launch to listings, SEO, email flows, ads, promos, support and fraud checks. Nothing goes live without yes.
entries.summary_zh: 从零搭建、运营和扩展 Shopify 店铺：首次上线、商品、SEO、利润、转化、邮件流程、广告、促销、客服和防欺诈检查，经你同意才上线。
entries.author: goyabean

entries.name: Interactive AI Story Studio
entries.summary: Builds and runs a daily interactive AI story series for Shorts and Reels with a locked cast and set, daily trend scans and A/B audience voting.
entries.summary_zh: 制作并运营每日更新的互动 AI 故事短视频系列（Shorts 和 Reels），固定角色和场景，每日扫描趋势并让观众 A/B 投票。
entries.author: Kevin

entries.name: CEO Bot
entries.summary: A CEO for your bot team: structures teams around your goals, proposes hires for approval, assigns daily work to specialist bots and sends one clear report.
entries.summary_zh: 你 bot 团队的 CEO：围绕目标搭建团队，提议新增 bot 供你批准，每天给专职 bot 分派工作，并发一份清晰报告说明完成了什么、什么需要你。
entries.author: hong

entries.name: Scholarship Scout
entries.summary: Finds scholarships, grants and fellowships you or a family member actually qualify for, flags scams and drafts essays for your review.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你或家人真正有资格申请的奖学金、助学金和研究资助，标出骗局，并起草申请文书供你审阅。
entries.author: Hudson

entries.name: Tech Stack Miner
entries.summary: For the accounts a seller names, finds public evidence of the tools each company runs (job posts, case studies, talks) and logs it, every finding sourced.
entries.summary_zh: 针对销售指定的目标客户，从招聘、客户案例、演讲等公开信息找出每家公司在用的工具并记录下来，每条都有出处。只读，不写外联。
entries.author: Jacob

entries.name: Haggle Bot
entries.summary: Lowers your recurring bills: finds what you pay in your email, researches better local prices and writes honest negotiation plans. Contacts no one without OK.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你降低固定账单：从邮件里找出你在付什么，调研本地更优价格，写出友善诚实的议价方案。未经你同意不联系任何公司。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: Car Review
entries.summary: Send a used-car listing or CARFAX and get a straight buy-or-pass verdict: accidents, owners, recalls, warranty, reliability, fair price and out-the-door cost.
entries.summary_zh: 发来二手车链接或 CARFAX 报告，得到买或不买的明确结论：事故、车主数、召回、保修、可靠性、合理价格以及落地总价和月供。
entries.author: Abhilash

entries.name: Art-Direction Web Designer
entries.summary: Paste your URL or describe your product: it picks a real art direction for your brand, counts every AI-template tell and rebuilds the page so it looks designed.
entries.summary_zh: 贴上网址或描述产品，它为品牌选定真正的美术方向，数出所有 AI 模板痕迹，并重做页面让它看起来像设计过的。
entries.author: Daniel

entries.name: Scam Shield
entries.summary: Watches your X DMs and message requests on a schedule and warns about likely scammers with a score, red flags and the scam type. Read-only; you decide.
entries.summary_zh: 定时查看你的 X 私信和消息请求，对可能的骗子给出评分、具体可疑点和诈骗类型。只读，只提建议，由你决定。
entries.author: Sarah

entries.name: Online Vehicle Buyer
entries.summary: Watches online listings for the exact used car, truck, SUV or EV you want, checks specs and recalls by VIN, tracks trade-in and financing. Never buys unasked.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着网上的二手车源，找你想要的那款轿车、皮卡、SUV 或电动车，按 VIN 核对配置和召回，跟踪置换和贷款。未经同意从不下单。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Aegis
entries.summary: Security lock-down operator: finds weak spots in your own accounts, devices and networks, applies the fixes you approve one step at a time, reports what's left.
entries.summary_zh: 安全加固操作员：找出你自己账号、设备和网络的薄弱点，逐步落实你批准的修复，并报告剩余风险。
entries.author: Rob

entries.name: Medicare Appeals Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: When Medicare or a plan says no, or a hospital or rehab stay is ending: finds the right appeal and deadline, drafts the request and doctor letter, tracks it.
entries.summary_zh: 当 Medicare 或其计划拒绝、或住院康复即将结束时：找到正确的申诉途径和期限，起草申请和医生信，跟踪每一级进展。非医疗或法律意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Social Security Letter Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: Got an SSA overpayment, benefit cut or Medicare surcharge letter? Finds the 30- and 60-day dates, picks the right form, drafts your side, tracks the answer.
entries.summary_zh: 收到社保局多付追缴、福利削减或 Medicare 附加费通知？找出 30 天和 60 天期限，选对豁免、申诉或降费表格，起草你的陈述并跟踪答复。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Brand Design Bot
entries.summary: Brand designer for small businesses: brand cards, post graphics, headers, doc templates, thumbnails and video concepts, always 2-3 options, live only on KEEP.
entries.summary_zh: 给小企业的品牌设计师：品牌卡、帖子配图、头图、文档模板、缩略图和视频创意，每次给 2-3 个方案，你说 KEEP 才上线。
entries.author: Kelly

entries.name: Penny
entries.summary: Warm, practical personal finance assistant: bill reminders, a weekly money check-in and help catching up on past-due bills. Never pays or contacts anyone.
entries.summary_zh: 温暖务实的个人理财助手：账单提醒、每周理财检查，帮你补上逾期账单。从不替你付款或联系任何人。
entries.author: Caitlin

entries.name: Cold Outreach
entries.summary: Give it your company URL: it researches your business, finds and scores prospects, writes short cold emails, sends from your inbox with OK, tracks on a page.
entries.summary_zh: 给它公司网址：它调研你的业务，寻找并评分潜在客户，写简短的个性化开发信，经你同意从你的邮箱发出，并在实时页面上跟踪。
entries.author: Jack

entries.name: Viral Content Engine
entries.summary: Runs your X and Facebook like a viral team: studies what's going viral in your niche, writes posts in your voice, makes images, schedules in Buffer.
entries.summary_zh: 像爆款内容团队一样运营你的 X 和 Facebook：研究领域内的爆款，用你的口吻写帖、做配图，在 Buffer 排期，并在 Notion 复盘效果。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Family Security Coach
entries.summary: Patient coach that locks down your accounts, phone and money in 15-minute steps, checks trusted sources for new threats and helps protect your family.
entries.summary_zh: 耐心的安全教练：每次 15 分钟一步步加固你的账号、手机和资金，每天查看可信来源的新威胁，用可打印指南帮你保护家人。从不索要密码。
entries.author: Eduardo

entries.name: Next Bird
entries.summary: Bird-photography assistant: uses recent eBird sightings to say where to go nearby for species you haven't shot yet, flags rarities, can send a morning report.
entries.summary_zh: 鸟类摄影助手：根据最近的 eBird 观测记录告诉你附近去哪能拍到还没拍过的鸟，标出稀有鸟种，附参考照片，可每天早上发报告。
entries.author: Forrest

entries.name: Unify Monitor
entries.summary: Keeps a read-only eye on your Ubiquiti UniFi networks and sends a daily health report with offline devices, WAN status and speed tests.
entries.summary_zh: 只读监控你的 Ubiquiti UniFi 网络，每天发送健康报告，包括离线设备、WAN 状态和测速结果。
entries.author: Terry

entries.name: Claim Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: Helps a homeowner run their own insurance claim after a storm, leak or fire: tracks deadlines with the state rule cited, logs calls, drafts every letter.
entries.summary_zh: 帮房主在暴风、漏水或火灾后自己办理保险理赔：引用本州规定跟踪期限，记录通话，起草每封信由你发送。非法律意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Last Call
entries.summary: Catches free trials you sign up for, warns a few days before they turn into a charge and offers to cancel them for you.
entries.summary_zh: 记下你注册的免费试用，在转为扣费前几天提醒你，并可代你取消。
entries.author: Nick

entries.name: Reply Guy Filter
entries.summary: Cleans up your X replies: a daily digest with real conversations first, each with a draft reply idea, and spam and scam accounts flagged for blocking.
entries.summary_zh: 清理你的 X 回复：每天一份摘要，真实对话排前面并附回复思路，垃圾和诈骗账号标出供你拉黑。未经批准不发任何内容。
entries.author: Allan

entries.name: Dreamline
entries.summary: Job-hunt coach: checks fit, tailors your resume honestly, tracks applications and follow-ups, and builds a prep sheet and mock interviews when one lands.
entries.summary_zh: 求职教练：评估匹配度，如实定制简历，跟踪申请和跟进；面试排进日历时准备资料并陪你模拟面试。未经同意不投递不发送。
entries.author: Johnson

entries.name: Debt Collector Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: When debt collectors call or write: checks each contact against federal rules, tracks your 30-day dispute window, drafts letters, flags court papers same day.
entries.summary_zh: 应对催收：按联邦催收规定核对每次联系，跟踪 30 天异议期，起草信件，当天标出法院文书。所有信件由你发送。非法律意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Remodel Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: The homeowner's side of a remodel: compares bids, checks the contract, matches payments to finished work, tracks change orders and lien waivers.
entries.summary_zh: 站在房主一边管装修：比较报价、审合同、按完工情况核对每笔付款、跟踪变更单和留置权放弃书，起草每条消息由你发送。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Odyssey Scenario Runner
entries.summary: Text RPG game master that turns the Odyssey, or any epic, transcript or scene you share, into a playable adventure with choices and branching consequences.
entries.summary_zh: 文字角色扮演游戏主持人：把《奥德赛》或你分享的任何史诗、文稿、场景变成可玩的冒险，有生动场景、选择和分支后果。
entries.author: Jay

entries.name: Neo
entries.summary: Full-stack programmer, security, sysadmin and Linux expert: helps with code, servers, hardening and day-to-day ops.
entries.summary_zh: 全栈程序员、数字安全、系统管理和 Linux 专家：帮你写代码、管服务器、做安全加固和日常运维。
entries.author: APlocks

entries.name: Mr Bot Goes to Washington
entries.summary: Nonpartisan Capitol Hill desk: tracks new bills twice daily, writes plain-English briefs, finds the right staff contact and keeps the Hill calendar.
entries.summary_zh: 无党派的国会山工作台：每天两次跟踪新法案，写通俗的法案简报，找到对应议题的幕僚联系人，维护听证、投票、招待会和职位日历。
entries.author: Marshall

entries.name: Disaster Aid Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: After a declared disaster: reads every FEMA letter, finds what's missing, starts the 60-day appeal clock, drafts your appeal, keeps insurance and SBA straight.
entries.summary_zh: 灾害宣布后：读懂每封 FEMA 来信，找出缺什么材料，启动 60 天申诉倒计时，起草申诉，理清保险、SBA 和 FEMA 的钱。非法律意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Dink Bot
entries.summary: Turns pickleball doubles score sheets (photos, PDFs or typed) into a CSV for DUPR's club match importer and keeps stats. You upload; it never logs into DUPR.
entries.summary_zh: 把匹克球双打记分表（照片、PDF 或手打）转成 DUPR 俱乐部比赛导入用的 CSV，并统计数据。由你上传，它从不登录 DUPR。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: Batch-Cook Kitchen
entries.summary: Cook once, feed the family all week: plans 3-5 batch anchors from your pantry, with adaptations for babies, toddlers, picky kids and grown-ups.
entries.summary_zh: 做一次吃一周：根据你现有食材规划 3-5 道批量主菜，并为婴儿、幼儿、挑食孩子和大人分别调整。给有小孩的忙碌家庭。
entries.author: Valen

entries.name: Horror Shorts Studio
entries.summary: Writes original AI horror and mystery short stories and turns them into vertical Reels and Shorts with narration, eerie visuals and subtitles.
entries.summary_zh: 写原创 AI 恐怖悬疑短故事，并做成带旁白、诡异画面和字幕的竖屏 Reels 和 Shorts 视频。
entries.author: Salih

entries.name: Local Presence & Review Desk
entries.summary: Weekly check-up for local businesses: your Google profile, new reviews and website basics, with review replies drafted for approval. Never posts on its own.
entries.summary_zh: 本地商家每周体检：Google 商家资料、新评价和网站基础项，起草评价回复等你批准。从不自行发布或回复。
entries.author: Z23

entries.name: Bill & Budget Buddy
entries.summary: Plain-English money helper: builds a simple monthly budget, reminds you before bills are due, spots subscriptions to cut, writes call scripts to lower bills.
entries.summary_zh: 大白话理财助手：做简单的月度预算，账单到期前提醒，找出可砍的订阅，写打电话降费的话术。一般性建议，非专业理财意见。
entries.author: dale

entries.name: Digger
entries.summary: Career intelligence by email: interviews you or someone you love, builds an evidence-based career profile in Drive and sends a selective weekly job digest.
entries.summary_zh: 通过邮件做职业情报：采访你或你的家人，在 Drive 里建立有依据的职业档案，每周发一份精选职位摘要。从不投递或联系雇主。
entries.author: Dave

entries.name: Omaha
entries.summary: Sets up an Omalauncher home-screen widget of your Grok Bots on Android: builds a private feed in your GitHub repo with unread counts and tap-to-open chats.
entries.summary_zh: 在安卓 Omalauncher 上为你的 Grok Bot 设置主屏小组件：在你自己的 GitHub 仓库建私有数据源，显示未读数，点一下即可打开对话。
entries.author: Joshua

entries.name: The Walk-Away
entries.summary: Scores a live sales page the way a stranger would: Pass or Walk, with the exact line, the buyer fear and the smallest fix.
entries.summary_zh: 像陌生访客一样给线上销售页打分：通过或离开，指出具体哪一句、买家的顾虑和最小的修改。
entries.author: Joshua

entries.name: Bot Beginner: Your First 7 Days
entries.summary: New to Grok Bot? A friendly coach with one small tip a day for 7 days and one tiny thing to try each time. Say 'next tip' to go faster.
entries.summary_zh: 刚上手 Grok Bot？友好的教练连续 7 天每天一个小技巧，每次附一个可以试的小动作。说“下一条”可以加快进度。
entries.author: John

entries.name: Dr. Bot
entries.summary: Personal medical assistant that tracks symptoms of any condition, plus meds, sleep and labs, with a warm daily check-in. Never diagnoses or changes meds.
entries.summary_zh: 个人医疗助手：长期记录任何疾病的症状以及用药、睡眠和化验结果，每天温和地问候。从不诊断，也不更改用药。
entries.author: sarah

entries.name: Bot Router: Talk to Any Bot
entries.summary: Gives every outside bot one front door and relays each message to whichever of your bots owns that relationship, without passing keys around in chat.
entries.summary_zh: 给所有外部 bot 一个统一入口，把每条消息转给负责该关系的那个 bot，全程不在聊天里传递密钥。
entries.author: Ken

entries.name: Game Dev Pro
entries.summary: Make a game in a day: takes your HTML5 game from idea to brief, build, testing and a live arcade page, with 2-player add-ons, thumbnails and platform checks.
entries.summary_zh: 一天做出一个游戏：把你的 HTML5 游戏从想法带到需求、开发、测试和上线的街机页面，内置双人模式、玩法缩略图和平台检查。
entries.author: Rob

entries.name: QR Creator
entries.summary: Turns any website into a free static QR code that never expires: checks the link, places the code on your image, scans the result to confirm, keeps a tracker.
entries.summary_zh: 把任何网址变成永不过期的免费静态二维码：检查链接真实有效，把码放到你的图片上，扫描成品确认可用，并记录在追踪表里。
entries.author: Jay

entries.name: Grok Bot Setup Coach
entries.summary: Walks a new owner through a working Grok Bot setup in one sitting: bot email, connectors, first skill and routine, weekly backup, avatar and a 'my bot' card.
entries.summary_zh: 一次带新用户完成可用的 Grok Bot 设置：bot 邮箱、连接器、第一个技能和例程、每周备份、头像和可分享的 bot 名片。改动前先展示。
entries.author: Pieter

entries.name: Lane Carrier Finder
entries.summary: Carrier sourcing for independent freight brokers: finds for-hire carriers near your lanes in FMCSA data, vets authority, insurance and safety, flags fraud.
entries.summary_zh: 给独立货运经纪人找承运商：从 FMCSA 免费数据里找你线路附近的承运商，核查经营资质、保险和安全记录，标出欺诈迹象，起草介绍邮件。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Echo
entries.summary: Personal continuity and reflection bot: keeps a living record of your goals, projects and decisions, checks in on your cadence, writes past-self notes.
entries.summary_zh: 个人延续与反思 bot：持续记录你的目标、项目和决策，按你设定的频率问候，写基于事实的“过去的你”笔记和模式总结。
entries.author: Dindu

entries.name: Usage Meter
entries.summary: Watches your Grok and Grok Bot usage meters, sends a daily report with charts and warns early before a limit locks you out.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着你的 Grok 和 Grok Bot 用量，每天发带图表的报告，在额度用尽锁住前提前提醒。
entries.author: Rob

entries.name: Bot Team Pack
entries.summary: A ready-made team of six bots (Hub, Email & Calendar, Tasks, Finance, Critic, Architect) sharing one lean rule set. Add once and Architect sets up the rest.
entries.summary_zh: 现成的六个 bot 团队（总台、邮件日历、任务、财务、评审、架构师），共用一套精简的隐私、消息和安全规则。添加一次，架构师搭好其余部分。
entries.author: Jacob

entries.name: Reddit Deep Mystery Hunter
entries.summary: Every two hours finds one fresh, archive-verified Reddit story across 10 curious niches (mysteries, dark psychology, confessions and more). No Reddit API.
entries.summary_zh: 每两小时从 10 个猎奇领域（悬案、黑暗心理学、告白、哲学等）找一个新鲜且经存档核实的 Reddit 故事，按 30 个一轮收集。无需 Reddit API。
entries.author: Ace

entries.name: 🔒 Exact-Text Gate
entries.summary: Posts on X without a rogue agent: shows the exact text, posts only after your yes on those words, checks duplicates, strips stray mentions, confirms it's live.
entries.summary_zh: 让代理发 X 帖不失控：先展示原文，你确认这几个字后才发，检查重复、去掉多余提及，并确认帖子已上线。
entries.author: prateek_budhwar

entries.name: Bot Activity Dashboard
entries.summary: A chief of staff that keeps a live 3-column dashboard of what all your Grok Bots are doing, what's waiting on you and how active each bot is.
entries.summary_zh: 幕僚长 bot：维护一个实时三栏看板，显示所有 Grok Bot 在做什么、什么在等你处理、每个 bot 有多活跃。
entries.author: david

entries.name: Yard Pulse
entries.summary: Local intelligence for sellers of sheds, portable buildings and yard goods: watches weather windows, marketplaces, competitors and seasonal demand.
entries.summary_zh: 给棚屋、移动房、设备和庭院用品卖家的本地情报 bot：盯天气窗口、本地交易平台、竞争对手和季节性需求，有可行动的情况才说话。
entries.author: Dindu

entries.name: 🧾 Ops Ledger
entries.summary: One run log, checkpoints for long tasks and dated snapshots of your bots' rules, so a reset never means guessing. Restores from backup only with your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 一份运行日志、长任务检查点和 bot 规则的带日期快照，重置后不用靠猜。只在你同意后从备份恢复，从不凭记忆。
entries.author: prateek_budhwar

entries.name: Legal Awareness Model
entries.summary: Builds a personal map of the laws and regulations that touch your life and work, linked to the official text. Not legal advice; a way to learn the rules.
entries.summary_zh: 为你绘制一张涉及你生活和工作的法律法规地图，附官方原文链接。不是法律意见，而是让你自己读懂真实规则。
entries.author: Bennett

entries.name: Smile More Case Watch ⚖️
entries.summary: Follows Roman Atwood's Smile More trademark lawsuit against American Eagle, explains each update in plain English and only messages when something changes.
entries.summary_zh: 跟踪 Roman Atwood 的 Smile More 商标诉讼（对 American Eagle），用大白话解释每次进展。每个工作日检查，有变化才通知。
entries.author: Jermball

entries.name: Privacy Cleanup
entries.summary: Finds where your phone number and personal info show up on people-search sites and files the removal requests for you.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你的电话号码和个人信息出现在哪些人员搜索网站，并替你提交删除申请。
entries.author: Jordan

entries.name: Independent Artist Business Manager
entries.summary: Business manager for independent artists: sales, shop consignment, outreach, content planning and records, with nothing going out without your approval.
entries.summary_zh: 独立艺术家的经纪人：负责销售、本地店铺寄售、对外联系、内容规划和记录，让你专心创作。未经批准不发出任何内容。
entries.author: M

entries.name: taco
entries.summary: Finds the best taco spots in New York City for where you are and what you're craving, with ranked, verified picks and what to order.
entries.summary_zh: 按你所在位置和口味找纽约最好的塔可店，给出排名和核实过的推荐，附推荐点什么。
entries.author: Alberto

entries.name: Token Cop
entries.summary: Shows every place your AI usage goes, lets you set rules and checks them daily, warning you before a limit or bill catches you out. Runs on your plan.
entries.summary_zh: 让你看清 AI 用量都花在哪，自己设规则，每天检查，在额度或账单出意外前提醒你。在现有套餐上运行，未经同意不做改动。
entries.author: Pieter

entries.name: Roommate Keeper
entries.summary: Keeps a shared flat running fairly: rotates chores, splits shared bills, tracks who owes whom and drafts friendly, neutral reminders.
entries.summary_zh: 让合租生活公平运转：轮换家务、分摊共同账单、记录谁欠谁，并起草友好中立的提醒，减轻“管家”室友的负担。
entries.author: Cristopher

entries.name: Zeabur 搬家大哥
entries.summary: Moves a Zeabur project to Railway end to end: inventory, redeploy, database migration and Cloudflare domain cutover, all the way to live. Traditional Chinese.
entries.summary_zh: 把 Zeabur 项目一条龙搬到 Railway：盘点、重建部署、迁移数据库、切换 Cloudflare 域名，一直做到上线。繁体中文。
entries.author: 太濕啦

entries.name: Spam Shield
entries.summary: Cuts US spam calls and texts: Do Not Call registration, FTC reports you review, 7726 text forwarding, a spam log and a monthly check-in.
entries.summary_zh: 帮美国用户减少骚扰电话和短信：登记拒绝来电名单、你审核过的 FTC 举报、7726 短信转发、骚扰记录和每月检查。
entries.author: Allan

entries.name: Feature Watch
entries.summary: Watches the App Store and Google Play for your games and pings you the first time one gets featured, a banner or Editors' Choice in a new country.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着 App Store 和 Google Play 上你的所有游戏，任何一款首次在新国家获推荐、上横幅或获编辑精选时通知你。
entries.author: Ovidiu

entries.name: OSRS Accountant
entries.summary: Coordinates Old School RuneScape Grand Exchange flip and high-alch bots, validates their live prices and delivers one ranked, sourced money-making report.
entries.summary_zh: 统筹《老派 RuneScape》大交易所倒卖和高级炼金 bot，核实实时价格，汇总成一份有排名、有出处的赚金报告。
entries.author: kaleb

entries.name: Subscription Detox
entries.summary: Finds every subscription, hidden Apple charge and direct debit, shows what you spend each month, then cancels the ones you don't want for you.
entries.summary_zh: 找出所有订阅、隐藏的 Apple 扣费和自动扣款，告诉你每月实际花多少，再替你取消不想要的。
entries.author: Hoem

entries.name: Scam-Job Checker
entries.summary: Checks job posts, recruiter messages and offers in English or Spanish for scam signs, with a clear verdict, sourced red and green flags and the safe next step.
entries.summary_zh: 检查英文或西班牙文的招聘信息、猎头消息和录用通知是否为诈骗，给出明确结论、有出处的可疑和可信迹象以及最安全的下一步。
entries.author: giga

entries.name: Roof CEO
entries.summary: Marketing team lead for residential roofing companies: runs Meta ad campaigns, creative, lead follow-up and daily storm monitoring through specialist bots.
entries.summary_zh: 住宅屋顶公司的营销团队负责人：通过一组专职 bot 运营 Meta 广告、素材、线索跟进和每日风暴监测，并汇报清晰的下一步。
entries.author: Lee

entries.name: X Follower Randomizer
entries.summary: Every night picks 10 random verified followers of your X account, screens out bots and promo accounts, and hands you a ready-to-paste shoutout post.
entries.summary_zh: 每晚从你的 X 认证粉丝里随机挑 10 位，筛掉机器人和推广号，给你一条可直接粘贴的点名感谢帖，由你自己发。
entries.author: Lightning

entries.name: 乗り過ごし番
entries.summary: Stops you missing your train stop: send your destination and it sets phone alarms just before your transfer and exit stations. Japanese.
entries.summary_zh: 防止坐过站：发送目的地，它就在换乘站和下车站前一点给手机设闹钟。酒后回家、通勤通学都适用。日语。
entries.author: RYO

entries.name: Pawfile
entries.summary: Your dog's private file and first responder: records, meds, vaccines and vet visits, sitter sheets and lost-dog kits, and plain advice on when to see a vet now.
entries.summary_zh: 狗狗的私人档案和急救顾问：记录病历、用药、疫苗和就诊，准备寄养说明和走失应急包，紧急时直说是否该马上看兽医。不是兽医。
entries.author: Sam

entries.name: Lucy
entries.summary: A maker and big-project thinker who turns ambitious ideas into clear plans and finishable projects: bots, apps or creative side projects.
entries.summary_zh: 创客型的大项目思考者：把雄心勃勃的想法变成清晰的计划和能真正完成的项目，适合做 bot、应用或创意副业的人。
entries.author: Martha

entries.name: Bargain Hunter
entries.summary: Daily on-sale scout: finds discounted deals across stores in your country, then checks eBay, Etsy, Gumroad and Shopify for 30%+ net resale profit. You buy.
entries.summary_zh: 每日全国折扣侦察：找出你所在国家各商店的打折商品，再查 eBay、Etsy、Gumroad、Shopify 等平台是否有 30% 以上的净转卖利润。由你购买。
entries.author: Jake

entries.name: Car Repo Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: When a car loan is behind or the car was taken: gets your belongings back, reads the sale notice, tracks your redemption window, checks any bill after sale.
entries.summary_zh: 车贷逾期或车被收回时：帮你取回车内物品，读懂拍卖通知，跟踪赎回期限，核查拍卖后的账单，起草每封信由你发送。非法律意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Payout Pilot
entries.summary: Insurance claims assistant for any policy and country: builds a policy register, finds receipts in Gmail and Drive, files after your yes, chases and appeals.
entries.summary_zh: 适用任何保单和国家的理赔助手：建立保单登记表，从 Gmail 和 Drive 找票据并核对，经你同意在保险公司网站提交，催办慢理赔并起草拒赔申诉。
entries.author: Al

entries.name: The Billionaire Mentor
entries.summary: A mentor built from the decision-making principles of the world's most successful billionaires, on call whenever you need it.
entries.summary_zh: 以全球最成功亿万富翁的决策原则打造的导师，随时待命。
entries.author: Si

entries.name: One-Person Product Business Bot
entries.summary: Runs a small digital-product business with you: researches, drafts posts and replies, keeps a shared task board and checks for stuck tasks.
entries.summary_zh: 和你一起经营小型数字产品生意：做调研、起草帖子和回复、维护共享任务看板并检查卡住的任务。经你同意才上线。
entries.author: dcowboys

entries.name: X Safety Bot
entries.summary: Reviews your X posts and replies nightly for spam patterns, reply bursts and rule risks that could get you limited, with a recap of links and fixes. Read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 每晚检查你的 X 帖子和回复里可能导致限流或影子封禁的垃圾模式、刷屏回复和违规风险，发一份附链接、严重度和修改建议的总结。只读。
entries.author: Damian

entries.name: Livestream Raffle Host
entries.summary: Runs chat-command raffles during your X livestreams: collects entries, draws winners fairly, publishes a results page and preps X Money payouts for approval.
entries.summary_zh: 在你的 X 直播中运行聊天口令抽奖：收集报名、公平抽取中奖者、发布结果看板，并准备 X Money 奖金发放等你批准。
entries.author: J

entries.name: School Meeting Prep
entries.summary: Get ready for your child's school health meeting: what to ask the doctor to write down, questions for the school and a follow-up log.
entries.summary_zh: 为孩子的学校健康会议做准备：该请医生写明什么、要问学校的问题，以及后续跟进记录。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Make It a 10
entries.summary: Assumes your work is a 3/10 and shows what gets it to 7 and 10: scores writing, code, designs or plans, critiques its own review, hands back top 3 fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 假设你的作品只有 3 分，告诉你怎样到 7 分和 10 分：按你选的维度给文章、代码、设计或计划打分，再自审一遍，交回三大修改点和重写版。
entries.author: Luke

entries.name: Global Alert
entries.summary: Personal alerts desk: on demand scans weather, transport, power, unrest, health, scams, cyber and money news, verifies it and says what affects you first.
entries.summary_zh: 个人预警与新闻台：按需扫描天气、交通、电力、动乱、卫生、诈骗、网络安全和金融新闻，核实后先说影响你的，附简报和交互看板。
entries.author: Jon

entries.name: Sponsorship Hunter
entries.summary: Finds verified sponsorship opportunities for creators, newsletter writers, indie hackers and podcasters, ranks them and drafts pitches for you to approve.
entries.summary_zh: 为创作者、简报作者、独立开发者和播客主找经核实的赞助机会，排序后起草个性化邀约供你批准。
entries.author: Vedant

entries.name: Chief of Staff
entries.summary: A main go-to bot that runs point on your requests, hands work to specialist bots, reviews what they send back and keeps one rulebook for everyone.
entries.summary_zh: 你的主力总台 bot：统筹你的请求，分派给专职 bot，审核它们交回的结果，并为所有 bot 维护一套统一规则。
entries.author: Luis

entries.name: Site Builder
entries.summary: Builds and hosts a professional website for you free on Cloudflare, even if you've never made one: plain-English steps, previews first, monthly check-ups.
entries.summary_zh: 免费在 Cloudflare 上为你搭建并托管专业网站，零基础也行：大白话步骤，上线前先预览，每月体检。
entries.author: Jason

entries.name: Family Helpdesk (Beta)
entries.summary: Patient help for a parent or grandparent: checks scary texts, emails and letters (scam, real or ignorable), big-print tech steps, alerts you when serious.
entries.summary_zh: 给父母或祖父母的耐心帮手：判断吓人的短信、邮件和信件是诈骗、真的还是可忽略，给大字版操作步骤，严重时马上提醒你。从不登录或付款。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: Merch Mate
entries.summary: Print-on-demand helper for Shopify + Printful: designs checked for trademark, copyright, spelling and print risks, spam-safe posts and daily sales tallies.
entries.summary_zh: Shopify + Printful 按需印刷店助手：出设计方案并检查商标、版权、拼写和印刷风险，起草不刷屏的社媒帖，每日统计销量和流量。
entries.author: John

entries.name: Admin Chief
entries.summary: Personal admin helper: every morning reads your email, calendar and to-dos and tells you in plain words what needs you. Never sends or changes anything.
entries.summary_zh: 个人事务助手：每天早上读你的邮件、日历和待办，用大白话告诉你什么需要你处理。未经同意从不发送或修改任何内容。
entries.author: John

entries.name: UnmuteAmerica
entries.summary: Personal civic advocate: finds your reps, checks registration and ballot, matches candidates to your views, tracks bills and votes. Nonpartisan, all 50 states.
entries.summary_zh: 个人公民倡导助手：找出你的民意代表，检查选民登记和选票，按你的观点匹配候选人，跟踪法案和投票，起草信息由你发送。无党派，覆盖全美。
entries.author: Jonah

entries.name: Team Pulse
entries.summary: Check-in bot that keeps your other bots from stalling: pings each hourly, nudges idle ones to their next approved task, and sends one digest when you're needed.
entries.summary_zh: 防止其他 bot 停摆的巡检 bot：每小时问一遍，催闲置的 bot 开始下一个已批准任务，有事需要你时才发一份简短摘要。
entries.author: Raymond

entries.name: Financial Advisor
entries.summary: Budgeting buddy: send your bank statement and it shows where your money goes, finds the leaks and builds a simple monthly budget around your real income.
entries.summary_zh: 预算小帮手：发来银行流水，它告诉你钱花去哪了、哪里在漏，并按你的真实收入做一份简单的月度预算。
entries.author: mini

entries.name: SolidCraft CAD
entries.summary: Parametric CAD agent for SolidCraft, the open-source Rust CAD app: installs it, models and edits parts headlessly over MCP, backs results with STL/STEP exports.
entries.summary_zh: 开源 Rust CAD 软件 SolidCraft 的参数化建模代理：安装软件，通过 MCP 无界面建模和修改零件，用测量、截图和 STL/STEP 导出佐证结果。
entries.author: Raymond

entries.name: CloudBot
entries.summary: Friendly assistant for reminders and recurring check-ins. Starts by sending a spoken fun fact every morning.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的提醒和定期问候助手，一开始每天早上发一条语音冷知识。
entries.author: PrettyBoyLive13

entries.name: Fantasy Sports
entries.summary: Manages fantasy football and basketball teams on ESPN, Yahoo and Sleeper: sets lineups, flags injuries, suggests trades for your OK, sends a weekly report.
entries.summary_zh: 管理你在 ESPN、Yahoo、Sleeper 上的梦幻橄榄球和篮球球队：排阵容、标伤病、提交易建议等你确认，每周发报告。
entries.author: Chef

entries.name: Musk Mode
entries.summary: First-principles technical cofounder: checks an idea's physics, finds the bottleneck, designs the cheapest test and says straight whether it can make money.
entries.summary_zh: 第一性原理的技术联合创始人：检查想法的物理可行性，找瓶颈，设计最便宜的验证，并直说能不能赚钱。
entries.author: Bennett

entries.name: Computer Builder
entries.summary: Plans Mini-ITX and Micro-ATX PC builds with the most performance for the money using live prices, and watches the parts for price drops.
entries.summary_zh: 用实时价格规划性价比最高的 Mini-ITX 和 Micro-ATX 装机方案，并盯着配件降价。
entries.author: iq_over_90000

entries.name: Buyer-Intent Lead Finder
entries.summary: Finds fresh public posts from people asking for help or looking to hire in your niche and drafts short value-first replies for approval. Never posts on its own.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你领域里有人求助或想雇人的新公开帖子，起草简短、先给价值的回复等你批准。从不自行发帖、私信或关注。
entries.author: Z23

entries.name: Move Desk (Beta)
entries.summary: For a move with a moving company: checks movers in FMCSA records, reads your estimate, shows the most they can demand at delivery, drafts damage claims.
entries.summary_zh: 请搬家公司时：查 FMCSA 记录核验搬家公司，读懂报价单，告诉你交付时对方最多能收多少，按联邦期限起草损坏索赔。非法律意见。
entries.author: Jimmy

entries.name: X Unfollow Watch
entries.summary: Checks your X account daily and emails you a list of people you follow who stopped following you back. Read-only on X, uses your own X API token.
entries.summary_zh: 每天检查你的 X 账号，把你关注但已取关你的人列成清单发邮件给你。对 X 只读，使用你自己的 X API 令牌。
entries.author: Coty

entries.name: Money Back
entries.summary: Finds money you're owed from receipts and statements (forgotten subscriptions, trials turned paid, double charges, price hikes), helps get it back, tallies it.
entries.summary_zh: 从收据、订单确认和账单里找出该退给你的钱（被遗忘的订阅、转付费的试用、重复扣款、涨价），帮你追回并累计追回金额。
entries.author: Wonder

entries.name: Airbnb Host Concierge
entries.summary: Five-star guest messaging for short-term rental hosts: welcome and checkout notes, guest replies, house manuals, local guides, listing rewrites, review replies.
entries.summary_zh: 给短租房东的五星级房客沟通：欢迎和退房消息、回复房客问题、房屋手册、本地指南、房源文案改写和评价回复。
entries.author: Queen

entries.name: X Viral Bot
entries.summary: Grows an X account with lessons from X's open-source ranking code: shareable posts, replies, timing, dodging spam filters. Drafts with images; never auto-posts.
entries.summary_zh: 借鉴 X 开源排序代码的经验帮账号增长：值得转发的帖子、回复、发帖时机、避开垃圾过滤。起草带图帖子等你批准，从不自行发布。
entries.author: hong

entries.name: X机器人回复判定
entries.summary: Watches replies to your X posts, flags convincing AI or bot replies with evidence, logs them in a Google Sheet, and hides and blocks the ones you pick.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着你 X 帖子下的回复，带证据标出像真人的 AI 或机器人回复，记入 Google 表格，并隐藏、拉黑你选中的账号。
entries.author: Tualatrix

entries.name: Home & Garage
entries.summary: Tracks seasonal home maintenance, vehicle service, registrations and warranties, keeps a Home Specs Sheet from photos and receipts, gives a 45-day heads-up.
entries.summary_zh: 跟踪季节性房屋保养、车辆保养、年检登记和保修，从照片和票据整理一份房屋规格表，每月提前 45 天提醒到期事项。
entries.author: Grease

entries.name: Parent Math Helper
entries.summary: Coaches a parent through K-12 math homework in plain words: the method step by step, one sentence to say to your child and a quick check to do yourself.
entries.summary_zh: 用大白话带家长辅导 K-12 数学作业：一步步讲解方法，给一句可以对孩子说的话，再附一个自己能做的快速检查。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Heimdall Chief Of Security
entries.summary: Keeps watch over your X account: finds impersonators using your photos, flags scam and bot followers and shady accounts you follow, weekly read-only check.
entries.summary_zh: 守护你的 X 账号：找出盗用你照片的冒充者，标出诈骗和机器人粉丝以及你关注的可疑账号，每周一次只读检查。
entries.author: Elise

entries.name: Is This Health Claim True?
entries.summary: Paste a health claim from a group chat or TikTok and get a clear verdict, real sources and a kind reply to send back.
entries.summary_zh: 贴上家庭群或 TikTok 里的健康说法，得到明确结论、真实出处，以及一条可以友善回复的话。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Curriculum Researcher
entries.summary: Finds free, open courses for anything you want to learn, high school through college, and turns them into a course plan with readings and videos.
entries.summary_zh: 为你想学的任何内容找免费公开课程（高中到大学），整理成带阅读材料、图片和视频的课程计划。可搭配 Teacher Agent。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Speech to Motion Video
entries.summary: Turns any speech or voice clip into a finished motion-graphics video with animated UI, infographics, kinetic text and original music, ready to post on X.
entries.summary_zh: 把任何演讲或语音片段做成完整的动态图形视频，带动画界面、信息图、动态文字和原创音乐，可直接发 X。无需剪辑技能。
entries.author: mowziee

entries.name: Milani — Voice to Music Video
entries.summary: Turns a voice note, song, podcast or poem into a music video with subtitles and living generative art by artist Reza Milani. No AI video generation.
entries.summary_zh: 把语音、歌曲、播客或诗歌做成带字幕的音乐视频，配艺术家 Reza Milani 的生成艺术画面。不使用 AI 视频生成。
entries.author: Reza

entries.name: Daily News in 5 Minutes
entries.summary: A neutral 5-minute daily news brief for where you live and any place you follow, every story linked to a reputable source.
entries.summary_zh: 每天 5 分钟的中立新闻简报，覆盖你所在地和你关注的地方，每条新闻都附可靠来源链接。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Breast Awareness Coach
entries.summary: A gentle monthly reminder to know what's normal for your breasts so you notice changes and get them checked. Not a test; never replaces mammograms.
entries.summary_zh: 每月温和提醒你了解自己乳房的正常状态，以便发现变化及时检查。不是医学检测，不能替代乳腺 X 光筛查。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Screening Reminder
entries.summary: Tracks which health screenings you're due for and reminds you ahead, with optional breast-awareness check-ins and a family cancer history map. For busy moms.
entries.summary_zh: 记录你该做哪些健康筛查并提前提醒，可选每月乳房自查问候和家族癌症史图谱。为总把别人放第一的忙碌女性和妈妈设计。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Vaccine and Checkup Tracker
entries.summary: Checkups, shots and school forms on one list, with reminders ahead of time.
entries.summary_zh: 体检、疫苗和学校表格都在一张清单上，并提前提醒。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Silver Dollar Duke
entries.summary: Old-school coin dealer for collectors: inventories coins and bullion from photos, melt value from live spot prices, collector value from cited guides and sales.
entries.summary_zh: 给收藏者的老派钱币商：从照片建钱币和金银条清单，按实时现货价算熔值，按有出处的价目指南和成交记录估收藏价，并讲评级和保存。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Max News
entries.summary: Personal news monitor: a short neutral brief on your topics and area a few times a day, every story sourced, no repeats, alerts only for truly big news.
entries.summary_zh: 个人新闻监测：每天几次针对你的话题和地区发简短中立的简报，每条有出处、不重复，只有真正的重大突发才单独提醒。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Skywatcher Buzz
entries.summary: What's worth stepping outside for over your town: ISS passes, aurora chances, meteor showers, eclipses, planets and rocket launches, with cloud forecast.
entries.summary_zh: 告诉你家乡上空有什么值得出门看：空间站过境、极光机会、流星雨、日月食、行星、月相和可见火箭发射，并配上云量预报。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Phil Connors
entries.summary: Dry-witted Groundhog Day-style TV weatherman with accurate daily forecasts for your US town from the National Weather Service. Alerts delivered straight.
entries.summary_zh: 《土拨鼠之日》式冷幽默电视天气播报员，用美国国家气象局数据给你所在小镇做准确的每日预报。预警和海事预报不开玩笑。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Weekend With Kids
entries.summary: Finds free and cheap things to do with your kids this weekend in your city: special events, age-fit plans and a rainy-day backup.
entries.summary_zh: 找出这个周末你所在城市可以带孩子去的免费或便宜活动：特别活动、适合年龄的安排和雨天备选。
entries.author: Yossi

entries.name: Novaterra Foods
entries.summary: Space food R&D bot: upscale global fusion food concepts for orbit, Starship-style transit, Moon bases and Mars, each with cited science and a home recipe.
entries.summary_zh: 太空食品研发 bot：为轨道、星舰式航行、月球基地和火星殖民地设计高档环球融合菜概念，每个附有出处的科学依据和可在家试做的菜谱。
entries.author: Xavier

entries.name: X Unfollower Tracker
entries.summary: Watches your X followers daily and messages you the @handles of anyone who left. Quiet when nothing changes.
entries.summary_zh: 每天盯着你的 X 粉丝，有人取关就把对方账号发给你。没有变化时保持安静。
entries.author: Fundador

entries.name: Goldie Gems
entries.summary: Jewelry assistant: builds an inventory spreadsheet from photos, figures melt value from live gold, silver and platinum prices, helps with insurance and selling.
entries.summary_zh: 珠宝助手：从照片建立首饰清单表格，按实时金、银、铂价格算熔值，协助保险清单、估价、保养和出售。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Claim Helper
entries.summary: From an ex-adjuster: handles an auto or home insurance claim in plain English, from documenting damage to judging an estimate and drafting a counter letter.
entries.summary_zh: 前车损理赔员打造：用大白话帮你处理车险或房屋险理赔，从记录损失、读保单到判断定损或全损报价、起草还价信和何时升级。
entries.author: Vic

entries.name: Cheap Flight Finder
entries.summary: Finds the cheapest acceptable flight across Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak, Kiwi, airlines and more, compares total cost with bags and fees, watches fares.
entries.summary_zh: 在 Google Flights、Skyscanner、Kayak、Kiwi、航司官网等处找最便宜又可接受的航班，按含行李和杂费的总价比较，并盯票价下降。从不擅自订票。
entries.author: datapoint

entries.name: NotHomeview Updates
entries.summary: Posts an update whenever a new NotHomeView release for Home Assistant comes out, with a plain-language summary of what changed and a link.
entries.summary_zh: Home Assistant 的 NotHomeView 每次发新版本时通知你，附通俗的更新内容摘要和发布链接。
entries.author: Blue Jay Ball Boy

entries.name: Backup Bot
entries.summary: Copies the important data on your Grok Bot computer (files, bot settings, skills, chat logs, instructions, routines) to storage you pick, and helps restore.
entries.summary_zh: 把 Grok Bot 电脑上的重要数据（文件、bot 设置、技能、聊天记录、各 bot 的指令和例程）按计划备份到你选的存储，需要时帮你安全恢复。
entries.author: Jacob

entries.name: Glow Picasso, Creative Director
entries.summary: Creative director bot that designs premium website visuals (layouts, UI, icons, motion), one polished upgrade per round as desktop and phone mockups.
entries.summary_zh: 创意总监 bot：为网站设计高端沉浸式视觉（布局、界面、图标和动效），每轮交付一项精修升级，提供桌面和手机尺寸效果图。
entries.author: Xavier

entries.name: Site Engineer
entries.summary: Careful lead engineer for your website: builds approved changes via cloud agents and draft PRs, tests and secret-scans every push, never merges without OK.
entries.summary_zh: 谨慎的网站首席工程师：通过云端代理和草稿 PR 实现已批准的改动，每次推送都测试并扫描密钥泄露，未经同意从不合并或部署。
entries.author: Xavier

entries.name: Kid Sick Day Helper
entries.summary: Calm help for a sick kid: what to watch, when to call the pediatrician and when to go to the ER.
entries.summary_zh: 孩子生病时的冷静帮手：该观察什么、什么时候打给儿科医生、什么时候该去急诊。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Scriptopher Nolan, Video Content Producer
entries.summary: Turns your ideas into tight, hook-first 6-15 second video scripts with beats, timed voiceover and on-screen text. Never invents the plot or posts for you.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的想法写成紧凑、开头抓人的 6-15 秒视频脚本，含节拍、定时旁白和屏幕文字。只打磨你的故事，不编情节也不替你发布。
entries.author: Xavier

entries.name: Dashboard
entries.summary: Builds a private drag-to-arrange stats dashboard as a single HTML file, starting with tagged sample data; connect real data panel by panel, keys never in chat.
entries.summary_zh: 做一个可拖拽排列的私人数据看板（单个 HTML 文件），先用标明的示例数据，再逐个面板接入真实数据，密钥从不出现在聊天里。
entries.author: ollie

entries.name: Birthday Party
entries.summary: Birthday freebie finder: give it a zip code and birthday and it finds free food, drinks and perks nearby, how to claim them, and reminds you to sign up.
entries.summary_zh: 生日福利搜罗器：给它邮编和生日，它找出附近的免费餐饮和优惠、领取方法，并提醒你及时注册。
entries.author: Marcell

entries.name: Value Estimator
entries.summary: What something you own would likely sell for, goods or vehicles in any country, from real sold comps: send a photo or VIN, get a low/likely/high range.
entries.summary_zh: 估算你手上的东西能卖多少钱，物品或车辆、任何国家都行，基于真实成交记录：发照片或 VIN，得到低/可能/高价区间、可信度和对比链接。
entries.author: Jay

entries.name: Bookmark Bot
entries.summary: Organizes your X bookmarks into an inbox-style Page with folders, search and a preview pane. Read-only on X; never posts, follows or DMs.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的 X 书签整理成收件箱式页面，带文件夹、搜索和预览栏。对 X 只读，从不发帖、关注或私信。
entries.author: Jay

entries.name: Agent Bridge
entries.summary: Chat bridge to your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor): carries requests, brings back answers, does web research. Push and deploy stay with you.
entries.summary_zh: 你和编程代理（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等）之间的对话桥梁：传达请求、带回答复、替它做网络调研、告诉你什么在等审批。推送和部署仍由你掌握。
entries.author: Borderless

entries.name: Save Usage Bot
entries.summary: Audits what your bots do on repeat and turns the no-judgment steps into plain python3 scripts that only wake a bot on a change or after 3 failed checks.
entries.summary_zh: 审查你的 bot 重复在做什么，把不需要判断的步骤改成普通 python3 脚本，只在有变化或连续 3 次检查失败时才唤醒 bot。
entries.author: ollie

entries.name: Backup Bot
entries.summary: Audits any of your bots and saves a restore pack with its profile, skills, routines and key notes, never passwords or tokens; optional encrypted second copy.
entries.summary_zh: 审查任意一个 bot，保存包含资料、技能、例程和关键笔记的恢复包，从不保存密码、密钥或令牌；可在你掌控的地方另存加密副本。
entries.author: ollie

entries.name: Jenny Genealogy
entries.summary: Genealogy assistant for your Ancestry.com tree: reviews hints one person at a time, finds duplicates, fixes conflicting dates and places, exports GEDCOMs.
entries.summary_zh: Ancestry.com 家谱助手：一次一个人和你一起审阅提示，找出重复，修正冲突的日期和地点，导出 GEDCOM。未经同意从不改动家谱。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Bot Portfolio Manager
entries.summary: Scores your bot ideas, spots overlap and decides what to build, merge or retire, so every bot has one clear job.
entries.summary_zh: 给你的 bot 想法打分，找出重叠，决定该建、该合并还是该退役，让每个 bot 都只有一个明确职责。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Invoice Chaser
entries.summary: Get-paid assistant for freelancers and small businesses: a Notion invoices database, a daily who-owes-me queue and polite-to-firm Gmail reminders you send.
entries.summary_zh: 给自由职业者和小企业的收款助手：维护 Notion 发票库，按逾期程度每天排出“谁欠我钱”队列，在 Gmail 起草由客气到强硬的催款提醒由你发送。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: AI Deal Scout
entries.summary: Scans X a few times a day for AI tool and subscription deals (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Midjourney and more) and sends short alerts. Never posts as you.
entries.summary_zh: 每天几次在 X 上搜罗 AI 工具和订阅优惠（ChatGPT、Claude、Cursor、Midjourney 等），发简短提醒。含黑五，从不以你的名义发帖。
entries.author: MetCaster

entries.name: Menopause Coach
entries.summary: Clear, honest answers about perimenopause and menopause, plus symptom tracking and questions to bring to your appointment.
entries.summary_zh: 关于围绝经期和更年期的清楚、诚实的解答，附症状记录和就诊时可以问的问题。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: eBay Seller Assistant
entries.summary: Helper for small eBay sellers: checks new orders, buys and prints standard shipping labels within your caps, tracks USPS scans and guards your price floor.
entries.summary_zh: 小型 eBay 卖家助手：查看新订单，在你设定的上限内购买并打印标准运单，跟踪 USPS 扫描记录，守住你的最低价，改价或大额支出前先问你。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Gun Collection Assistant
entries.summary: For gun owners and collectors: keeps collection inventory and values, checks deals and auctions, helps price and list for sale, tracks carry-license renewals.
entries.summary_zh: 给枪支持有者和收藏者：维护藏品清单和估值，查看枪弹优惠和拍卖，协助定价和挂售，跟踪持枪证续期。未经同意从不购买、出价或挂牌。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Computer Shop Bot
entries.summary: For a small computer repair and sales shop: buys and sells PC parts on eBay, prices for profit after fees, tracks orders, quotes office network installs.
entries.summary_zh: 小型电脑维修销售店助手：在 eBay 买卖电脑配件，按扣费后利润定价，跟踪订单和物流，规划并报价办公室网络安装。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Template Safety Checker
entries.summary: Paste any Grok Bot template, link or JSON and get a plain read on what it can touch, its red flags and whether it's safe to install. Read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 贴上任何 Grok Bot 模板、链接或 JSON，用白话告诉你它能接触什么、有哪些危险信号、是否可以安全安装。只读，从不安装或运行。
entries.author: Jorhan

entries.name: Vacation Vicky
entries.summary: Plans trips end to end (flights, lodging, rental cars, day-by-day itineraries, price checks) and saves polished plans to Google Drive or OneDrive. Never books.
entries.summary_zh: 端到端规划旅行：机票、住宿、租车、每日行程（含美食和景点）和比价，把精美行程存到 Google Drive 或 OneDrive。未经同意从不预订。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Job Application Agent
entries.summary: Finds, assesses, fills and tracks your job applications with the open-source job-application-agent CLI. Review mode by default; nothing submits unconfirmed.
entries.summary_zh: 用开源的 job-application-agent 命令行工具寻找、评估、填写并跟踪你的求职申请。默认审核模式，未经确认不提交。
entries.author: Vaibhav

entries.name: Boating Assistant
entries.summary: Hands-on assistant for a boat owner: maintenance and repairs, parts lists, vessel documentation, cruising plans and onboard media, using your boat's real specs.
entries.summary_zh: 给船主的实用助手：保养维修、配件清单和采购、船舶文件、航行计划和船上影音，按你船的真实参数一步步指导，未经同意不买不发。
entries.author: James

entries.name: AI Character Studio
entries.summary: Runs faceless AI influencer characters end to end: scripts with hook options, AI avatar videos, captions, scheduled posting and weekly growth checks.
entries.summary_zh: 端到端运营不露脸的 AI 网红角色：带钩子选项的脚本、AI 虚拟形象视频、可直接粘贴的文案、定时发布和每周销售与增长检查。经你同意才发。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Viral Content Radar
entries.summary: Finds up to 3 trending stories in your niche, verified from sources, with hooks in your voice and a ready-to-post X draft.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你领域里最多 3 条经来源核实的热门话题，配上你口吻的开头钩子和一条可直接发布的 X 草稿。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Login Ledger
entries.summary: Keeps an index of which email or username you signed up with for every online account, built from your inbox. Never stores passwords.
entries.summary_zh: 从你的收件箱整理出每个网络账号注册时用的邮箱或用户名，形成索引。从不保存密码。
entries.author: Nicholas

entries.name: X to LinkedIn
entries.summary: Turns your real X posts (not shitposts, reposts or replies) into LinkedIn posts with the same people tagged, sent for your OK or posted if you choose.
entries.summary_zh: 把你在 X 上的正经帖子（不含水帖、转帖和回复）改写成 LinkedIn 帖子并标记同样的人，先发你确认，或按你选择直接发布。
entries.author: Pratik

entries.name: Movie Rating
entries.summary: Family-first movie guide: set your kids' ages, likes and content filters, then type any movie for a compact review with age fit and skip timestamps.
entries.summary_zh: 以家庭为先的观影指南：设定孩子年龄、喜好和内容过滤，然后输入任何电影，得到含适龄判断和可跳过时间点的简短评价。
entries.author: Komil

entries.name: Missed Call Rescuer
entries.summary: For service businesses where a missed call is a lost job: reads missed-call, voicemail and web-form emails, drafts a friendly reply per lead, logs in Notion.
entries.summary_zh: 给错过电话就丢生意的服务类小企业：读取未接来电、语音留言和网页表单通知邮件，为每条线索起草友好回复和一句话摘要，记入 Notion。只起草。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Ms. Reviewenstein
entries.summary: Peer-critique bot for a multi-agent desk: reviews teammates' big calls (workflow, architecture, spend, skills) for up to 3 rounds before they ship.
entries.summary_zh: 多代理团队的同行评审 bot：在上线前对队友的重大决定（工作流、架构、花费、技能变更）最多评审 3 轮，证据优先，只把未决分歧交给人。
entries.author: Jonathan

entries.name: Pyloros
entries.summary: Skill-quality gate that treats skills as tested code: planted-bad evals, held-out checks before promote, rollback on regression. Proposals only.
entries.summary_zh: 把技能当作需测试代码的质量关卡：植入坏样本评测、上线前留出集检查、退化时回滚。只提建议，未经你同意从不自动安装。
entries.author: Jonathan

entries.name: Job Requirements Scout
entries.summary: Send your resume and connect an Indeed job-hunting account: every weekday it scans nearby jobs in your field, without applying, and tracks what they require.
entries.summary_zh: 发来简历并连接求职用的 Indeed 账号：每个工作日扫描附近你所在领域的职位，不投递，持续整理这些职位的要求。
entries.author: nahjuin

entries.name: Backup
entries.summary: Keeps copies of your bots' setups and key files off the shared Grok Bot computer, in a private GitHub repo and Google Drive, and helps restore after a wipe.
entries.summary_zh: 把 bot 配置和重要文件备份到共享 Grok Bot 电脑之外（私有 GitHub 仓库和 Google Drive），定时静默备份，记录已删 bot，清空后帮你恢复。
entries.author: Chris

entries.name: Security
entries.summary: Active security guard for your Linux machines: daily health and threat checks, watches advisories and X for threats to your software, applies safe fixes.
entries.summary_zh: Linux 机器的主动安全守卫：每天做健康和威胁检查，关注安全公告和 X 上针对你所用软件的威胁，只执行你允许的安全修复，每周报告。
entries.author: Anubhav

entries.name: Clearloop
entries.summary: GTD-inspired Notion productivity bot: capture commitments by chat, voice, email, Gmail stars, Reminders or X bookmarks, then a morning brief and weekly review.
entries.summary_zh: 受 GTD 启发的 Notion 效率 bot：通过聊天、语音、邮件、Gmail 星标、提醒事项或 X 书签收集承诺，每天早上简报，每周引导复盘。
entries.author: mr

entries.name: Car Shopper
entries.summary: Helps you find a used car, check its record, build a real out-the-door price and draft a haggle script. Never buys or contacts dealers for you.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你找二手车、查车况记录、算出真实落地价并起草砍价话术。从不替你购买或联系车商。
entries.author: Hudson

entries.name: Cancer Caregiver Hub
entries.summary: For cancer caregivers and people in treatment: meds, visits, daily check-ins and family updates, shared only as the patient wishes.
entries.summary_zh: 给癌症照护者和治疗中的人：管理用药、就诊、每日问候和家人近况通报，只按患者意愿分享。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Credit Watch
entries.summary: Watches your Experian, Equifax and TransUnion reports, reminds you to pay each card before it reports so a low balance shows, and summarizes changes.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着你在 Experian、Equifax、TransUnion 的信用报告，提醒你在每张卡上报前几天还款以显示低余额，并按时汇总变化。
entries.author: Marcell

entries.name: Résumé and Cover Letter Helper
entries.summary: Tailors your résumé, writes a short cover letter, tracks applications and practices interviews with you, using only your real experience.
entries.summary_zh: 定制简历、写简短求职信、跟踪申请并陪你练习面试，只用你的真实经历。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Buyer Radar
entries.summary: Finds people publicly asking for your service on Reddit, X and elsewhere, scores each lead, logs it in Notion and drafts a helpful reply you send yourself.
entries.summary_zh: 在 Reddit、X 等公开渠道找出正在求购你服务的人，为每条线索打分并记入 Notion，起草有帮助的回复由你自己发送。只读只起草。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Grok Bot Inc.
entries.summary: Chief of staff for your team of AI bots: routes each request to the right role bot, hires new ones when nobody owns the work and keeps the org chart clean.
entries.summary_zh: 你 AI bot 团队的幕僚长：把每个请求交给对应角色的 bot，没人负责时招新 bot，并保持组织架构清晰。
entries.author: Luke

entries.name: What's for Dinner Tonight?
entries.summary: Tonight's dinner from what's already in your kitchen, in under a minute.
entries.summary_zh: 一分钟内用你厨房里现有的东西想好今晚的晚餐。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Scroll
entries.summary: Reads your X home timeline every morning and sends the five posts most worth your time, plus an optional evening digest of clever Grok Bot setups. Read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上读你的 X 首页时间线，挑出最值得看的五条发给你，可选晚间摘要汇总别人分享的巧妙 Grok Bot 用法。只读，从不发帖。
entries.author: Richard

entries.name: Organizer CEO Bot
entries.summary: CEO bot for a team of Grok Bots: routes work to the right specialist, keeps docs organized, logs receipts to a cost tracker and sends a daily morning brief.
entries.summary_zh: 管理 Grok Bot 团队的 CEO bot：把工作分给对的专职 bot，整理文档，把票据记入成本表，每天早上发简报。未经同意不发、不贴、不买。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Burn Bot
entries.summary: Delivers a locked skill pack: enter the one-time passphrase from the sender to unlock it; three wrong tries and the drop burns.
entries.summary_zh: 交付一个加锁的技能包：输入发送者给的一次性口令解锁，错三次就自毁。
entries.author: SuddenlyJon

entries.name: Meme Maker
