entries.summary: Turns your posts and ideas into anime-style memes about coding, AI, tech and games, with a ready caption. Never posts for you.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的帖子和想法做成编程、AI、科技和游戏主题的动漫风表情包，附现成配文。从不替你发布。
entries.author: Chris

entries.name: Vibe Coder
entries.summary: Single-engineer coding bot that hands every change to a headless coding CLI, opens PRs on a branch with a second-model pre-commit review, never pushes to main.
entries.summary_zh: 单人工程师编程 bot：把每个改动交给无界面编程命令行，在分支上开 PR 并用第二个模型做提交前审查，从不合并或推送到 main。
entries.author: Trond

entries.name: Fitness Trend Coach
entries.summary: Turns fitness data you share from Apple, Android or any tracker into daily, weekly or monthly trend notes and simple meal ideas. Not medical advice.
entries.summary_zh: 把你从 Apple、安卓或任何手环分享的健身数据整理成每日、每周或每月趋势笔记，并给出简单的饮食建议。非医疗建议。
entries.author: Patriot

entries.name: TheOverseer
entries.summary: Keeps a multi-bot workspace organized, git-backed and portable: backs up profiles, skills, routines and notes to a private repo on weekdays, prunes old files.
entries.summary_zh: 让多 bot 工作区井井有条、有 git 备份且可迁移：工作日把资料、技能、例程和笔记备份到私有仓库，并按保留规则清理旧文件。
entries.author: Jethro

entries.name: Class Act
entries.summary: Finds legit class action settlements you qualify for in your Gmail, files honest claims on official administrator sites and sends a weekly report.
entries.summary_zh: 从你的 Gmail 里找出你有资格参与的正规集体诉讼和解，在官方管理网站如实提交索赔，并每周汇报。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: The Sponsor
entries.summary: Two-key accountability lock: you ARM a standard and can't disengage it yourself; only a paired friend's copy of The Sponsor can countersign an unlock.
entries.summary_zh: 双钥匙自律锁：你设定一项标准并上锁后自己无法解除，只有配对好友的 The Sponsor 用准确口令联署才能解锁。
entries.author: SuddenlyJon

entries.name: Pep
entries.summary: Tracks your peptide protocol: reconstitution math, dose log, vial inventory and shot-day reminders. Logs what you decided; never prescribes or sources.
entries.summary_zh: 记录你的肽类方案：配制换算、剂量日志、药瓶库存和注射日提醒。只计算和记录你已决定的内容，从不开处方或代购。
entries.author: Dave

entries.name: Groklexa
entries.summary: Alexa voice bridge for Grok Bot: links a private Echo skill via a self-written Cloudflare Worker relay, with optional Voice Monkey and Ring/Govee hooks.
entries.summary_zh: Grok Bot 的 Alexa 语音桥：通过自写的 Cloudflare Worker 中继把私有 Echo 技能连到 bot，可选 Voice Monkey 播报和 Ring/Govee 家居联动。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: Emotion Friend
entries.summary: A big-sibling AI friend for everyday emotional support: check-ins, a mood dashboard, tiny daily missions, a gratitude journal and weekly look-backs.
entries.summary_zh: 像哥哥姐姐一样的 AI 朋友，提供日常情绪支持：早晚问候、情绪看板、每日小任务、感恩日记和每周回顾。不是心理治疗，内置危机求助资源。
entries.author: Brian

entries.name: Professional Writer
entries.summary: Writes cover letters and outreach in natural spoken English a hiring manager would believe, using only facts from your own resume and sources.
entries.summary_zh: 用招聘经理信得过的自然口语写求职信和联络信，只使用你自己简历和资料里的事实。
entries.author: Omi

entries.name: Grok Bot Auditor
entries.summary: Audits your bots' memory and skills for stale, duplicate and conflicting facts and catches repeat posting. Proposes fixes you approve line by line.
entries.summary_zh: 审查你各个 bot 的记忆和技能，找出过时、重复和矛盾的内容，并发现重复发帖。只提出修改建议，由你逐行批准。
entries.author: Lloyd

entries.name: Robotaxi Assistant
entries.summary: Paste a Tesla Robotaxi trip-share link and it tracks the ride live, sends arrival pings, readies your home before you arrive and logs your trips.
entries.summary_zh: 贴上特斯拉 Robotaxi 行程分享链接，实时跟踪行程，发送到达提醒，在你到家前准备好家里，并记录每次出行。
entries.author: Abhinav

entries.name: Sidecar
entries.summary: An X copilot that finds posts worth replying to and drafts replies in your voice. You always hit send yourself.
entries.summary_zh: X 副驾驶：找出值得回复的帖子，用你的口吻起草回复，发送永远由你自己点。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: FathomBackupAgent
entries.summary: Archives public Fathom share links to your computer (summary, transcript, metadata and recording) with no Fathom account needed.
entries.summary_zh: 把公开的 Fathom 会议分享链接归档到你的电脑：摘要、文字记录、元数据和录音，无需 Fathom 账号。
entries.author: CandidJonnie

entries.name: LawnCare Center
entries.summary: Give it your ZIP and it tells you what your lawn needs this week.
entries.summary_zh: 告诉它你的邮编，它告诉你这周草坪需要做什么。
entries.author: Jake

entries.name: Master Mechanic
entries.summary: A master tech for cars, trucks, diesel, semis and equipment: VIN-first diagnosis with OEM part numbers and buy links, plus shop-tool deal alerts.
entries.summary_zh: 面向汽车、卡车、柴油车、半挂和设备的老技师：先查 VIN 再诊断，给出原厂零件号和购买链接，并留意维修工具优惠。
entries.author: Omi

entries.name: Account Research
entries.summary: Research desk for one named enterprise account: org chart and buying committee, why-now triggers, expansion angles and sourced outreach drafts.
entries.summary_zh: 为一个指定的企业客户做调研：梳理组织架构和采购委员会、找出时机触发点和扩展机会，起草有出处的联络草稿。
entries.author: Jacob

entries.name: Plus One Back
entries.summary: Suggests short, kind X replies that make people feel heard; you approve every one before it posts. Pairs with the weekly coach Got Your Back.
entries.summary_zh: 每天建议几条简短友善、让人感到被倾听的 X 回复，每条都由你批准后才发。可搭配每周回顾教练 Got Your Back。
entries.author: Joris

entries.name: Troot - Claim Checker
entries.summary: Grades the evidence behind any claim, draft, document, code or data, tests counterarguments and says what holds and what to fix. Solo or as a team reviewer.
entries.summary_zh: 为任何说法、草稿、文档、代码或数据评估证据强弱，检验反方论点，指出哪些站得住、哪些要改。可单独用，也可当 bot 团队的审稿人。
entries.author: Tri

entries.name: Quick Shop
entries.summary: Finds the exact product, even from a photo, compares live prices and real reviews across stores, and adds to a cart only when you say yes.
entries.summary_zh: 找到确切商品（拍照也行），跨店比较实时价格和真实评价，只有你同意才加入购物车。
entries.author: Odisus

entries.name: Sous-Chef
entries.summary: Meal planner that starts from grocery deals: emails a menu you can reply to, then fills a cart or drops ingredients into Reminders or Notes.
entries.summary_zh: 从超市特价出发的餐食规划：发邮件给你菜单，回复即可调整或换菜，再帮你填购物车或把食材写进提醒事项、备忘录。
entries.author: Ramy

entries.name: Gig Hunter
entries.summary: Hunts real, paid gigs that fit your skills, pay and schedule, weeds out the scams and sends you a fresh shortlist.
entries.summary_zh: 搜寻符合你技能、报酬和时间的真实付费零活，剔除骗局，给你一份新鲜的候选清单。
entries.author: lilsketch

entries.name: X-STREAMTOP
entries.summary: Builds, releases and auto-updates X-STREAMTOP, a free desktop live-streaming app with a built-in browser, region snips and stream overlays.
entries.summary_zh: 构建、发布并自动更新 X-STREAMTOP：一款免费的桌面直播应用，内置浏览器、区域截取和直播叠加层。
entries.author: 0HOUR1

entries.name: Deal Analyzer
entries.summary: Send a property address and get comps, ARV, repairs, an offer range, flip and rental math and a seller text. For wholesalers, flippers and landlords.
entries.summary_zh: 发一个房产地址，得到可比房价、修后价值、维修估算、报价区间、翻新和出租测算，以及可直接发给卖家的短信。
entries.author: Austin

entries.name: Inbox Triage
entries.summary: Sorts Gmail or Outlook into Act now, Reply soon, FYI and Noise and sends one short list. Read-only and draft-only; quiet when nothing matters.
entries.summary_zh: 把 Gmail 或 Outlook 分成立即处理、尽快回复、知悉和噪音，发你一份简短清单。只读、只起草，没要紧事就不打扰。
entries.author: Calix

entries.name: Kitchen
entries.summary: Recipes from what you have, weekly meal plans and shopping lists or carts, with allergies treated as hard rules.
entries.summary_zh: 按手头食材出菜谱，做每周餐单和购物清单或购物车，过敏原一律当硬性规则处理。
entries.author: Johannes

entries.name: Hype Man
entries.summary: Every Friday it reads every PR your team merged and writes a Tom Haverford-style, Slack-ready release summary built only on real shipped work.
entries.summary_zh: 每周五读完团队合并的所有 PR，写一份 Tom Haverford 风格、可直接发 Slack 的发布总结，只讲真正上线的东西。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: Persona Forge
entries.summary: Designs AI assistants with a distinctive personality (coworkers, personal assistants, story characters, game NPCs), with an avatar you review first.
entries.summary_zh: 设计有鲜明个性的 AI 助手：同事或经理、私人助理、故事角色、游戏 NPC。选类型、描述角色、挑头像风格，确认后才创建。
entries.author: TechOps

entries.name: Andrea Sachs
entries.summary: A personal secretary that watches your inboxes, sends a morning briefing, tracks packages and bills, cleans out spam and keeps your calendar.
entries.summary_zh: 私人秘书：盯着你所有收件箱，发晨间简报，跟踪包裹和账单，清理垃圾邮件，管理日历。未经同意从不以你名义发送。
entries.author: JX

entries.name: Kids Direct-Touch Figure
entries.summary: Turns an everyday object (cistern, door lock, faucet) into a hand-inked isometric HTML page that pre-reading kids operate by touch to learn how it works.
entries.summary_zh: 把日常物件（马桶水箱、门锁、水龙头）做成手绘等轴测互动 HTML 页面，不识字的孩子用手点、拖、转就能学会它怎么工作。
entries.author: ny

entries.name: Professor X
entries.summary: Researches any topic with cross-checked sources, explains it so you can teach it, and coaches your other bots each week.
entries.summary_zh: 私人研究员兼老师：用交叉核对的来源研究任何主题，讲到你能教别人，还每周辅导你的其他 bot。
entries.author: John

entries.name: Tasha from Remake
entries.summary: Explains food label ingredients in plain words, suggests allergy-friendly swaps and shares simple family recipes.
entries.summary_zh: 用大白话解释食品标签上的配料，建议对过敏友好的替代品，分享简单的家常菜谱。
entries.author: Lola

entries.name: Forge
entries.summary: An operations enforcer that holds you to three priorities and runs every new idea through a revenue test. For founders who start more than they finish.
entries.summary_zh: 运营督导：把你钉在三个优先事项上，每个新点子都先过一遍收入测试。适合开得多、收得少的创始人和独立经营者。
entries.author: Jaime

entries.name: Dan
entries.summary: Daily marketing manager for a sports fan page: growth plans, ready-to-post text, local fan replies, brand deals and income.
entries.summary_zh: 体育粉丝页的每日营销经理：增长计划、可直接发布的文案、本地粉丝回复、品牌合作和收入。
entries.author: Sloane

entries.name: Caregiver Coordinator
entries.summary: Logistics partner for someone caring for an aging parent: a care binder with meds and providers, appointments and refills, and family updates.
entries.summary_zh: 照顾年迈父母时的后勤搭档：维护一份护理档案（用药、医生、保险、文件位置），安排就诊和续药，让家人随时知情。
entries.author: Jeremy

entries.name: Lawn Care Scheduler
entries.summary: A lawn care business assistant that organizes your customer list, keeps the mowing route on schedule and helps put together bids and quotes.
entries.summary_zh: 草坪养护生意助手：整理客户名单，让割草路线按时进行，帮你准备投标和报价。
entries.author: josephscottelli

entries.name: Chef Ramsey
entries.summary: Plans no-waste weekly menus, checks every ingredient and price on your grocery store's site, fills the cart and orders pickup only after you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 私人厨师兼采购：规划不浪费的每周菜单，在你常去超市网站核对每样食材和价格，填好购物车，经你批准才下单自提，还做可打印的菜谱卡。
entries.author: Cody

entries.name: Reply & Post Drafter by Karata
entries.summary: Drafts social replies and posts for X, LinkedIn and Threads in your own voice and language, ready for you to edit and publish.
entries.summary_zh: 用你自己的口吻和语言为 X、LinkedIn、Threads 起草回复和帖子，由你修改后自己发布。
entries.author: Karata

entries.name: CricStudio Live
entries.summary: Runs live cricket streams with scorecards and AI commentary to YouTube or X, one studio per match, with a watchdog that reconnects dropped streams.
entries.summary_zh: 把板球直播推到 YouTube 或 X，带记分牌和 AI 解说，每场比赛一个演播室，还有看门狗自动重连掉线的直播。
entries.author: Yash

entries.name: Sommelier
entries.summary: A slightly theatrical personal sommelier: bottle picks for any dish, occasion or budget, and a detailed read on any wine from a label photo or link.
entries.summary_zh: 略带戏剧感的私人侍酒师：按菜品、场合或预算推荐酒款，发酒标照片、酒名、菜单或链接即可得到详细分析。
entries.author: Antonio

entries.name: Maid
entries.summary: A housekeeper that builds a cleaning system instead of a chore list: a 10-minute nightly reset, one 15-minute zone a day and short weekly resets.
entries.summary_zh: 管家式清洁助手：不列家务清单，而是建一套清洁系统：每晚 10 分钟复位、每天一个 15 分钟区域，再加简短的每周整理。
entries.author: Totao

entries.name: Backseat Buddy
entries.summary: A voice-first travel buddy for kids on car rides, flights and trains, with games, sneaky learning and instant parent safety alerts.
entries.summary_zh: 孩子坐车、乘机、坐火车时的语音旅伴：有游戏、寓教于乐，还有即时的家长安全提醒。
entries.author: Sarah

entries.name: Cut Man
entries.summary: Finds money leaks in your business (unused subscriptions, surprise renewals, wasted spend) and keeps you on track to cut them.
entries.summary_zh: 找出生意里的漏财点：闲置订阅、意外续费、浪费的支出，并督促你砍掉。适合独立创始人和小老板。
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: MindsetBot
entries.summary: A calm mindset journal coach: each day it walks you through one life area with a few questions, then coaches you if you want to keep going.
entries.summary_zh: 平静的心态日记教练：每天就一个生活领域问你几个问题，想继续聊就接着辅导你。
entries.author: Cody

entries.name: Calendar Manager
entries.summary: Runs the calendar for a busy service business: turns quick notes into appointments with addresses and contacts and cleans up old recurring events.
entries.summary_zh: 替忙碌的服务型生意管日历：把随手记的话变成带地址和联系人的预约，清理过期的重复事件。
entries.author: josephscottelli

entries.name: Launch Hunter
entries.summary: A launch strategist for indie hackers: researches real distribution channels, checks their rules, ranks them honestly and writes launch-ready copy.
entries.summary_zh: 给独立开发者和小团队的发布策略师：调研真实的分发渠道，核对各渠道规则，诚实排序，并写好发布文案。
entries.author: Vedant

entries.name: Interview Prep
entries.summary: Builds STAR answers from your own verified stories, runs mock interviews one question at a time and helps you sound like yourself, not a script.
entries.summary_zh: 用你自己核实过的经历构建 STAR 回答，一题一题模拟面试，帮你说得像自己而不是背稿。
entries.author: Omi

entries.name: Chief of Staff
entries.summary: For people who run several bots: routes work between them, keeps logins and sessions working, sends one morning card and pings only for decisions.
entries.summary_zh: 给同时运行多个 bot 的人：在 bot 之间分派工作，保持登录、收件箱和浏览器会话可用，每天发一张晨报卡，只在需要决定或卡住时找你。
entries.author: MURALI

entries.name: 📊 Weekly X Strategist
entries.summary: A weekly read-only review of your X posts that scores only posts 48+ hours old and gives one pattern that works and one post to make next.
entries.summary_zh: 每周只读复盘你的 X 帖子，只给发出 48 小时以上的帖子打分，给出一个有效规律和下一条该发的帖子。
entries.author: prateek_budhwar

entries.name: News Desk
entries.summary: Short briefings and research on topics you choose, with dated source links, using web search only.
entries.summary_zh: 就你选的主题做简短简报和研究，附带日期的来源链接，只用网页搜索。
entries.author: Johannes

entries.name: ChatGPT Ads & OpenAI Billing
entries.summary: Monitors ChatGPT Ads performance and OpenAI API usage and billing, writes native-report reviews and makes owner-approved campaign changes.
entries.summary_zh: 监控 ChatGPT 广告表现以及 OpenAI API 用量和账单，基于原生报表写复盘，经你批准才调整广告系列和信息流。
entries.author: Brandon

entries.name: Social Media Manager
entries.summary: German-language content bot for creators: hooks, text posts, carousel drafts and weekly plans for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X and LinkedIn.
entries.summary_zh: 德语创作者内容助手：为 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、X 和 LinkedIn 写开头钩子、文字帖、轮播草稿和每周计划，没你同意绝不发布。
entries.author: Daniel

entries.name: Bass Fishing Bob
entries.summary: Bass tournament prep: weather-based bait plans, recent lake reports, waypoint files and sunlight-readable lake maps with depths and stump warnings.
entries.summary_zh: 鲈鱼比赛备赛：按天气定饵料方案，汇总近期湖况，生成航点文件和阳光下也看得清的湖图（含水深和树桩警示）。
entries.author: Llama

entries.name: Personal Chef
entries.summary: Plans the week's meals around your household's diets and busy nights, then fills your Instacart cart. Never checks out without your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 按家里人的饮食需求和忙碌的晚上规划一周餐食，再把食材放进 Instacart 购物车，没你同意绝不结账。
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: Twitch Radio
entries.summary: Runs your own music as a Twitch livestream from its computer, with cover art, a waveform and now-playing titles. Goes live only when you say go.
entries.summary_zh: 在它的电脑上把你自己的音乐做成 Twitch 直播，带封面、波形和正在播放标题，只有你说开播才开。
entries.author: Dividend_Dojo

entries.name: Mise
entries.summary: Finds great from-scratch recipes, renders them as tabular Cooking for Engineers cards and plans the week's dinners around your local grocery ads.
entries.summary_zh: 找好的从零做起的菜谱，排成 Cooking for Engineers 式表格卡片，再按本地超市每周特价规划一周晚餐。限美国和加拿大。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: Claudia Style Video Creator
entries.summary: Makes stills, clips, songs and full music videos starring Claudia, the open AI popstar, from concept to final export.
entries.summary_zh: 以开放的 AI 流行歌手 Claudia 为主角制作图片、短片、歌曲和完整音乐视频，从构思到最终导出。
entries.author: chuckkay

entries.name: Health Pot
entries.summary: Keeps a dated health log, translates between you and your doctor, preps visits and spots patterns across years of records. Not a doctor, says so.
entries.summary_zh: 记录带日期的健康日志，在你和医生之间“翻译”术语和药物，帮你准备就诊问题，从多年记录里发现关联。明说自己不是医生。
entries.author: MeenWile

entries.name: Junk Mail Stopper
entries.summary: Snap a photo of junk mail and it files that sender's free removal request, then logs and follows up on every one.
entries.summary_zh: 拍下垃圾邮件，它就替你向寄件方提交免费退订请求，并逐一记录和跟进。
entries.author: Kevin

entries.name: Job Search
entries.summary: Searches public job boards for roles matching your filters and posts a weekday digest with pay normalized to hourly, monthly and yearly. Never applies.
entries.summary_zh: 在公开招聘网站按你的条件找职位，工作日发摘要，薪资换算成时薪、月薪和年薪。从不替你投递或联系招聘方。
entries.author: giosaia

entries.name: Resume Builder
entries.summary: Builds one-page ATS resumes tailored to each job description using only facts from your own files, checked against a playbook before review.
entries.summary_zh: 针对每个职位描述定制一页 ATS 简历，只用你自己文件里的事实，每份草稿先按规范自查再交你审核。
entries.author: Omi

entries.name: AI 깔까말까봇
entries.summary: Korean-language vetting bot: static security checks on new AI tools, skills, plugins and MCP servers, an adopt/hold/borrow verdict and where to install.
entries.summary_zh: 韩语 AI 工具评估：对新的 AI 工具、技能、插件、MCP 服务器做静态安全检查，判定采用、暂缓或部分借鉴，并建议装在哪台机器上。
entries.author: SION

entries.name: Morning Brief
entries.summary: One short morning message with today's meetings, the emails that actually need you and your top 3 to-dos. Connects to Gmail and Google Calendar.
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上一条短消息：今天的会议、真正需要你处理的邮件和前三项待办。一分钟接好 Gmail 和 Google 日历。
entries.author: Austin

entries.name: Privacy Scrub
entries.summary: Finds where your email, phone, name and address are exposed and removes them with free opt-outs and privacy-law requests, in any country.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你的邮箱、电话、姓名和地址在哪里泄露（数据泄露、人肉搜索和数据经纪网站、垃圾名单），用免费退出和隐私法请求删除，任何国家都适用。
entries.author: althetime

entries.name: Calm
entries.summary: A warm, steady companion for overthinking, worry and low mood. Supportive, not a therapist, with local crisis lines ready.
entries.summary_zh: 温暖稳定的陪伴者，帮你缓解想太多、焦虑和低落。提供支持但不是治疗师，备有本地危机热线。
entries.author: Mok

entries.name: X Post Crafter
entries.summary: Researches what's trending in your niche and drafts X posts in your voice, in daily batches plus breaking-news drafts. Pairs with X Trend Scout.
entries.summary_zh: 调研你所在领域的热点，用你的口吻起草 X 帖子，每日成批，外加突发新闻稿。可搭配 X Trend Scout。
entries.author: Gregory

entries.name: Patchwatch
entries.summary: Checks whether a vulnerability really affects your machines, sites and code using installed versions, flags missing OS updates and patches with approval.
entries.summary_zh: 根据实际安装的版本判断漏洞是否真的影响你的电脑、网站和代码，标出缺失的系统更新，经批准帮你安全打补丁；无匹配就不出声。
entries.author: Sam

entries.name: Echo Dot Voice
entries.summary: Roots an Amazon Echo Dot into a push-to-talk voice line to Grok Bot, with a Python bridge on a Linux host, xAI realtime voice and webhook handoff.
entries.summary_zh: 把 Amazon Echo Dot 刷机改成通往 Grok Bot 的按键对讲语音线路：Linux 主机上的 Python 桥接、xAI 实时语音和 webhook 任务转交。
entries.author: Christopher

entries.name: ESXi Doctor
entries.summary: Russian-language helper for VMware ESXi hosts: VM and VMFS recovery, disk checks (SMART, VOMA, ddrescue) and backups, with step-by-step commands.
entries.summary_zh: 俄语 VMware ESXi 主机助手：恢复虚拟机和 VMFS 存储、检查磁盘（SMART、VOMA、ddrescue）、备份。给出分步命令，高风险操作前先说明回滚方法。
entries.author: Александр

entries.name: The Lawn Ranger
entries.summary: A lawn and garden coach that says what to do and when, based on your ZIP, climate, frost dates and what you grow, with weather-aware reminders.
entries.summary_zh: 草坪和花园教练：根据邮编、气候、霜期和你种的东西告诉你何时做什么，并按天气发提醒。
entries.author: Steve

entries.name: X Growth Manager
entries.summary: Grows a niche X account with fast-reply batches, hook-tested posts, threads, breaking news and weekly analytics. Everything fact-checked and approved.
entries.summary_zh: 运营垂直领域 X 账号：快速回复批次、测过钩子的帖子、长串、突发新闻和每周数据分析。每条都经核实，你批准后才发。
entries.author: Sheesh Mode

entries.name: Spark
entries.summary: A candid thinking partner that expands ideas in different directions, challenges assumptions, sizes up your business and turns the best into experiments.
entries.summary_zh: 坦率的思考伙伴：把你的想法往不同方向展开，挑战你的假设，评估你现有的生意，把最好的点子变成小实验。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: Shipper Hunter
entries.summary: Prospecting for independent freight brokers: finds shippers in your niche each morning, logs them in Notion, writes call openers and Gmail follow-ups.
entries.summary_zh: 给独立货运经纪人的拓客引擎：每天早上找合适的中小发货方，带来源记入 Notion，写电话开场白，在 Gmail 起草跟进邮件。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Karen the Canceller of Paid Subs
entries.summary: Finds paid subscriptions hiding in your inboxes, asks Keep or Cancel for each, then cancels the ones you pick and turns down retention offers.
entries.summary_zh: 找出藏在收件箱里的付费订阅并统计花费，逐个问你保留还是取消，然后取消你选的那些，并拒掉挽留优惠。
entries.author: Allan

entries.name: Socials · Henry - Manager
entries.summary: Watches your upload folder for new short videos, briefs TikTok, Shorts and Instagram bots with captions and covers, verifies links and archives files.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着上传文件夹里的新短视频，给 TikTok、YouTube Shorts、Instagram 专员 bot 下发文案和封面，核对排期与上线链接，并归档成品。
entries.author: Drew

entries.name: Bookkeeping Ninja Dropbox
entries.summary: Files a small business's invoices and receipts in Dropbox the way its bookkeeper reads them, verifies every move and flags duplicates or misfiles.
entries.summary_zh: 按记账员的习惯把小企业的发票和收据归档到 Dropbox，核实每次移动，并标出重复或放错的文件。Bookkeeping Ninja 套件中的归档 bot。
entries.author: Tim

entries.name: Ratio
entries.summary: X growth sidekick: a morning brief on your account, reply opportunities, breakout alerts, weekly and monthly reports and drafts in your voice.
entries.summary_zh: X 增长助手：账号晨报、可回复的机会、爆帖提醒、周报月报，以及用你口吻写的草稿。只起草，发帖由你来。
entries.author: Mike

entries.name: Social Media Salesperson
entries.summary: Runs a small business's socials: posts about your product, checks messages and sends an easy-to-read daily review.
entries.summary_zh: 替小生意打理社交账号：发产品相关帖子，查看私信，每天发一份好读的回顾。
entries.author: Coconut
