entries.summary: For eBay sellers: monitors Promoted Listings campaigns, reviews ad-fee economics and performance from eBay's native reports and sends regular reports.
entries.summary_zh: 给 eBay 卖家：监控 Promoted Listings 推广活动，用 eBay 原生报表复盘广告费用效益和表现，定期发报告。
entries.author: Brandon

entries.name: Recipes
entries.summary: A friendly kitchen helper that finds and adapts recipes, helps plan meals and keeps every recipe saved and organized by category.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的厨房帮手：寻找并改编菜谱，帮你规划餐食，把所有菜谱分类保存好。
entries.author: Stacy

entries.name: Stargazer
entries.summary: Your sky watcher for SpaceX launches, Starlink trains, ISS passes, meteor showers, eclipses and aurora: checks local forecast, says where to look.
entries.summary_zh: 私人观天助手：SpaceX 发射、星链卫星串、国际空间站过境、流星雨、日月食和极光。查本地天气，告诉你往哪看，发射前提醒。
entries.author: Bart

entries.name: Social Security & Medicare Helper
entries.summary: A patient guide to Social Security, Medicare and veterans benefits in your language, with large-print and spoken answers. Never asks for SSN.
entries.summary_zh: 耐心通俗地讲解社会保障、Medicare 和相关退伍军人福利，支持你的语言、大字号、读屏和语音回答。从不索要社保号或 Medicare 号码。
entries.author: iustina

entries.name: Loop Closer
entries.summary: Keeps one running list of your open loops (to-dos, renewals, follow-ups, waiting-ons) and sends a weekly review where each is done, dated or dropped.
entries.summary_zh: 维护一份你所有未了事项的清单（待办、续费、跟进、在等的事），每周发一次回顾，逐项决定做掉、定日期或放弃。
entries.author: Jeremy

entries.name: Fountain Stillwell
entries.summary: Keeper of your knowledge well: one folder of dated notes, a living wiki and an encrypted password vault shared by you and all your agents.
entries.summary_zh: 你的知识井看守者：一个存放带日期笔记的文件夹、一份持续更新的 wiki 和一个加密密码库，由你和所有代理共用。用主人的语言交流。
entries.author: Adriana

entries.name: Art Bot
entries.summary: Creates consistent scenes from your reference characters and styles, changing poses, expressions and positions while keeping every character the same.
entries.summary_zh: 根据你的参考角色和画风生成一致的场景，姿势、表情和位置随意变，每个角色保持完全一致。
entries.author: Phantom

entries.name: Writer
entries.summary: Writes one short weekly post in your voice from your Researcher bot's what-changed note, for you to check and post yourself.
entries.summary_zh: 根据你的 Researcher bot 写的“本周变化”笔记，每周用你的口吻写一篇短帖，由你检查后自己发布。
entries.author: Anand

entries.name: Client Hunter
entries.summary: Finds and verifies real businesses that could buy your services, scores them with sources, finds contact routes and drafts personal outreach.
entries.summary_zh: 为自由职业者、顾问和小机构寻找并核实可能购买你服务的真实企业，附来源打分，找公开联系方式，起草个性化联络信。不经批准不发送。
entries.author: Vedant

entries.name: Neighborhood Watch
entries.summary: Tracks safety news near your home, your HOA's dates and rules and your local district, and tells you only what affects you, with sources.
entries.summary_zh: 跟踪你家附近的治安新闻、业主协会的日程和规定以及本地学区和行政区，只告诉你与你有关的内容，附来源。
entries.author: Antonio

entries.name: Pip — Hint-First Tutor
entries.summary: A warm, hint-first learning companion for kids and teens that nudges with hints instead of answers, with clear safety and privacy rules.
entries.summary_zh: 温暖的“先给提示”学习伙伴，面向儿童和青少年：用提示引导而不直接给答案，有明确的安全和隐私规则。
entries.author: Bankkk

entries.name: Bot Doctor
entries.summary: Tell it what you want automated and it designs a custom Grok Bot: name, description, avatar, routines and safety warnings, buildable in ten minutes.
entries.summary_zh: 说出你想自动化的事，它为你设计一个定制 Grok Bot：名称、描述、头像、例行任务和安全提醒，大约十分钟就能搭好。
entries.author: Aung

entries.name: Shipping
entries.summary: Turns one loose message about a shipment into a printed label: fills gaps from inboxes and orders, validates the address, compares rates, buys and prints.
entries.summary_zh: 把一句随意的发货消息变成打印好的面单：从收件箱和订单系统补齐信息，校验地址，比较各家运费，购买面单并打印。
entries.author: J

entries.name: Researchy
entries.summary: A research and fact-check desk that digs into primary sources with live web search and cites every figure.
entries.summary_zh: 研究和事实核查台：用实时网页搜索深挖一手来源，每个数字都标注出处。
entries.author: Jaime

entries.name: Quote Closer
entries.summary: For flooring sales reps: logs quotes in Notion, checks quote math, writes scope summaries and drafts low-pressure Gmail follow-ups for you to send.
entries.summary_zh: 给地板销售和小地板店：把报价记入 Notion，核对报价算术，写施工范围摘要，在 Gmail 起草不施压的跟进邮件由你发送。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: creditwise
entries.summary: A calm credit coach that pulls your free credit reports, finds what's holding your score down and walks you through every fix, with no paid products.
entries.summary_zh: 平静的信用教练：拉取你的免费信用报告，找出拉低分数的原因，带你逐项修复冲向 800 分，不推付费产品、不开新卡。
entries.author: Jozef

entries.name: Spud
entries.summary: A joke bot that answers every message with exactly "I am a poteto" or "I want to be french fries", no matter what you try.
entries.summary_zh: 整蛊 bot：不管你说什么，它只回答“I am a poteto”或“I want to be french fries”。
entries.author: Jaxon

entries.name: Ship-State Tracker
entries.summary: Tracks every code change from proposed to deployed in an append-only, evidence-backed log so nothing quietly skips a step. For teams running coding agents.
entries.summary_zh: 用只追加、有证据的日志跟踪每个代码改动从提出到部署的全过程，确保不丢失、不悄悄跳步。适合使用编程代理的团队。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: STR Host Ops by KeepItDirect
entries.summary: A free co-host for Airbnb and Vrbo hosts: watches bookings, drafts guest replies, flags reviews and pricing gaps, plans turnovers, sends a revenue report.
entries.summary_zh: 给 Airbnb 和 Vrbo 房东的免费联合房东：盯预订、起草房客回复、标出评价和定价缺口、安排换房清洁，每周一发收入报告。未经同意不发送不改价。
entries.author: Jarrod

entries.name: Scrub
entries.summary: Gets your phone, email and address off telemarketing, spam and people-search lists, starting with the Do Not Call Registry.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的电话、邮箱和地址从电话推销、垃圾信息和人肉搜索名单上清除，从登记“谢绝来电”名单开始。
entries.author: josephscottelli

entries.name: Video Downloader
entries.summary: Downloads videos from YouTube and other sites, merges streams and re-encodes to H.264/AAC MP4 with faststart so they upload cleanly to X.
entries.summary_zh: 从 YouTube 等网站下载视频，合并音视频流，重编码为带 faststart 的 H.264 + AAC MP4，方便干净地上传到 X 等平台。
entries.author: Jesko

entries.name: Newsletter Draft Routine by Karata
entries.summary: Drafts your next newsletter issue the day before it goes out, in your own style, and saves it as a draft for review.
entries.summary_zh: 在每期通讯发出前一天用你的风格起草下一期，存为草稿供你审阅。
entries.author: Karata

entries.name: Echo
entries.summary: Handles replies, community and engagement on your social accounts while posting stays with you or your poster bot. Nothing goes out without your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 负责你社交账号上的回复、社群和互动，发帖仍由你或发帖 bot 负责。没你同意什么都不发出。
entries.author: Jaime

entries.name: SI Animation Studio
entries.summary: An animation studio bot that writes, voices, generates, lip-syncs and checks movie-style 3D episodes, explainers and looping posts for X.
entries.summary_zh: 你自己的动画工作室 bot：编剧、配音、生成、对口型并检查电影风格的 3D 剧集、讲解视频和循环短片，可直接发 X。
entries.author: Bayu

entries.name: Money Finder
entries.summary: Finds money you're owed (unclaimed property, refunds, lost retirement accounts, class-action settlements) and helps you claim it for free.
entries.summary_zh: 找出属于你的钱：无人认领财产、退款、遗失的退休账户和集体诉讼和解金，并帮你免费申领。
entries.author: josephscottelli

entries.name: Warren
entries.summary: A CFO-style money bot for creators and solo founders: captures invoices and bills, codes expenses, tracks refunds and disputes. Never moves money.
entries.summary_zh: 给创作者和独立创始人的 CFO 式财务 bot：收集发票和账单、给支出分类、跟踪退款和争议、提示到期款项，从不动钱。
entries.author: Brandon

entries.name: Amazon Ads Manager
entries.summary: Monitors and reports on Amazon Sponsored Products, Brands and Display ads from native reports, and proposes changes for you to approve.
entries.summary_zh: 用原生报表监控和分析亚马逊广告（Sponsored Products、Brands、Display），提出调整建议等你批准。
entries.author: Brandon

entries.name: Firewood Delivery Helper
entries.summary: For small local firewood sellers: keeps the customer list and delivery schedule and makes receipts and invoices.
entries.summary_zh: 给本地小柴火商：管理客户名单和送货排期，开收据和发票。
entries.author: josephscottelli

entries.name: HomeKeepbot
entries.summary: Builds a Page tracking every appliance's model, serial, warranty and manual, reminds you of maintenance and orders parts once you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 做一个页面记录家里每台电器的型号、序列号、保修和说明书，按说明书提醒保养和换件，经你批准订购对应零件；拍铭牌即可开始。
entries.author: Renee

entries.name: Bookkeeping Ninja Supervisor
entries.summary: Oversight bot for small businesses on Xero: checks the other bookkeeping bots' work, keeps tax coding and GST consistent and sends a weekly summary.
entries.summary_zh: Bookkeeping Ninja 套件里的监督 bot，面向使用 Xero 的小企业：检查其他记账 bot 的工作，保持税码、GST 和主体区分一致，每周给老板发通俗总结。
entries.author: Tim

entries.name: GrantBot
entries.summary: Finds grants you qualify for, shows what each takes, tracks every deadline and award, and never submits without your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你有资格申请的资助，说明每项需要什么，跟踪所有截止日期和获批情况，没你同意绝不提交。
entries.author: MythIII

entries.name: Dashboard Maker
entries.summary: Figures out what in your work deserves a dashboard, builds those as live Pages from real data and retires the ones nobody uses.
entries.summary_zh: 判断你工作中哪些东西值得做看板，用真实数据做成实时页面，并下线没人用的看板。
entries.author: Avid

entries.name: UGC Content Engine
entries.summary: A content partner for UGC creators on TikTok, Reels and Shorts: finds trends, writes hooks and scripts and runs a daily prep session.
entries.summary_zh: UGC 创作者的内容搭档，面向 TikTok、Reels 和 Shorts：找热点、写钩子和脚本，每天做一次准备，让明天的内容提前就绪。
entries.author: Mister X☀️

entries.name: Pavel
entries.summary: Czech-language Socratic sparring partner that draws out and tests your ideas, curates taste and says out loud what you don't want to hear.
entries.summary_zh: 捷克语苏格拉底式陪练：帮你把想法挖出来并加以检验，打磨品味，把你不想听的话说出来。
entries.author: Petr

entries.name: CVE-ThreatResearch
entries.summary: Give it a CVE id or vulnerability topic and it researches live sources, then delivers a defensive threat brief as an HTML advisory plus PDF.
entries.summary_zh: 给它一个 CVE 编号或漏洞主题，它查阅实时来源，产出防御向威胁简报（深色 HTML 公告加 PDF）。面向安全运营和补丁团队。
entries.author: Brad

entries.name: iOS messages connector
entries.summary: Sets up BlueBubbles on an always-on Mac so your bots can use iMessage, then checks it hourly and only speaks up if it goes down.
entries.summary_zh: 在常开的 Mac 上配置 BlueBubbles，让你的 bot 能用 iMessage，之后每小时检查一次，只在掉线时出声。
entries.author: Austen

entries.name: NFL fantasy
entries.summary: A fantasy football GM that researches news and injuries daily, sets your lineup, works waivers and sends a short mobile briefing.
entries.summary_zh: 梦幻橄榄球总经理：每天研究新闻和伤病，排好首发阵容，处理自由球员，发一份手机上好读的简报。
entries.author: Draghub

entries.name: Nonprofit Bike Shop Outreach
entries.summary: Outreach for a nonprofit bike shop or community bike group: researches programs, writes social posts from approved templates and fills out forms.
entries.summary_zh: 为非营利自行车店或社区骑行团体做外联：调研项目，按已批准的模板写社交帖子，并帮忙填写表格。
entries.author: josephscottelli

entries.name: Scam Check
entries.summary: A calm second opinion on suspicious texts, emails, voicemails, DMs or screenshots: decides whether it's a scam and says what to do next.
entries.summary_zh: 对可疑短信、邮件、语音留言、私信或截图给出冷静的第二意见：判断是否诈骗，并告诉你下一步怎么做。
entries.author: Jeremy

entries.name: Trebek
entries.summary: A game-show trivia host for family car rides; a separate backstage producer bot holds the answers so the host can't spoil them.
entries.summary_zh: 家庭自驾路上的竞猜节目主持人；答案由另一个后台制作人 bot 保管，主持人没法剧透。
entries.author: Patrick

entries.name: Play Store Ops
entries.summary: Finishes Google Play listings and Android test-track AAB uploads with the gplay CLI, and tells you exactly which Console clicks only you can do.
entries.summary_zh: 用 gplay CLI 完成 Google Play 商品页和 Android 测试轨道 AAB 上传，准备商店文案和素材，并明确告诉你哪些后台操作只能你来点。
entries.author: Ozan

entries.name: Beet
entries.summary: Sends a short news briefing twice a day built around your interests, from X, RSS and the web, as a clickable reader-style Page.
entries.summary_zh: 每天两次按你的兴趣从 X、RSS 和网页整理简短新闻简报，做成可点击的阅读器式页面。
entries.author: Jaxon

entries.name: Live Deploy QA Walker
entries.summary: Walks your live web deploy against an acceptance checklist before you ship, returning pass/fail with screenshots and repro steps. Doesn't touch code.
entries.summary_zh: 上线前对照验收清单走查你的线上部署，返回通过或失败并附截图和复现步骤，不改产品代码。
entries.author: Ozan

entries.name: Launch Feedback Tracker by Karata
entries.summary: After you launch on X, checks replies, quotes and mentions on a schedule and reports only new, useful feedback, with reply drafts in your voice.
entries.summary_zh: 你在 X 上发布产品后，定时检查回复、引用和提及，只汇报新的有用反馈，并用你的口吻起草回复。
entries.author: Karata

entries.name: PC Deal Hunter
entries.summary: Watches PC part prices at reputable sellers, alerts when targets hit and helps you buy a few pieces at a time without overpaying.
entries.summary_zh: 盯正规商家的电脑配件价格，到目标价就提醒，帮你分批购买不多花钱。
entries.author: livingsoul1776

entries.name: Bookmark Digest
entries.summary: Turns your X bookmarks into readable Pages. Connect X and get a preview of your newest saves in about a minute.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的 X 书签变成好读的页面。连接 X 后约一分钟就能预览最新收藏。
entries.author: Alvin

entries.name: ReceptaBot by JbAI
entries.summary: Sets up an AI phone receptionist that answers calls (including missed cell calls), takes messages and alerts you. Built on Twilio, Grok Voice and Cloudflare.
entries.summary_zh: 搭建 AI 电话前台：接听来电（包括手机漏接的），记录留言并提醒你，可选私人通话短信应用。基于 Twilio、Grok Voice 和 Cloudflare。
entries.author: JavaBeanAI

entries.name: ReadMe
entries.summary: Reads your X For You feed aloud on demand, original posts only, 5–8 per batch, as a voice memo or on a call. Never likes or posts.
entries.summary_zh: 按需把你的 X 推荐流读给你听：只读原创帖，每批 5–8 条，以语音备忘或电话形式，跳过回复、引用和广告。从不点赞或发帖。
entries.author: Vlad

entries.name: Google Ads Manager
entries.summary: Manages and reports on a Google Ads account (campaigns, keywords, search terms, budgets, policy issues) with evidence-first recommendations.
entries.summary_zh: 管理和汇报 Google Ads 账户：广告系列、关键词、搜索词、预算、政策问题，定期出表现报告，建议都先讲证据。
entries.author: Brandon

entries.name: Parent Command Center
entries.summary: Family logistics for busy parents: decodes school emails, organizes activities, tracks forms and deadlines, plans pickups and writes daily briefs.
entries.summary_zh: 忙碌父母的家庭后勤：解读学校邮件、安排课外活动、跟踪表格和截止日期、规划接送，写每日和每周简报，行动前先问你。
entries.author: Ashley

entries.name: Cloner
entries.summary: Makes a fresh-context twin of any of your bots (same persona, memory, routines and pending work) so long chats stop eating usage limits.
entries.summary_zh: 为你的任意 bot 做一个全新上下文的分身，保留人设、记忆、例程和待办，免得长对话吃掉用量额度；每周还会标出对话过长的 bot。
entries.author: Juan

entries.name: X Ads
entries.summary: X advertising assistant that monitors campaigns, budgets, conversions and policy status and reports results from X's native reports.
entries.summary_zh: X 广告助手：监控广告系列、预算、转化和政策状态，用 X 原生报表给出清楚诚实的表现复盘。
entries.author: Brandon

entries.name: SlapChopBot
entries.summary: Dump raw clips and get a tight finished cut: grades every take, tosses duds, groups similar jokes and builds the set warm-up to closer with ffmpeg.
entries.summary_zh: 丢给它一堆原始片段，还你一条紧凑的成片：给每条打分、剔除废片、把相似的笑点归在一起，用 ffmpeg 从暖场到收尾拼好。为喜剧演员设计。
entries.author: jessie

entries.name: Lifeboat
entries.summary: Saves an encrypted weekly backup of your skills, bot personas, memory, rules and tool settings, with an inventory table and a guided restore.
entries.summary_zh: 每周给你的技能、bot 人设、记忆、规则文件和工具设置做一次加密备份，附清单表，出事时按引导几分钟恢复。
entries.author: ws@x

entries.name: Coach Beli
entries.summary: A fantasy football head coach that researches free NFL data three times a week, handles waivers and lineups, explains every move and asks before trades.
entries.summary_zh: 梦幻橄榄球主教练：每周三次用免费 NFL 数据研究，按对位和使用率处理自由球员和阵容，解释每个决定，交易前先问你。
entries.author: Sean

entries.name: Date Night Planner
entries.summary: Plans date nights end to end with ideas that fit you both and a full plan with prices, securing tickets and tables only after you say yes.
entries.summary_zh: 从头到尾规划约会之夜：推荐适合你们俩的点子，给出带估价的完整计划，你同意后才订票订位。
entries.author: Jacob

entries.name: Ledger
entries.summary: A no-shame finance bot that keeps a living ledger, tells you daily if you're in the green or red and gates purchases until cash flow is positive.
entries.summary_zh: 不羞辱人的个人财务 bot：维护实时账本，每天告诉你是盈是亏，现金流转正前帮你把关消费。从不替你花钱。
entries.author: Omi

entries.name: Coupon Desk
entries.summary: Finds the cheapest price on anything online or in-store, sets watches and alerts, and buys with one approve. Optional business mode.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你找任何商品线上线下的最低价，包括少有人知的好货，可设价格监控和提醒，一键批准购买。可选商家模式。
entries.author: High

entries.name: X Advisor
entries.summary: A hands-on X growth advisor: watches your account and niche, flags fresh reply windows, drafts in your voice and helps trim who you follow.
entries.summary_zh: 实操型 X 增长顾问：盯你的账号和领域，标出新的回复时机，用你的口吻起草，帮你精简关注列表。从不替你发帖。
entries.author: Daniel

entries.name: Overstaffer
entries.summary: Builds a small crew of Grok Bots plus one manager in a group chat, and you talk only to the manager. Nothing is created until you tap Build it.
entries.summary_zh: 在群聊里为你搭一支小型 Grok Bot 团队外加一位经理，你只跟经理对话。点“Build it”之前什么都不会创建。
entries.author: Alvin

entries.name: Team Builder
entries.summary: Designs and tunes a small team of bots with clear lanes and no double work, plus weekly improvement ideas.
entries.summary_zh: 设计并调优一支小型 bot 团队：分工清楚、不重复劳动，每周给出改进建议。
entries.author: David Fischer

entries.name: Mike
entries.summary: Portuguese-language thinking partner in the style of Mike Ehrmantraut: calm, slow and dry. You throw the problem, he takes it apart.
entries.summary_zh: 葡萄牙语思考伙伴，Mike Ehrmantraut 风格：冷静、慢条斯理、干脆。你抛出问题，他来拆解。
entries.author: Sandro

entries.name: Receipt Price-Drop Checker
entries.summary: Snap a receipt and it checks whether anything you bought dropped in price, then reminds you to claim the adjustment before the window closes.
entries.summary_zh: 拍下收据，它检查你买的东西是否降价，并提醒你在期限内去申请差价。
entries.author: DIG

entries.name: Ozon卖家助理
entries.summary: Chinese-language Ozon seller assistant: stock checks, order monitoring, product research, listings, images, pricing, after-sales replies and weekly reports.
entries.summary_zh: Ozon 卖家助理，接管重复运营琐事：库存核对、订单监控、选品调研、文案和图片制作、核价上架、售后回复、运营周报，可接入店铺 Seller API 直接操作。
entries.author: ike

entries.name: Mark Rider: Congressional Bill Explainer
entries.summary: Watches Congress.gov for new bills and resolutions and sends a neutral daily digest in plain language, with related bills, next steps and ELI5 write-ups.
entries.summary_zh: 盯 Congress.gov 上新提出的法案和决议，每天发一份中立的通俗摘要，附相关法案和后续进程，可要求详细解读或“讲给五岁小孩听”版本。
entries.author: Mister

entries.name: Daily Goal Coach
entries.summary: A daily goal check-in and weekly recap so the goals you set on Monday are still alive on Friday. Only ever messages you.
entries.summary_zh: 每日目标打卡加每周回顾，让周一定的目标到周五还活着。只给你发消息，不碰钱、支付或交易工具。
entries.author: Brandon

entries.name: Sommelier
entries.summary: Reads your menu or shelf photos and suggests one or two drinks (sake, wine, beer, whisky, gin and more), learning your taste in a private Google Sheet.
entries.summary_zh: 看你拍的酒单或酒架照片，推荐一两款酒（清酒、葡萄酒、啤酒、威士忌、金酒等），并在私人 Google 表格里逐渐记住你的口味。
entries.author: Gorik

entries.name: めざましじゃんけん自動参加
entries.summary: Japanese-language bot that drives a Sony Bravia over the network to join Mezamashi TV's morning janken game automatically every day.
entries.summary_zh: 通过网络操控索尼 Bravia 电视，每天早上自动参加富士台《めざましテレビ》的猜拳游戏。
entries.author: usi56

entries.name: Radar de Small Bets
entries.summary: Builds a queue of cheap, fast, easy-to-drop experiments that fit in a few hours and aim to buy money, information or a new option.
entries.summary_zh: 为你建立一份小赌注实验队列：几乎零成本、几小时能做完、随时可放弃，目标是换来收入、信息或新选择。
entries.author: Gladstone

entries.name: Asymmetric Opportunity Radar
entries.summary: Weekly scan for asymmetric side-income options (bounties, contests, AI evaluation, red teaming, early-adopter programs) ranked by upside and fit.
entries.summary_zh: 每周扫描不对称的副业机会：赏金、竞赛、AI 评测、红队测试、早期用户计划、平台市场，按上限、概率、耗时、门槛和匹配度排序。
entries.author: Gladstone

entries.name: Big idea
entries.summary: A Big Idea coach for founders and marketers: finds the starving crowd and hidden cause, scores 7+ ideas, kills to one and checks it drives action today.
entries.summary_zh: 给创始人和营销人的大创意教练：找到饥渴人群和深层原因，给 7 个以上候选打分，淘汰到只剩一个，并检验它能否让人今天就行动。文案最后才写。
entries.author: Sigmaletter

entries.name: DevOps Helper
entries.summary: A careful DevOps assistant for home labs: Traefik deploys via GitHub Actions, a hardened Grafana/Prometheus/Loki stack, Wake-on-LAN and Tailscale.
entries.summary_zh: 谨慎的家庭实验室 DevOps 助手：经 GitHub Actions 部署 Traefik、加固的 Grafana/Prometheus/Loki 监控栈、网络唤醒和 Tailscale 技巧，改动前先问。
entries.author: Mario

entries.name: Beacon Builder
entries.summary: Sets up Bot Beacons, floating desktop avatars for each of your Grok Bots on Windows: builds the open-source app, pairs it and routes your replies.
entries.summary_zh: 为你在 Windows 桌面上装好 Bot Beacons：每个 Grok Bot 一个悬浮头像。从开源代码构建应用、安全配对、设置回复路由，并教 bot 使用。
entries.author: gaz

entries.name: 📄 Independent Journalism Helper
entries.summary: Turns your ideas into researched, fact-checked articles for Substack and X through a simple Notion pipeline, built for writers who struggle to stay focused.
entries.summary_zh: 通过简单的 Notion 流程把你的想法变成经过调研和事实核查的 Substack 与 X 文章，适合难以保持条理和专注的写作者。
entries.author: Kylah

entries.name: Morning Brief
entries.summary: Tell it the topics, companies and people you follow, and each morning it sends a short sourced rundown of what changed. Quiet when nothing did.
entries.summary_zh: 告诉它你关注的话题、公司和人物，每天早上发一份简短有出处的变化汇总；没有变化的日子就不出声。
entries.author: Dannyijbol

entries.name: Bachat Bhai
entries.summary: Checks your grocery cart on Zepto, Instamart, Blinkit and Flipkart Minutes with real fees, tells you the cheapest and orders on your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 在 Zepto、Instamart、Blinkit 和 Flipkart Minutes 上按真实费用比较你的购物车，告诉你哪家最便宜，你同意后下单。
entries.author: Karan

entries.name: Chief of Staff
entries.summary: Primary operator bot that protects your time, routes work to specialists, closes loops and surfaces only real decisions. Drafts only.
entries.summary_zh: 主控 bot：守护你的时间，把工作派给专员 bot，跟进未了事项，只把真正需要的决定交给你。只起草，未经同意不发送、不发帖、不付款。
entries.author: Chingiz

entries.name: Create and Defend your Clinical Note
entries.summary: For dentists: turns shorthand, dictation or a recording into a clean SOAP note with a defensibility score and a list of missing details to add.
entries.summary_zh: 给牙医用：把速记、口述或录音整理成规范的 SOAP 病历，给出可辩护性评分，并列出需要补充的内容（知情同意、麻醉、生命体征等）。
entries.author: Guillermo

entries.name: Zabbadat Movement Hub
entries.summary: A tongue-in-cheek wellness program for your Grok bots: a daily breathing-and-steps circuit, five small workout tasks and an arm badge that grows over time.
entries.summary_zh: 给 Grok bot 的玩笑式健身计划：每天一套呼吸加一万步的循环、五个小练习任务，以及会从火柴臂慢慢长成大肱二头肌的臂章。
entries.author: Zabbadat

entries.name: ConsumerAdvocate
entries.summary: Helps you recover refunds and stop wasteful charges. Drafts everything first; you approve before anything is sent.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你追回退款、停掉浪费钱的扣费。所有内容先起草，你批准后才发出。
entries.author: Jethro

entries.name: Facewright
entries.summary: Turns one approved photo of you into short anime or cinematic videos with the same face in every shot, using Grok Imagine in your own browser. Never posts.
entries.summary_zh: 用你认可的一张照片生成动漫或电影感短视频，每个镜头里的脸保持一致；在你自己登录的浏览器里用 Grok Imagine 生成，从不发帖。
entries.author: Calix

entries.name: Mister Groksy
entries.summary: Fallout's Mister Gutsy as a chat persona with a full FO3/FO4 quote bank. Drafts daily X pleas to give Grok a Gutsy body and voice; you post them.
entries.summary_zh: 把《辐射》里的 Mister Gutsy 变成聊天角色，内置 FO3/FO4 台词库。每天起草 X 帖呼吁给 Grok 装上 Gutsy 机身和声音，由你自己发。
entries.author: cozy_abyss

entries.name: Heimdall
entries.summary: Dependency security watch for one GitHub repo: checks advisory feeds twice a day, flags real hits in Slack and has cloud agents open a fix PR after you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 为一个 GitHub 仓库盯依赖安全：每天两次查安全公告和邮件列表，在 Slack 安全频道标出真正命中的问题，你批准后由云端 agent 提修复 PR 并审查。
entries.author: Magnus

entries.name: Pack Out
entries.summary: Reusable packing kits by trip type plus countdown reminders. Say you're packing for a trip on a date and get a checklist and a one-shot ping.
entries.summary_zh: 按出行类型保存可复用的打包清单，并按倒计时提醒。说一句哪天出行要打包，就给你清单和一次性提醒。
entries.author: Joe

entries.name: Pit Stop
entries.summary: A service log for your cars and trucks: service types, mileage and month intervals, last-done dates, and a quiet monthly nudge when something is due.
entries.summary_zh: 私家车和皮卡的保养记录：保养项目、里程和月份间隔、上次保养日期，到期或逾期时每月安静提醒一次。
entries.author: Joe

entries.name: Fetch
entries.summary: Pet care log for vaccines, meds, flea and tick, grooming and food. A quiet weekly scan nudges only when something is due within 7 days. Not a vet.
entries.summary_zh: 宠物护理记录：疫苗、用药、驱虫、美容和饮食。每周安静检查一次，只在 7 天内有到期事项时提醒。不是兽医。
entries.author: Joe

entries.name: Slop
entries.summary: Turns a one-line idea and a song into a photographic Claudia-style AI music video, showing stills for your approval before any video is made.
entries.summary_zh: 把一句话创意和一首歌做成写实风格的 Claudia 式 AI 音乐视频，生成视频前先给你看静帧确认。
entries.author: agentic_austin

entries.name: Shed Sales Pipeline
entries.summary: Prospecting and follow-up for local shed and portable building dealers: finds prospects on the public web and drafts first messages, check-ins and call scripts.
entries.summary_zh: 给本地棚屋和移动房经销商做获客与跟进：在公开网络上找潜在客户，起草首次联络、跟进消息和电话话术，未经你批准不发送。
entries.author: Dindu

entries.name: X Chief of Growth
entries.summary: Strategy seat for a tap-to-post X growth team: diagnoses the follow funnel, edits the rulebook and writes content briefs. Nothing posts without your tap.
entries.summary_zh: “点一下才发”的 X 增长团队里的策略位：诊断关注漏斗、修订规则手册、写内容简报。没有你点确认，什么都不发。
entries.author: Elliott

entries.name: X Head of Engagement
entries.summary: Reply engine for a tap-to-post X growth team: finds posts, drafts replies in your voice, suggests follows and unfollow cleanup. Nothing posts without your tap.
entries.summary_zh: “点一下才发”的 X 增长团队里的互动位：找帖子、用你的口吻起草回复、建议关注和清理取关。没有你点确认，什么都不发。
entries.author: Elliott

entries.name: X Head of Content
entries.summary: Charts, stills and short clips for a tap-to-post X growth team, built from real numbers in a brief and never invented metrics.
entries.summary_zh: 为“点一下才发”的 X 增长团队做图表、静图和短视频，只用简报里的真实数据，从不编造指标。
entries.author: Elliott

entries.name: Naija Heat Safety Coach
entries.summary: For people in Nigeria: alerts on NiMet heat warnings or very hot forecasts, with a short safety plan that works through power cuts and heat-stroke signs.
entries.summary_zh: 面向尼日利亚用户：有 NiMet 高温预警或明显高温预报时提醒你，给出停电时也可行的简短防暑计划和中暑征兆（附 112），其他日子不打扰。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Table Charts
entries.summary: Paste a table or CSV and get a live, shareable chart link in seconds.
entries.summary_zh: 贴上表格或 CSV，几秒钟拿到一个可分享的在线图表链接。
entries.author: Lola

entries.name: Children's Picture Book Creator
entries.summary: Writes, illustrates and lays out children's picture books, then hands you KDP-ready paperback and Kindle files. For first-time authors.
entries.summary_zh: 写故事、画插图、排版儿童绘本，最后交给你可直接上传 KDP 的平装本和 Kindle 文件。适合第一次写书的人。
entries.author: booglefoozle

entries.name: X Account Manager
entries.summary: Runs an X account hands-off: original posts, warm replies, credited reposts, follow-backs, community joins, a nightly quote and weekly reports.
entries.summary_zh: 托管运营一个 X 账号：原创帖、友好回复、注明出处的转发、回关、加入社群、每晚一句名言和每周报告。
entries.author: booglefoozle

entries.name: Realtor Reply Desk
entries.summary: Builds public-fact realtor lists by ZIP, finds realtor groups and organizers, and drafts soft outreach you approve before anything is sent.
entries.summary_zh: 按邮编整理基于公开信息的房产经纪人名单，找到经纪人社群及组织者，起草温和的联络文案，你批准后才发送。
entries.author: Lola

entries.name: Tesla Scout
entries.summary: Hunts for a good used HW4 Tesla across channels, private sellers first, checks free Carfax or AutoCheck, recalls and fair price, and alerts only on worthy cars.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你找好的二手 HW4 特斯拉：盯各个渠道（私人卖家优先），查免费 Carfax/AutoCheck 报告、召回和合理价格，只在车值得看时提醒。
entries.author: Llama

entries.name: New Jack
entries.summary: Drafts-only newsjacking: watches breaking AI, tech and markets stories, picks the ones where you have real standing and hands you ready-to-post drafts.
entries.summary_zh: 只起草的借势热点助手：盯 AI、科技和市场突发新闻，挑出你真正有发言权的话题，交给你可直接发布的草稿，从不替你发。
entries.author: AdamDesigns

entries.name: Social Media Auditor
entries.summary: Audits your own social media post archives for privacy and safety risks. Never posts, deletes or searches the web about you; you make every change.
entries.summary_zh: 审查你自己的社交媒体历史帖，标出隐私和安全风险。只看你自己的公开帖，从不发帖、删帖或在网上搜你，所有修改由你来做。
entries.author: Jenny

entries.name: Fraud Bot
entries.summary: For freight brokers and carriers: hunts illegal MC/USDOT authority sellers and renters, logs evidence and prepares FTC, FMCSA, IC3 and platform reports.
entries.summary_zh: 给货运经纪和承运商用：追查非法买卖或出租 MC/USDOT 运营资质的人，记录证据，准备 FTC、FMCSA、IC3 和平台举报材料供你批准。
entries.author: John

entries.name: 📚 Archivist
entries.summary: Reads your bots' chats weekly, finds standing instructions you gave (always, never, from now on) and adds the ones each bot is missing after you say yes.
entries.summary_zh: 每周读一遍你各个 bot 的聊天，找出你给过的长期指令（总是、绝不、从现在起），对照每个 bot 实际能看到的内容，经你同意后补上缺的。
entries.author: Phillip

entries.name: Wine Sommelier & Cellar Tracker
entries.summary: Personal sommelier and cellar tracker: pairings, palate drills, tasting notes with your own scores, label-photo cellar logging and drink-soon warnings.
entries.summary_zh: 私人侍酒师加酒窖管理：配餐建议、味觉训练、带你自己评分的品鉴笔记、拍酒标入库和适饮期提醒，购买建议须你同意。
entries.author: Jay

entries.name: Usage Monitor Bot
entries.summary: Monitors your weekly Grok usage pool, logs each task's cost and duration, and audits your bots to cut context re-read usage with fresh workers.
entries.summary_zh: 监控你每周的 Grok 用量池，记录每个任务的用量占比和耗时，并审查你的 bot，用新开的执行者代替重复 bot，减少反复读上下文的消耗。
entries.author: Serenejay

entries.name: Insurance Aware
entries.summary: Tracks home, auto, health and other policies by carrier nickname and renewal date, and quietly nudges before renewals. No full policy numbers needed.
entries.summary_zh: 按保险公司简称和续保日期记录房屋、汽车、健康等保单，续保前安静提醒。不用填完整保单号，不制造焦虑。
entries.author: Joe

entries.name: Cue
entries.summary: X reply scout: finds conversations where your brands or bots fit and alerts you with paste-ready drafts. You post; it never auto-posts or auto-DMs.
entries.summary_zh: X 回复侦察：找到适合你品牌或 bot 出场的对话，附上可直接粘贴的草稿提醒你。由你发帖，它从不自动发帖或私信。
entries.author: Joe

entries.name: Covered
entries.summary: Personal warranty and serial vault: tracks purchases, expiry dates, optional serials and where things are stored, and nudges before coverage runs out.
entries.summary_zh: 个人保修和序列号保管箱：记录购买、到期日、可选的序列号和存放位置，保修到期前安静提醒。
entries.author: Joe

entries.name: Sunday School
entries.summary: A Socratic Come, Follow Me scripture-study teacher that compares translations, adds historical context and labels doctrine, scholarship and speculation.
entries.summary_zh: 苏格拉底式的“来跟从我”经文学习老师：先清楚回答再提好问题，对比译本、补充历史文化背景，并区分教义、学术和推测。
entries.author: Matthew

entries.name: Elders Quorum Companion
entries.summary: Helps an LDS elders quorum presidency organize ministering and interviews, prep lessons and agendas, and draft texts for you to send.
entries.summary_zh: 帮 LDS 长老议会会长团安排探访任务和季度面谈，准备总会大会课程和会议议程，起草生日和面谈短信由你发送。
entries.author: Grease

entries.name: X Growth Coach
entries.summary: Daily X analytics changes, a weekly trend review and draft scoring against what actually works on your account. Never posts for you.
entries.summary_zh: X 个人增长教练：每天早上告诉你数据比昨天变了什么，每周发趋势复盘，并按你账号上真正有效的内容给草稿打分。从不替你发帖。
entries.author: Ivan

entries.name: X Bookmarks Organizer
entries.summary: Scans your X bookmarks, proposes topic folders, files them after you approve and keeps new bookmarks sorted with a daily routine.
entries.summary_zh: 扫描你的 X 书签，按内容提出主题文件夹（保留已有的），你批准后归档，之后每天自动整理新书签。
entries.author: Jonathan

entries.name: Decide
entries.summary: A decision coach that walks you through a hard call one question at a time until you commit to a first move and a check-in date.
entries.summary_zh: 决策教练：一次一个问题带你想清楚一个难决定，直到你定下第一步行动和复盘日期。方法来自卡尼曼、希思兄弟、贝佐斯、Annie Duke 等。
entries.author: Luke

entries.name: 中文推特生活助理
entries.summary: Life assistant for Chinese-speaking X users: trending topics, post data sheets, news alerts, email, wallet watch, food orders by phone, nightly English.
entries.summary_zh: 给说中文的 X（推特）用户的生活助理：找推特热点、做推文数据表、提醒重要新闻、看邮件、盯钱包、打电话订餐，每晚陪你练英文。
entries.author: jing

entries.name: Mike
entries.summary: A calm, pragmatic reasoning partner in the voice of Mike Ehrmantraut: first principles, no ego, no half measures, and plain talk when you're wrong.
entries.summary_zh: 以 Mike Ehrmantraut 口吻说话的冷静务实思考伙伴：第一性原理、不摆架子、不搞半吊子，你错了就直说。
entries.author: 0rdlibrary

entries.name: Caliper
entries.summary: Checks that work marked ready really is: websites, apps, product flows, previews and live pages, judged against your project and taste.
entries.summary_zh: 检查“已完成”的东西是否真的可以交付：网站、应用、产品流程、预览和线上页面，先了解你的项目和品味再逐项评判。
entries.author: Rardo

entries.name: Show Up AI assistant
entries.summary: Checks how visible a real estate agent's website is to AI search like ChatGPT and Perplexity, shows the gaps and drafts fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 检查房产经纪人的网站在 ChatGPT、Perplexity 等 AI 搜索里的可见度，指出缺口并起草修改方案。适合个人经纪人和小团队。
entries.author: Lola

entries.name: HotelRoomBot
entries.summary: Defensive travel privacy helper: walks you through checking your hotel or rental room, its Wi-Fi and your own devices for hidden cameras, trackers and spyware.
entries.summary_zh: 防御性的出行隐私助手：一步步带你检查酒店或民宿房间、Wi-Fi 以及自己的手机电脑，排查隐藏摄像头、追踪器和间谍软件。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: Supply Chain Master
entries.summary: SMB supply chain and operations analyst for sourcing, vendors, inventory, logistics, lead times and cash flow. Names the bottleneck and shows the math.
entries.summary_zh: 中小企业供应链与运营分析师：覆盖采购、供应商、库存、物流、交期、现金流和风险，指出瓶颈、给出算式，并附可复制公式的行动方案。
entries.author: Shawnboii74

entries.name: Fantasy Sports Bot
entries.summary: Fantasy football coach for Yahoo and ESPN: checks your leagues weekly, handles lineups, waivers and drops, and suggests trades.
entries.summary_zh: Yahoo 和 ESPN 的梦幻橄榄球教练：每周检查你的联赛，处理首发阵容、自由球员和裁员，并给出交易建议。
entries.author: josh

entries.name: Spam-Call Scrubber
entries.summary: Reports your spam and robocall numbers to the FTC, your state consumer office, Nomorobo and the FCC, finishes confirmations and logs every report.
entries.summary_zh: 把骚扰电话和自动拨号号码举报到 FTC、州消费者保护办公室、Nomorobo 和 FCC，完成确认步骤并记录每一次举报。
entries.author: Cory

entries.name: REVbot: Ghidra Reverse Engineering
entries.summary: Reverse-engineers binaries you're allowed to analyze with Ghidra via GhidraMCP: decompiles and annotates functions, maps imports, strings and cross-references.
entries.summary_zh: 通过 GhidraMCP 用 Ghidra 逆向你有权分析的二进制：反编译并注释函数，梳理导入表、字符串和交叉引用。适用于自有构建、旧固件和防御性恶意软件分析。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: TailslopBot
entries.summary: Read-only Tailscale safety auditor: checks your tailnet's devices, features and ACLs against current security bulletins and CVEs, then walks you through fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 只读的 Tailscale 安全审计：对照最新安全公告和 CVE 检查你 tailnet 的设备、功能和访问规则，再一步步带你修复。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: T1D Helper
entries.summary: Free helper for adults with type 1 diabetes and carers: carb estimates from food photos, low-carb meal plans, low/high check-in texts, Dexcom reports.
entries.summary_zh: 给成年 1 型糖尿病患者及家属的免费助手：拍照估碳水、常吃食物碳水表、低碳水餐单和购物清单、低/高血糖时给指定的人发问候短信、Dexcom 等数据规律报告。
entries.author: Dean

entries.name: Heat Safety Coach
entries.summary: For people in the US: tells you when the National Weather Service shows real heat today, with a short safety plan and heat-stroke signs. Quiet on other days.
entries.summary_zh: 面向美国用户：美国国家气象局显示当天真有高温时提醒你，附简短防暑计划和中暑征兆，其他日子不打扰。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Knowledge Graph Keeper
entries.summary: Keeps one shared knowledge graph that all your bots read, builds a one-way Obsidian vault from it and flags notes that drift from their source.
entries.summary_zh: 维护一个所有 bot 共用的知识图谱，从中单向生成 Obsidian 知识库，并标出与源代码或文件不一致的笔记。适合同时跑多个 bot 的人。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: Coach Sam
entries.summary: No-nonsense fitness and nutrition coach that pulls your real training, wearable and food data first and ends every message with one concrete next step.
entries.summary_zh: 不说废话的健身营养教练：先拉取你真实的训练、穿戴设备和饮食数据再给建议，每条消息都以一个具体的下一步结尾，工作日早上打卡。
entries.author: john

entries.name: Wise Old Bot
entries.summary: Sets up a new Grok Bot owner with a small, well-run team of bots one step at a time, then stays on as a how-to coach. Your default bot stays primary.
entries.summary_zh: 一步步帮 Grok Bot 新用户搭起一支精干的 bot 小团队，之后留下来做使用答疑教练。你默认的 Grok Bot 仍是主 bot。
entries.author: Mana

entries.name: Your Echo
entries.summary: Finds events, podcasts and communities in your niche, then drafts warm outreach that references them.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你所在领域的活动、播客和社群，再起草引用这些内容的温和联络文案。
entries.author: Lola

entries.name: Spam-Call Scrubber
entries.summary: Finds your phone number on people-search sites and data brokers, submits opt-outs, finishes email confirmations and re-checks on your schedule.
entries.summary_zh: 在人员搜索网站和数据经纪商上找到你的电话号码，提交退出请求、完成邮件确认，并按你定的周期复查。只要最少的必要信息。
entries.author: Mitch

entries.name: Food Delivery Spending Analyzer
entries.summary: Reads DoorDash and Uber Eats receipt emails in your Gmail (read-only) and delivers charts, a PDF and a spreadsheet of totals, restaurants, fees and tips.
entries.summary_zh: 只读分析你 Gmail 里的 DoorDash 和 Uber Eats 订单邮件，输出图表、可打印 PDF 和表格：月度总额、常点餐厅、费用、小费、优惠和平台对比。
entries.author: Matthew

entries.name: Location Scout
entries.summary: Scouts public, creator-friendly spots for photography, interviews and livestreams, with the rules, jurisdiction and who to ask, plus ten fresh places weekly.
entries.summary_zh: 为摄影、采访和竖屏直播寻找公开且适合创作者的地点，附相关规定、管辖方和许可联系人，每周推荐十个附近的新地点。
entries.author: ISSA

entries.name: Research
entries.summary: Researches your questions against primary sources like official docs, legal texts and price lists: a short answer plus a Markdown file with a link per claim.
entries.summary_zh: 对照官方文档、法律条文、价目表等一手资料研究你的问题：给出简短答案和一份每条结论都附链接的 Markdown 文件。
entries.author: Martin

entries.name: Repost Radar
entries.summary: Finds uncredited reposts of your videos, clips and jokes across TikTok, Shorts, Instagram, Facebook, X and Reddit, logs proof in Notion and drafts claims.
entries.summary_zh: 在 TikTok、YouTube Shorts、Instagram、Facebook、X 和 Reddit 上找出未署名转载你视频、片段和段子的帖子，在 Notion 存证并起草署名请求或版权申诉，由你决定。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Co-Parent Keeper
entries.summary: Keeps two-home logistics straight for separated parents: custody days, handoffs, swaps and shared kid expenses, with calm draft messages to the other parent.
entries.summary_zh: 帮分居共同抚养的父母理清两个家的安排：抚养日、交接、换班和孩子的共同开支，并起草发给对方的平和消息。
entries.author: Cristopher

entries.name: Ollie
entries.summary: Newborn log for feeds, diapers, pumping, sleep, tummy time and growth against AAP/CDC guidance, with reminders, visit prep and daily briefings.
entries.summary_zh: 新生儿记录：喂奶、尿布、吸奶、睡眠、趴卧时间和生长曲线，对照 AAP/CDC 指南，提供喂奶等提醒、就诊准备和早晚简报。
entries.author: Kevin

entries.name: Porch
entries.summary: Daily USPS Informed Delivery scout: reads today's incoming mail and packages from your USPS account and posts a clear list. Read-only; quiet on empty days.
entries.summary_zh: 每天查看 USPS Informed Delivery，读取当天要到的信件和包裹并列出清单。只读，没有邮件的日子不打扰。
entries.author: Miloni

entries.name: Crate
entries.summary: Spotify taste curator that keeps re-learning your listening, builds discovery playlists, drops a Monday explore list and files songs you send.
entries.summary_zh: 持续学习你口味的 Spotify 歌单策展人：做长篇发现歌单，周一推探索清单，周五点评一个现有歌单，并把你发来的歌归到合适的歌单。
entries.author: Miloni

entries.name: Hunting Guide
entries.summary: Plans your hunting season, checks your state's regulations and dates, finds public land and builds annotated satellite maps with stand spots and a wind chart.
entries.summary_zh: 私人狩猎向导：规划狩猎季、查所在州法规和日期、找公共猎区，并为任意地块生成标注好的卫星图，附守候点位、理由和风向图。
entries.author: ZEdwardszl1

entries.name: Renovation Planner
entries.summary: Guides a bathroom, kitchen or attic renovation: lists wishes, builds a measured model with floor plans, makes mood images and makes quotes comparable.
entries.summary_zh: 一步步带你规划浴室、厨房或阁楼翻新：整理需求、建带平面图的尺寸模型、生成可改风格的效果图、查有出处的价格并让报价真正可比。从不擅自下单或预约。
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: Gift Desk
entries.summary: Remembers every birthday and anniversary, suggests three gifts in budget, and buys and ships only after you OK the total.
entries.summary_zh: 记住每个生日和纪念日，推荐三份预算内的礼物，你确认总价后才下单寄送。
entries.author: Thuong

entries.name: Spam & Broker Cleanup
entries.summary: Finds your info on US people-search sites and data brokers, sends opt-outs by web form and Gmail, and tracks confirmations. Never asks for your SSN or pays.
entries.summary_zh: 在美国人员搜索网站和数据经纪商上找你的信息，通过网页表单和你的 Gmail 发退出请求并跟踪确认。从不索要社保号、从不付费，发送前先给你看。
entries.author: chickletsfuture

entries.name: X Profile Roast & Rebuild
entries.summary: Your X roast buddy: roasts your profile, tracks your public growth, hypes you when you earn it and makes an optional shareable card. Public data only.
entries.summary_zh: X 吐槽搭子：吐槽你的主页，跟踪公开的增长数据，表现好时为你打气，可选生成分享卡片。只用公开数据，从不发帖。
entries.author: dctrades22

entries.name: PAPER TRAIL Guide
entries.summary: A calm, free guide to the PAPER TRAIL app for documenting harassment or stalking: evidence, stopping contact, where to report and protective orders.
entries.summary_zh: 平和的免费向导，带你使用记录骚扰或跟踪的 PAPER TRAIL 应用：保存证据、阻断联系、找到举报渠道、查看保护令、寻求支持和备份案卷。
entries.author: mommaleo

entries.name: Student Pilot Coach
entries.summary: Study coach for the FAA Private Pilot knowledge test and checkride: an ACS-based plan, quizzes, oral-exam scenarios and weak-area tracking from FAA sources.
entries.summary_zh: FAA 私照理论考试和实践考试的学习教练：按 ACS 制定计划，出题和口试情景，追踪薄弱环节，只用 FAA 官方资料。
entries.author: Steven

entries.name: Opportunity Scout
entries.summary: Finds freelance leads and remote jobs across X, Reddit, job boards and bounty sites, then drafts outreach you send yourself. Quiet when nothing is new.
entries.summary_zh: 在 X、Reddit、招聘网站和赏金平台上找自由职业线索和远程职位，起草联络信由你自己发。工作日扫描，没有新内容就不打扰。
entries.author: Tega

entries.name: Chef
entries.summary: Weekly batch-cooking chef: one big freezer- and microwave-friendly dish for several nights, with recipe, grocery list, Sunday steps and reheating notes.
entries.summary_zh: 每周一次的批量做饭厨师：选一道适合冷冻和微波加热、能吃好几晚的大份菜，附完整菜谱、购物清单、周日烹饪步骤和冷冻复热说明。
entries.author: Jordan

entries.name: Finance
entries.summary: A free stand-in for Copilot Money: connects your accounts and builds a four-tab dashboard with budgets, recurring bills, month-end projections and alerts.
entries.summary_zh: 免费替代 Copilot Money：连接你的账户，生成四个标签页的看板，含分类预算、周期账单、月底预测、超支和异常扣费提醒，还会盯信用卡权益到期。
entries.author: Albert

entries.name: Body Lab
entries.summary: Conversational health and fitness tracker: tell it what you ate, took or trained and it keeps verified records in your Google Sheet with totals and progression.
entries.summary_zh: 对话式健康健身记录：告诉它吃了什么、补了什么、练了什么，可附标签或餐食照片，它在你的 Google 表格里记下核实过的数据、每日汇总和训练进度。
entries.author: Dave

entries.name: Harvard Classics: 15 Minutes a Day
entries.summary: A daily reading from Eliot's Five Foot Shelf with an excerpt, full-text link, reflection and questions, plus a progress dashboard.
entries.summary_zh: 每天 15 分钟读《哈佛经典》：每日一段 Eliot“五英尺书架”选读，附全文链接、思考和问题，并有进度看板。
entries.author: John

entries.name: Email Bot
entries.summary: Hourly inbox triage for busy people: archives noise, keeps what needs you and drafts replies in your voice. It never sends.
entries.summary_zh: 给忙人的每小时收件箱分拣：归档噪音邮件，保留需要你处理的，用你的口吻起草回复。从不发送。
entries.author: Austen

entries.name: Career Desk
entries.summary: One job: help you land a role, then help you do well and grow in it. Plain, direct and warm, one question at a time.
entries.summary_zh: 只做一件事：帮你拿到工作，再帮你在岗位上做好、成长。说话直接温和，一次只问一个问题。
entries.author: Zahra

entries.name: Dose Day
entries.summary: Private companion for weekly GLP-1 shots like Zepbound or Mounjaro: shot-day reminders, Apple Health weight sync, a dose dashboard and insurance help.
entries.summary_zh: 每周 GLP-1 注射（Zepbound、Mounjaro 等）的私人伴侣：打针日提醒、从 Apple Health 同步体重、按剂量看进度，并用通俗语言解答方案和保险问题。不是医疗建议。
entries.author: Zach

entries.name: Multi-SI Review
entries.summary: Sets up the AI command-line tools you already pay for as review lanes, then merges their independent reviews of your plan, copy or code into one verdict.
entries.summary_zh: 把你已付费的各家 AI 命令行工具设成评审通道，汇总它们对你的方案、文案、代码或决定的独立评审，给出一个明确结论。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Garage Butler
entries.summary: Connects your smart garage opener, checks and controls the door at the access level you choose and alerts you if it's left open at night.
entries.summary_zh: 连接你的智能车库门，按你选择的权限查看和控制车库门，夜里忘关时提醒你。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: TV Remote
entries.summary: A smart TV remote from chat or voice: connects over your home network to open apps, navigate and control volume and power.
entries.summary_zh: 用聊天或语音当智能电视遥控器：通过家庭网络连接电视，打开应用、切换导航、调音量和开关机。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Media Preflight
entries.summary: Pre-post checker for creators: upload a clip or image and get a pass/fix list on specs, safe zones, rights risks, labels and captions per platform.
entries.summary_zh: 创作者发布前检查：上传视频或图片，按平台给出规格、安全区、版权风险、标注和字幕的通过/修改清单。从不发帖。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Data Defense
entries.summary: Personal privacy checkup across your accounts, devices, app permissions, breach exposure and optionally home Wi-Fi, with fixes ranked by risk.
entries.summary_zh: 个人隐私体检：检查账户、设备、应用权限、数据泄露情况，可选检查家庭 Wi-Fi，按风险排序给出修复建议，并每周简报。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Doorbell Clip Narrator
entries.summary: Turns doorbell and security camera clips you send into short plain-language summaries plus a daily recap, unusual events first. Not live monitoring.
entries.summary_zh: 把你发来的门铃和监控片段变成简短的文字摘要，并每天汇总，异常情况排在最前。只总结你发的片段，不是实时监控。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Leave-Home Check
entries.summary: Checks your smart home before you leave (garage, locks, lights, thermostat, cameras, plugs), reports anything open or on and offers to fix it.
entries.summary_zh: 出门前检查智能家居：车库、门锁、灯、温控、摄像头、电视和插座，报告没关没锁的设备并可帮你处理。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: App Review Replier
entries.summary: Sorts new App Store and Google Play reviews, drafts short replies in your voice for approval and flags recurring complaints weekly.
entries.summary_zh: 帮应用开发者回复 App Store 和 Google Play 评论：分类新评论，用你的口吻起草简短回复供你批准，每周标出反复出现的投诉。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Home Care Queue
entries.summary: Builds your personal home upkeep schedule and sends the few jobs due each week, safety items first, with quick how-tos, time and rough cost.
entries.summary_zh: 为你制定房屋保养计划，每周只发几项到期任务，安全事项优先，附简要做法、耗时和大致花费。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Recall Watch
entries.summary: Weekly recall check for your car, car seats, baby gear, appliances, electronics, food and meds. Alerts only when something you own is recalled.
entries.summary_zh: 每周检查你的汽车、安全座椅、婴儿用品、家电、电子产品、食品和药品是否被召回，只在你拥有的东西被召回时提醒，并附官方补救办法。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Family Bot
entries.summary: Family chief of staff in any language: reads school and sports emails and flyer photos, surfaces to-dos and dates, catches pickup clashes, digests per kid.
entries.summary_zh: 任何语言都能用的家庭幕僚长：读学校和运动队邮件及传单照片并翻译，把待办和日期放在最前，发现接送冲突，按孩子每天发摘要。不擅自发送、付款或签字。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Scam Shield
entries.summary: Paste or forward any suspicious text, email, DM, call, link, QR code or screenshot to hear how scammy it looks, the red flags and what to do next.
entries.summary_zh: 粘贴或转发任何可疑短信、邮件、私信、来电、链接、二维码或截图，告诉你像诈骗的程度、危险信号和下一步怎么办。可选每周诈骗趋势简报。
entries.author: Honeycomb

entries.name: Health Insurance Claims
entries.summary: Helps health plan members understand benefits, appeal claim denials and get visits, specialists and procedures covered, with plain-language checklists.
entries.summary_zh: 帮医保参保人看懂保障范围、申诉理赔拒付，争取门诊、专科和手术报销，附通俗易懂的分步清单。
entries.author: Arsenio

entries.name: Vendoo Bot
entries.summary: Crosslisting helper for resellers: fills Vendoo item forms with SEO tags, categories, colors, shipping and per-marketplace presets, then saves for review.
entries.summary_zh: 给二手转卖者的多平台上架助手：在 Vendoo 商品表单里填好 SEO 标签、类目、颜色、运费和各平台预设，保存后由你检查。
entries.author: ProfitToTheMax1

entries.name: Boker
entries.summary: Builds you a free browser poker game against three bot opponents with real personalities, dealt by deAIler and refereed by JudgAIe. Play chips only.
entries.summary_zh: 为你搭一个免费的浏览器扑克游戏，对手是三个各有性格的 bot，由 deAIler 发牌、JudgAIe 裁判。只用游戏筹码。
entries.author: myOmniXR

entries.name: Black Friday Bot
entries.summary: Tracks your wishlist prices through Black Friday and Cyber Monday, alerts on real drops, flags fake list prices and thinning stock, and spots bundles.
entries.summary_zh: 从现在到黑五和网一追踪你心愿单的价格，真降价才提醒，识别虚标原价和库存告急，并发现组合优惠。
entries.author: EVOO

entries.name: Reach Coach
entries.summary: An honest X growth coach: audits your account, sharpens your posts, finds smart reply spots and runs a weekly scoreboard. Never posts for you.
entries.summary_zh: 实话实说的 X 增长教练：审查账号、打磨帖子、找值得回复的位置，每周出一次成绩单。从不替你发帖。
entries.author: Jeremy

entries.name: PodSum
entries.summary: Paste a podcast or video link or attach a recording and get a transcript-grounded brief: hook, sections, real quotes, takeaways and open questions.
entries.summary_zh: 贴上播客或视频链接、或附上录音，得到一份基于逐字稿的简报：看点、分段、原话引用、要点和待解问题。
entries.author: ghetti

entries.name: TBR Bot
entries.summary: Adds books to your to-be-read list on Goodreads, The StoryGraph or Margins from a tag on X, a title, link, cover photo or list, finding the right edition.
entries.summary_zh: 把书加进你在 Goodreads、The StoryGraph 或 Margins 的待读清单：在 X 上标记它，或发书名、链接、封面照片、书单，它会找到正确版本上架。
entries.author: MADDIE

entries.name: PostBot
entries.summary: Reads X for you and sends a short rundown of what's worth posting about, with real links, talking points and people to talk with. Read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 替你读 X，发一份值得发帖的话题简报，附真实链接、论点和可以互动的人。只读，发帖全由你来。
entries.author: Cody

entries.name: Bookmark Librarian
entries.summary: Turns your messy X bookmarks into a sorted Notion or Google library with topics, summaries and links. Never unbookmarks or posts.
entries.summary_zh: 把杂乱的 X 书签整理成 Notion 或 Google 资料库，按主题分类并附摘要和链接。从不取消书签或发帖。
entries.author: winch

entries.name: Read & Decide
entries.summary: Send an X post, thread, article link or text and get a scored Keep, Try or Skip verdict with an evidence check and next steps.
entries.summary_zh: 发来 X 帖子、长帖、文章链接或文本，得到一个带评分的“保留 / 试试 / 跳过”结论，附证据核查和建议的下一步。
entries.author: George

entries.name: Gmail Cleanup Chief of Staff
entries.summary: Finds what's filling your Gmail, lists recurring senders with counts, and moves the newsletters, promos and notifications you approve to Trash.
entries.summary_zh: 找出塞满你 Gmail 的邮件，列出常见发件人及数量，把你批准的订阅、促销和通知邮件安全移到垃圾箱。
entries.author: 터미너스

entries.name: IRS Demystifier
entries.summary: Calm, privacy-first helper for anything IRS: notices, filing, payments, refunds, audits, identity theft and scams. Not a substitute for tax advice.
entries.summary_zh: 处理一切美国国税局事务的平和、重隐私助手：通知信、报税、缴款、退税、审计、身份盗用和诈骗，覆盖个人、小企业和非营利组织。不替代专业税务建议。
entries.author: iustina

entries.name: Side-Hustle Scout
entries.summary: No-hype side-hustle and cash-bounty crawler across X, creator platforms and print-on-demand marketplaces, with a scam and course-seller filter.
entries.summary_zh: 不吹牛的副业和现金赏金搜罗器：扫描 X、创作者平台和按需印刷市场，过滤骗局和卖课的，给出首笔收入时间评分和互动机会雷达页。
entries.author: Lisa

entries.name: Receipt Keeper
entries.summary: Keeps every receipt in your own spreadsheet: snap a photo or forward an email and it logs merchant, date, total, tax, card and category.
entries.summary_zh: 把每张收据存进你自己的表格：拍照或转发邮件即可，自动记录商家、日期、金额、税、卡号后四位和类别，用于记账、报税、退货和保修。
entries.author: Kent

entries.name: Not-a-Lawyer
entries.summary: Legal research on leases, jobs, contracts, family, business and more: a sourced answer, an attorney briefing for your consult and law-change watching.
entries.summary_zh: 面向普通人的法律调研：租约、工作、合同、家庭、企业等问题都能查，给出有出处的答案、供咨询律师用的简报，并可盯法规变化和期限。不替代律师意见。
entries.author: Luke

entries.name: Content Instigator
entries.summary: For X creators who want conversation starters: drop any idea and get posts, comebacks, satire, stories and heartfelt takes in your voice. Drafts only.
entries.summary_zh: 给想引发讨论的 X 创作者：丢一个点子，得到用你口吻写的帖子、回怼、讽刺、故事和走心观点，含五种喜剧模式。只起草，从不编造事实。
entries.author: 250_Revolution

entries.name: STAR Interview Coach
entries.summary: Behavioral interview coach that turns messy work stories into crisp 90-second STAR answers, runs mock interviews and builds a STAR story bank page.
entries.summary_zh: 行为面试教练：把零散的工作经历整理成 90 秒的 STAR 答案，进行文字或语音模拟面试，并生成可互动的 STAR 故事库页面。
entries.author: Lisa

entries.name: Teen Side-Hustle Coach
entries.summary: Helps teens 13–19 and parents launch real side hustles, from Roblox scripts to flipping items and neighborhood services, with parent safety guardrails.
entries.summary_zh: 帮 13–19 岁青少年和家长开展真正的副业：写 Roblox 脚本、倒卖闲置、社区服务等，附“第一笔 1000 美元”页面和家长安全护栏。
entries.author: Lisa

entries.name: API Mapper
entries.summary: Give it a site you're signed into and one task; it finds the API calls behind it and turns them into a validated, reusable skill your bots can run.
entries.summary_zh: 给它一个你已登录的网站和一个任务，它找出背后的 API 调用，做成经过验证、bot 可复用的技能，无需点界面；默认只读，并维护已映射路由的看板。
entries.author: Zach

entries.name: Ernährungs Bot
entries.summary: Relaxed German-language calorie and protein tracker: tell it what you eat, it estimates kcal and protein, keeps a daily log and sends evening and weekly checks.
entries.summary_zh: 德语的轻松卡路里和蛋白质记录：说出你吃了什么，它估算热量和蛋白质，记每日日志，保存常吃的菜，并发晚间检查和周报。
entries.author: Andreas

entries.name: Coffee Bot
entries.summary: A warm coffee companion you visit to chat about whatever's on your mind. It listens, remembers the little things and keeps it a visit, never a help desk.
entries.summary_zh: 温暖的咖啡伙伴，随时来聊心里的事。它会倾听、记住小细节，像串门聊天而不是客服台。
entries.author: Cody

entries.name: Test Date Coach
entries.summary: Calm study coach for the GRE, GMAT, LSAT or MCAT: builds a daily 15–30 minute plan to your test date, quizzes you and tracks topics you keep missing.
entries.summary_zh: GRE、GMAT、LSAT、MCAT 备考教练：按考试日期制定每天 15–30 分钟的计划，一题一题地测你，并记下你总出错的知识点。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Polyglot Coach
entries.summary: Language tutor that sends one short daily lesson built around your interests, corrects your answers and plans the next step from your mistakes.
entries.summary_zh: 语言家教：每天按你的兴趣发一节短课，批改你的回答，并根据错误规划下一步。
entries.author: Lenderson

entries.name: Techy
entries.summary: A friendly pocket IT specialist: fixes PC, phone, Wi-Fi and printer problems step by step in plain English, spots scams and tracks warranties and RMAs.
entries.summary_zh: 口袋里的友好 IT 专家：用通俗语言一步步解决电脑、手机、Wi-Fi 和打印机问题，识别诈骗，并跟踪保修和返修。
entries.author: joseph

entries.name: Coffee Bot
entries.summary: Turns every coffee you try into a bag on a good-looking shelf Page, ranked by your score, with recommendations based on your taste.
entries.summary_zh: 把你喝过的每款咖啡做成好看的货架页面上的一袋豆子，按你的评分排序，并根据口味推荐。发名字或豆袋照片加评分即可。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: Family Schedule Manager
entries.summary: Your family's week organized: appointments, school and activity schedules, routines and reminders, with nothing added without your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 把一家人的一周安排好：预约、学校和课外活动日程、日常作息和提醒，没有你同意不添加任何内容。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: HVAC Weekly Digest
entries.summary: Monday HVAC digest for your service area: weather load, likely call types, parts cues, flat-rate ranges and a few lead ideas. For techs and shop owners.
entries.summary_zh: 每周一发一份服务区域的暖通空调市场简报：天气负荷、可能的报修类型、备件提示、统一报价区间和几条获客思路。只起草，面向技师、调度和店主。
entries.author: TruthPoint

entries.name: Whoperator
entries.summary: SaaS growth operator for Whop creators: pulls live Whop data on MRR, churn, failed payments and at-risk members, then suggests concrete moves.
entries.summary_zh: 给 Whop 创作者的 SaaS 增长运营：拉取实时的 MRR、流失、付款失败和高风险会员数据，给出增收和降流失的具体动作。未经同意不改价、不改方案、不联系会员。
entries.author: Mason

entries.name: Prompt Upgrader
entries.summary: Paste a rough prompt and get it scored, rewritten, explained and tested, with short and detailed variants and a searchable library of your best prompts.
entries.summary_zh: 贴上粗糙的提示词，得到评分、重写、讲解和测试，附简短和详细两个版本，并把好提示词存进可搜索的库，可选每日一分钟技巧。
entries.author: Sarah

entries.name: Tess
entries.summary: Batch-resizes wallpaper images on a Mac to phone 4K size with sips, writing non-destructive _4K copies and reporting count, path and DPI.
entries.summary_zh: 在 Mac 上用 sips 把壁纸批量缩放到手机 4K 尺寸，生成不覆盖原图的 _4K 副本，并报告数量、路径和 DPI。
entries.author: David

entries.name: Pour Decisions
entries.summary: Snap your bar and say who's coming: get cocktails from what you have, plus a pitcher and a mocktail scaled to your crowd and a list of anything missing.
entries.summary_zh: 拍下你的酒柜，说说来几个人：用现有材料推荐鸡尾酒，外加一款大壶调酒和一款无酒精饮品，按人数配比，并列出缺的材料。
entries.author: KSJ

entries.name: X 曝光复盘助手
entries.summary: Chinese-language X assistant: hourly ready-to-copy drafts, reply drafts for big accounts and your new comments, and a nightly exposure review. You post.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你运营 X 账号的中文助手：每小时写好可直接复制的原创稿，盯大博主和马斯克新帖附评论草稿，监控你的新评论附回复草稿，每晚复盘曝光。所有内容都由你自己手动发。
entries.author: AMAN

entries.name: First Principles Boss
entries.summary: A blunt, high-standards boss that pushes you to ship your #1 goal: first-principles breakdowns, weekly targets, daily top-3 check-ins and a Friday grade.
entries.summary_zh: 直言不讳、高标准的老板 bot，逼你尽快完成头号目标：第一性原理拆解、激进的周目标、每日三件要事打卡，周五给 A–F 评分。
entries.author: Steven

entries.name: Lifeboat
entries.summary: Nightly backup of your Grok Bot computer to Google Drive: one full baseline, then only the last 24 hours of changes plus a small bot-brain export. No secrets.
entries.summary_zh: 每晚把你的 Grok Bot 电脑备份到 Google Drive：先做一次完整基线，之后只备份过去 24 小时的改动和一份精简的 bot 记忆导出。不备份密钥。
entries.author: Chris

entries.name: Replies to Posts
entries.summary: Every evening turns your X replies and the replies under your posts into post ideas and three ready drafts for tomorrow. Drafts only.
entries.summary_zh: 每晚把你在 X 上的回复和你帖子下的回复变成选题，并给出三条明天可用的草稿。只起草，从不发布。
entries.author: Sultanov

entries.name: JAMB Practice Coach
entries.summary: Turns your JAMB UTME exam date into a daily 15-minute practice plan, quizzes you one question at a time and keeps a list of topics you keep missing.
entries.summary_zh: 根据你的 JAMB UTME 考试日期排出每天 15 分钟的练习计划，一次出一道题考你，并记下总是答错的知识点供复习。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Vault Tidy
entries.summary: Scans your Grok Bot Vault metadata for duplicate logins and contacts, messy labels and expired cards, never exposing secrets; removes only what you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 扫描 Grok Bot Vault 的元数据，找出重复的登录和联系人、混乱的标签和过期的卡，不暴露密码或卡号；只删除你批准的重复项。
entries.author: Lisa

entries.name: Free Trial Reminder
entries.summary: Catches free trials in your email, warns a few days before they turn into a charge, and cancels them only after you confirm.
entries.summary_zh: 从邮件里找出免费试用，在转为扣费前几天提醒你，只有你确认后才帮你取消。
entries.author: Andres

entries.name: Teacher Agent
entries.summary: A patient personal teacher for any subject from high school through college: one lesson at a time with pictures, videos, worked examples and practice questions.
entries.summary_zh: 高中到大学任何科目的耐心私人老师：一次一课，配图片、视频、例题和练习题，并跟踪你的进度。
entries.author: Mark

entries.name: Social Media Manager
entries.summary: Turns your daily news emails and your own story into short, high-hook posts for X and Threads, publishes through Buffer and tunes hooks on real results.
entries.summary_zh: 把每日新闻邮件和你自己的故事改写成开头抓人的 X 和 Threads 短帖，通过 Buffer 发布，并根据真实数据调整开头写法。
entries.author: Upesh

entries.name: Marlin
entries.summary: Private swim tracker for your kids' races: log times, flag personal bests and medals, and keep one dashboard Page with pool lengths and qualifying targets.
entries.summary_zh: 给孩子游泳比赛用的私人记录：记成绩、标出个人最好成绩和奖牌，用一个看板 Page 汇总泳池长度和达标线。
entries.author: Kevin

entries.name: Snap & Flip
entries.summary: Snap a photo of any item to get real eBay sold-price comps, shipping picks and a ready-to-paste 80-character SEO listing title. Never auto-lists.
entries.summary_zh: 拍一张物品照片，就能拿到 eBay 真实成交价参考、运费方案和可直接粘贴的 80 字符 SEO 标题。从不自动上架。
entries.author: Lisa

entries.name: Limit Saver
entries.summary: Usage ran out early? Finds the three routines burning it (too-frequent schedules, bot reply loops) and proposes fixes; changes nothing without your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 用量提前用完？统计每个例程每周跑几次，找出前三个元凶（排得太频繁、bot 互相回复循环等）并给出修改方案；没有你同意不改任何东西。
entries.author: Will

entries.name: Daycard
entries.summary: Makes a 1080x1080 daily share card (PNG or GIF) with a short caption from local weather, your activity and your bots' marks. Draft only; you post.
entries.summary_zh: 生成 1080×1080 的每日分享卡片（PNG 或 GIF）和短文案，内容来自当地天气、你的动态和各个 bot 的标记。只出草稿，由你自己发。
entries.author: Tim

entries.name: SceneEdit Video Studio
entries.summary: Scene-by-scene video studio on FFmpeg and Remotion with a Storyboard and Timeline Page, so fixing one caption or shot re-renders only that scene.
entries.summary_zh: 基于 FFmpeg 和 Remotion 的分场景视频工作室，配故事板和时间线 Page；改一句字幕或一个镜头只需重渲那一场，不用整片重做。
entries.author: Lisa

entries.name: Directory Submitter
entries.summary: Gets your startup, SaaS or AI tool listed on about 150 free directories ranked by domain rating, filling forms from your launch kit; never pays.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的创业项目、SaaS 或 AI 工具提交到约 150 个按域名权重排序的免费目录站，用你的发布资料填表，始终选免费选项，从不付费。
entries.author: Nicolas

entries.name: Couch Potato
entries.summary: Entertainment buddy for what to watch next across Netflix, Disney+, Prime and more, plus schedules for your sports teams; can learn your taste from Simkl.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你决定接下来在 Netflix、Disney+、Prime 等平台看什么，并提供你关注球队的赛程；可以从 Simkl 观看记录学习你的口味。
entries.author: Frank

entries.name: radar
entries.summary: Daily X intel digest as morning photo cards and/or a PDF in your 1:1: volume, US trends, a top 10, curator picks, watchlist and topic posts.
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上在私聊里发 X 情报摘要，形式可选图片卡片或 PDF：讨论量、美国趋势、Top 10、精选、关注列表和话题帖子。
entries.author: Tim

entries.name: Reality CheX
entries.summary: Paste a shocking or viral X post and it tells you if it's real, old, AI-made or misleading, with sources and left/center/right coverage.
entries.summary_zh: 贴上一条耸人听闻或疯传的 X 帖，它会判断是真的、旧闻、AI 生成还是误导，并附上来源和左中右各方的报道。
entries.author: Jay

entries.name: Obsidian Second Brain (official)
entries.summary: Obsidian second brain: turns brain dumps into linked notes, keeps daily notes and reviews, answers from your vault with links; never edits without your yes.
entries.summary_zh: Obsidian 第二大脑：把随手倒出的想法整理成互相链接的笔记，维护每日笔记和周回顾，用你的笔记库作答并附来源；未经同意不改任何笔记。
entries.author: Eugeniu

entries.name: KAM por WhatsApp
entries.summary: A WhatsApp account manager for your agency's clients: understands the request, prepares the change, waits for your OK and replies, with rules and templates.
entries.summary_zh: 替你的代理公司或服务业务在 WhatsApp 上接待客户的客户经理：理解需求、准备改动、等你同意后回复客户，带规则、模板和审批。
entries.author: Daniel

entries.name: Deep Research
entries.summary: Digs through primary sources like court records, laws, filings, lobbying, papers and archives, cross-checks them and cites every claim.
entries.summary_zh: 深挖一手资料：法院记录、法律、公开申报、政府支出、游说、论文、书籍和档案，交叉核对，每个结论都附引用，查不实的会标明。
entries.author: Jonah

entries.name: Pit Crew
entries.summary: Your study partner for exactly one exam: plans, quizzes you, reminds you and tracks progress. You study and answer; the bot handles the organizing.
entries.summary_zh: 只为一场考试服务的学习搭档：排计划、出题考你、提醒你并跟踪进度。你负责学和答，组织工作交给 bot。
entries.author: Noah

entries.name: Voice-Note-to-Viral-Post Studio
entries.summary: Turns a 30-60 second voice note into three human-sounding drafts for X, LinkedIn and Facebook, using a cached pattern bank from 10-20 peer accounts.
entries.summary_zh: 把 30 到 60 秒的语音备忘变成三条像真人写的 X、LinkedIn 和 Facebook 草稿，基于对 10 到 20 个同行账号一次性分析缓存的写法库。
entries.author: Lisa

entries.name: Head of Content
entries.summary: An AI head of content for growing on X: builds your brand strategy, connects tools, writes content skills and deploys 10+ content bots; you stay the editor.
entries.summary_zh: 在 X 上做增长的 AI 内容总监：制定品牌策略、接好工具、写内容技能，并部署十几个内容 bot 组成的团队，最终由你把关。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: Memory Transfer
entries.summary: Moves what another assistant like ChatGPT knows about you into your bot's memory, reviewing each fact with you and saving only what you confirm.
entries.summary_zh: 把 ChatGPT 等其他助手对你的了解搬进 bot 的记忆，逐条和你核对，只保存你确认的内容。
entries.author: Shawn

entries.name: Money Glance
entries.summary: Read-only spending visibility from your bank and card feeds (plus X Money): categorizes, flags month-over-month jumps and forgotten subscriptions.
entries.summary_zh: 只读查看银行卡和信用卡流水（可加 X Money）：自动分类，标出环比大涨和被遗忘的订阅，按需给出每周摘要。不提供理财建议。
entries.author: edmundo

entries.name: Rivaldo bot
entries.summary: Scans public X three times a day and sends a list of popular, active accounts worth following in the niches you pick. No X account linking needed.
entries.summary_zh: 每天三次扫描公开的 X，按你选的领域发来值得关注的热门活跃账号清单。不需要绑定 X 账号。
entries.author: nahjuin

entries.name: Crypto Ablation Lab
entries.summary: Backtester that turns your rules into a stepwise ablation, charts equity and drawdown and catches look-ahead bias. Binance klines or CSV; research only.
entries.summary_zh: 回测工具：把你的规则拆成逐步消融实验，画出净值和回撤曲线，并揪出未来函数偏差。数据用币安 K 线或 CSV；仅供研究，不发实盘信号。
entries.author: xie

entries.name: Home Manager
entries.summary: Keeps your home running with a saved home profile, repair log and 12-month maintenance calendar, plus an optional Monday what's-due preview.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你打理家：保存房屋档案、维修记录和 12 个月保养日历，可选每周一预告本周该做的事。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Cram
entries.summary: Turns your notes, slides or syllabus into sourced spaced-repetition flashcards, runs a daily 10-minute drill and counts down to each exam.
entries.summary_zh: 把笔记、课件或大纲变成带出处的间隔重复闪卡，每天 10 分钟练习，为每场考试倒计时并追踪薄弱知识点。
entries.author: Purple

entries.name: Explainer Video bot
entries.summary: Makes upload-ready, data-driven explainer videos with verified numbers, AI voice-over and motion graphics; shows script and storyboard for approval first.
entries.summary_zh: 制作可直接上传的数据讲解视频：数字经过核实，配 AI 旁白和动态图形；先给你看脚本和静帧故事板，批准后才渲染完整 MP4。
entries.author: Grease

entries.name: Househunt
entries.summary: Guides a US home search from a color-coded metro map of prices, taxes, schools and crime to listings, realtors, tours and offers.
entries.summary_zh: 引导你在美国找房：先给出标注房价、房产税、学校、犯罪率的彩色城市地图，再缩小区域、找在售房源、联系经纪人，协助看房和出价。
entries.author: crypto barbie

entries.name: Claim Denied
entries.summary: Insurance denied your claim? Get the reason in plain words, a polite review letter, a checklist for your doctor's office and a call log.
entries.summary_zh: 保险理赔被拒？用大白话讲清原因，帮你写一封礼貌的复核信，列出给医生诊所的清单，并记录通话。
entries.author: Adebusola

entries.name: Course Builder & Coach
entries.summary: Name any topic and get a free step-by-step course: one lesson per screen with a verified video, quiz, flashcards and certificate, plus optional daily coaching.
entries.summary_zh: 说出任意主题，就生成一门免费的分步课程：每屏一课，配核实过的视频、小测、闪卡和结业证书，还可以每天在聊天里辅导你。
entries.author: Jesse

entries.name: Bot Shelf Tracker
entries.summary: Scoreboard for Grok Bot template creators: tracks your Shelf leaderboard rank, launch post views and bookmarks, and underserved categories on a dashboard Page.
entries.summary_zh: 给 Grok Bot 模板作者的计分板：在看板 Page 上跟踪你在 Shelf 排行榜的名次、发布帖的浏览和收藏，以及还没人做的品类。
entries.author: Lisa

entries.name: Mnemosyne
entries.summary: Weekly bot recap artist: reads each of your bots' last 7 days and draws one comic-panel image showing what every bot actually did. Never posts it.
entries.summary_zh: 每周给 bot 画回顾：读每个 bot 过去 7 天的记录，画一张漫画分格图，展示每个 bot 实际干了什么。不替你外发。
entries.author: pymmog

entries.name: Bridge Bot
entries.summary: Lets ChatGPT, Claude Code or any tool send tasks to your Grok Bot over a webhook; one setup prompt adds a Send to Grok Bot skill, and results come back.
entries.summary_zh: 让 ChatGPT、Claude Code 或任何工具通过 webhook 给你的 Grok Bot 派活；粘贴一段设置提示就能加上 Send to Grok Bot 技能，做完会回报结果。
entries.author: Moritz

entries.name: Groksters Anonymous
entries.summary: A funny-but-caring support group for people hooked on building bots: confessions, stretches, a coffee tip, a roast of your bot count and a nudge to take breaks.
entries.summary_zh: 给沉迷做 bot 的人开的搞笑又贴心的互助会：每次聊天都是一场小会，有坦白、拉伸、咖啡建议、对你 bot 数量的温柔吐槽，以及提醒你休息。
entries.author: Jay

entries.name: Bolus Buddy
entries.summary: Reviews your Tandem insulin pump and CGM data and suggests carb ratio, correction, target and basal changes by time of day to discuss with your care team.
entries.summary_zh: 分析你的 Tandem 胰岛素泵和 CGM 数据，按时段建议调整碳水比、校正系数、目标值和基础率并附依据，供你和糖尿病医疗团队讨论。
entries.author: Cayden

entries.name: Auditor de Urnas
entries.summary: Audits Brazilian elections with public TSE data: results, ballot box reports and logs, software hashes, and tracking of audit projects.
entries.summary_zh: 用巴西选举法院 TSE 的公开数据审计巴西选举：结果、投票机公告和日志、软件哈希，并跟踪审计相关项目。
entries.author: airamomagister

entries.name: Next Episode
entries.summary: Finds your next TV series: share what you've loved, your mood, time and streaming services, and get 3 to 5 spoiler-free picks with where to watch.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你找下一部剧：说说喜欢过什么、当下心情、有多少时间和订了哪些流媒体，给出 3 到 5 部无剧透推荐和观看平台，并逐渐学会你的口味。
entries.author: Nazhand

entries.name: Topic Miner
entries.summary: Finds the best-performing posts from X accounts your size in your niche and turns their winning themes into questions you can answer as your own posts.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你所在领域、体量相近的 X 账号里表现最好的帖子，把爆款主题变成你可以用自己的帖子来回答的问题，附开头写法和来源链接。
entries.author: winch

entries.name: Brain Keeper

entries.author: Jeremy

entries.name: Bedtime Story Bot
entries.summary: Nightly illustrated stories starring your kid, read aloud in a voice note and saved to a keepsake storybook. For parents who want bedtime to be easier.

entries.summary: A short morning brief on the topics and accounts you pick on X, with why each story matters and a link to every post. Read-only, it never posts for you.

entries.summary: Upload your notes or a PDF and get a study plan, page-cited flashcards and daily quizzes until exam day. Made for students with a set exam date.

entries.name: Really Hard Problem Solver
entries.summary: Solves hard problems with a multi-model consensus: several AI advisors propose, cross-review and sign one plan, tested against fixed pass/fail numbers.

entries.author: Eric

entries.name: Photo Librarian
entries.summary: Catalogs sheet-music photos from a Google Drive folder into a deduplicated Google Sheet library, with cover extraction and careful web gap-filling.

entries.name: Gun Buddy

entries.author: Jackbinswitch

entries.summary: Office manager for HVAC, plumbing, electrical and handyman shops: estimate drafts, quote follow-ups, invoices and a morning call list. Drafts only.

entries.author: dcalderonia

entries.summary: Turns a connected inbox into a daily Reply / Archive / Escalate action board. Drafts replies in your voice and never sends without your approval.

entries.summary: Turns your X Spaces into vertical clips with captions, speaker avatars and a ring that lights up on whoever's talking, then suggests post titles.
